summary: Note Buddy, an ambient AI documentation tool built with Microsoft and Synapxe, has expanded beyond SingHealth to Singapore's other public healthcare clusters, with thousands of clinicians now using it to cut charting time.

headline: Global life and health insurance M&A values surge even as deal count holds flat
summary: Milliman's 2026 review found the number of announced life and health insurance M&A transactions worldwide held steady at 85 deals in 2025, but total deal value jumped roughly 150%, with private capital-backed buyers remaining prominent.

headline: Global MGA and MGU market grows to $17.3 billion in revenue
summary: The worldwide managing general agent, underwriter and cover-holder market grew about 19% annually to roughly $17.3 billion in revenue, with the top five groups controlling nearly a fifth of the global total.

headline: CMS restricts Medicare Advantage plans from reopening approved hospital admissions
summary: Under its 2026 final rule, CMS bars Medicare Advantage plans from rescinding previously approved inpatient hospital admissions except for fraud or clear error, and requires faster turnaround on prior-authorization appeals.

headline: UK holds pension auto-enrolment thresholds steady while a government panel flags a savings gap
summary: The Department for Work and Pensions kept 2026/27 automatic-enrolment earnings thresholds unchanged, even as the Second Pensions Commission's interim report estimates around 15 million working-age Britons are undersaving relative to target retirement income.

headline: CMS floats rule locking in Medicare drug-price negotiation and new PBM reporting mandates
summary: CMS proposed converting the IRA's Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program into binding federal regulation starting plan year 2029 and opened comment on a framework requiring PBMs to report detailed drug pricing and rebate data.

headline: Modera Wealth adds $312M Florida RIA to expand state footprint
summary: Modera Wealth Management, a roughly $17.5 billion RIA, agreed to acquire Northstar Financial Planners, a Florida-based advisory firm managing about $311.6 million in client assets.

headline: Creative Planning deepens Southwest Florida push with accounting-firm acquisition
summary: National RIA Creative Planning agreed to acquire MarkhamNorton Accountants+Advisors, a 45-year-old Southwest Florida tax and advisory firm, in a deal expected to close July 1.

headline: Submissions-tool startup Sytrex rebrands as Braven after $4.6M seed and London launch
summary: Formerly known as Sytrex, the insurance infrastructure startup raised a $4.6 million seed round led by Collide Capital, rebranded as Braven, and opened a London office to chase delegated-authority and specialty business.

headline: F&G Annuities taps Conor Murphy as CEO as Chris Blunt steps down
summary: F&G Annuities & Life announced that President and CFO Conor Murphy will become CEO and President as longtime chief executive Chris Blunt retires effective June 30, with a new CFO also set to join the company in August.

headline: CRC Group recruits Beazley's Bethany Greenwood to lead underwriting arm
summary: Wholesale broker CRC Group named Bethany Greenwood, formerly head of specialty risks at Beazley in London, as CEO of its underwriting division spanning Starwind Specialty, AmRisc, Atrium and Euclid Transactional.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life Elevates Conor Murphy to Chief Executive
summary: F&G Annuities & Life announced a leadership overhaul in which Conor Murphy succeeds retiring CEO Chris Blunt, alongside other executive changes including a new chief financial officer, effective mid-2026.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life hands CEO reins to Conor Murphy as Chris Blunt steps down
summary: F&G Annuities & Life announced Chris Blunt's retirement as CEO with President/CFO Conor Murphy elevated to CEO and President, while Michael Bailey, formerly Corebridge Financial's Retail CFO, joins as EVP and CFO effective August 3, 2026.

headline: ING taps bolttech to widen embedded insurance across its European retail footprint
summary: ING selected bolttech as a strategic partner to expand embedded insurance and protection products across its European operations, with the tie-up already live in the Netherlands, Italy, Poland and Belgium and more markets planned.

headline: Waverly Advisors makes first trust-company purchase, buying $3B Smithfield Trust
summary: Birmingham-based Waverly Advisors acquired Pittsburgh's Smithfield Trust Company in its first dedicated trust acquisition, pushing the RIA's total assets under management well past $35 billion.

headline: Nassau Financial backs AI-governance startup Trussed AI through its Reimagine program
summary: Nassau Financial Group made an undisclosed investment in Trussed AI, a platform that helps regulated enterprises audit and govern their AI systems, via Nassau's insurtech-focused Reimagine venture program.

headline: HSBC signs multi-year AI alliance with Google Cloud
summary: HSBC entered a multi-year partnership with Google Cloud to embed AI more deeply across its banking and financial-services operations as part of a broader industry push toward cloud-based AI infrastructure.

headline: India raises insurer penalties tenfold under new insurance law amendments
summary: The maximum penalty for violations of India's Insurance Act and IRDAI Act increased tenfold, from ₹1 crore to ₹10 crore, under the newly enacted Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha (Amendment of Insurance Laws) Act.

headline: Waverly Advisors Extends Trust Platform With $3 Billion Smithfield Trust Deal
summary: RIA aggregator Waverly Advisors closed its 34th acquisition since 2021, adding Pittsburgh-based Smithfield Trust Company and roughly $3 billion in fiduciary and trust assets to broaden its estate and trust administration capabilities in Pennsylvania.

headline: Sixfold brings its AI underwriting assistant to the broader P&C market
summary: After three years of development with major carriers, Sixfold made its AI Underwriter generally available to property and casualty insurers, aiming to speed submission review and risk triage.

headline: Nearly half of US states now follow NAIC's AI model bulletin as insurers race to deploy AI
summary: As AI becomes embedded in underwriting, pricing and claims handling, 23 states plus Washington D.C. have adopted the NAIC's model bulletin governing insurers' AI use, with a national AI evaluation tool now piloting across a dozen states.

headline: Medicare navigation platform Connie Health lands $40M and folds in Clearlink's Medicare book
summary: Connie Health closed a $40 million Series B led by HealthQuest Capital while simultaneously completing its tenth acquisition, absorbing Clearlink Insurance Agency's Medicare business to scale its AI-driven senior-enrollment platform.

headline: Ascensus and Voya team up on pooled retirement plan for mid-size and large employers
summary: FuturePlan by Ascensus launched the PATH Pooled Employer Plan with Voya serving as recordkeeper and trustee and Mesirow providing fiduciary investment oversight, aiming to bring institutional-grade governance to a broader swath of employers.

headline: China issues first nationwide AI rulebook for banks and insurers
summary: China's National Financial Regulatory Administration published guidelines spanning governance, data handling and risk management for AI use across the banking and insurance sectors, its first comprehensive framework of its kind.

headline: BrokerTech Ventures sets September dates for second annual BrokerTech Connect conference
summary: BrokerTech Ventures announced its second annual BrokerTech Connect conference will convene C-suite executives from brokerages, carriers, wholesalers, and insurtech startups in Chicago on September 1-2, 2026.

headline: PwC projects APAC client assets to nearly double to $154 trillion by 2030
summary: A new PwC report forecasts Asia-Pacific client assets growing at a 6.3% CAGR, from $107.2 trillion in 2024 to $154.3 trillion by 2030, with regional AUM growth outpacing both North America and Europe.

headline: US wealthtech funding on pace for 27% jump in 2026 as capital spreads more widely
summary: US wealthtech investment is projected to reach roughly $3.8 billion across about 328 deals in 2026, a 27% rise in deal count, with money increasingly spread across B2B platforms and AI-driven advice tools rather than concentrated in mega-rounds.

headline: BrokerTech Ventures sets September Chicago summit pairing carriers, brokers and AI vendors
summary: BrokerTech Ventures unveiled plans for its second BrokerTech Connect conference in Chicago this September, where technology sponsors including Vertafore and Fulcrum will showcase AI-powered tools for agency automation alongside the group's newly announced startup accelerator cohort.

headline: CMS stands up a dedicated office to police AI and digital health tools across Medicare
summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services created a new Office of Health Technology Products to coordinate oversight of artificial intelligence, interoperability and other emerging digital health technologies across its programs, signaling a bigger federal push to shape how AI is adopted in care delivery and program integrity.

headline: Regulators start eyeing the AI models baked into annuity pricing and sales
summary: A Forbes analysis describes growing regulatory attention on opaque AI systems insurers now use to price, underwrite and market annuities, warning that unmonitored model risk could create new consumer-protection exposures.

headline: UK insurers face crunch deadline to prove they can wind down safely
summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority's solvent exit planning regime became fully binding on 30 June 2026, requiring most PRA-regulated insurers to maintain a documented Solvent Exit Analysis showing how they could leave the market without disrupting policyholders. Firms must also secure independent internal-audit assurance over their exit preparations, and supervisors can now request the analysis at any time.

headline: CMS opens comment period on PBM pay restrictions taking effect in 2028
summary: CMS is gathering feedback on how to define PBM affiliates and enforce flat, non-drug-price-linked bona fide service fee compensation limits taking effect in 2028 under the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, with comments due July 20.

headline: BrokerTech Ventures unveils 2026 accelerator class of nine startups
summary: BrokerTech Ventures named its 2026 accelerator cohort of nine insurtech startups and confirmed dates for its second annual BrokerTech Connect conference, set for September 1-2 in Chicago.

headline: Abarca-LucyRx merger creates new PBM serving 9 million members, may spur more deals
summary: The combination of pharmacy benefit managers Abarca Health and LucyRx formed a new alternative PBM serving more than nine million members, with analysts expecting the tie-up to spur further consolidation among smaller PBMs facing rising regulatory complexity.

headline: Corgi Insurance teams up with Silicon Valley Bank to embed startup coverage into banking relationships
summary: AI-native commercial insurer Corgi struck a partnership with Silicon Valley Bank so SVB's startup clients can access Corgi's digital insurance and risk-management tools directly through their banking relationship.

headline: Vertafore and Fulcrum headline BrokerTech Ventures' September Chicago conference
summary: BrokerTech Ventures announced its second annual BrokerTech Connect conference for September 1-2 in Chicago, with sponsors Vertafore and Fulcrum showcasing AI-powered distribution and proposal-automation tools for brokers and wholesalers.

headline: IRDAI proposes letting insurers park up to 5% of surplus capital in private companies
summary: India's regulator floated rules allowing insurers to invest a portion of shareholder funds beyond the solvency margin into private limited companies, plus new repo and securities-lending powers for life insurers to manage liquidity.

headline: Acrisure's UK arm loses its CEO and CFO/COO in abrupt leadership shake-up
summary: Acrisure UK chief executive Mark Mcilquham and CFO/COO Katherine Cross both had their roles terminated, with interim leadership handed to Andrew Boyce and Eleanor Gamble as the broker platform's UK retail business regroups.

headline: India's insurance regulator sets up a working group to govern AI use in the sector
summary: IRDAI formed a seven-member working group on artificial intelligence with a three-month mandate to map current AI adoption among insurers and propose a framework for ethical, transparent and explainable AI use, with particular focus on claims processing and fraud detection.

headline: Private medical cover in Britain hits its highest level since the financial crisis
summary: Roughly one in eight Britons now holds private medical insurance, the highest share since 2008, as frustration with NHS waiting times pushes more households and employers toward private cover.

headline: IRDAI drafts rule to give health TPAs permanent licenses instead of 3-year renewals
summary: India's insurance regulator has floated amendments that would replace the current three-year registration cycle for third-party administrators with a perpetual license subject to annual fees and compliance, following changes under the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha insurance law reforms.

headline: BCG report ties agentic AI to a coming shift in wealth management economics
summary: Boston Consulting Group's 2026 Global Wealth Report argues that agentic AI is beginning to change the cost and revenue structure of wealth management, favoring firms that redesign advisory workflows around autonomous digital agents.

headline: One in ten Medicare Advantage members forced off their plan for 2026 as insurers retreat from markets
summary: A new study finds forced disenrollments hit roughly 10% of MA enrollees heading into 2026, a tenfold jump from historical norms, as carriers pulled back from unprofitable counties and plans.

headline: Four in Ten Insurers Now Use AI in Underwriting Amid Competitive and Pricing Pressure
summary: A Sollers Consulting analysis found underwriting has become the fastest-growing IT investment area for insurers, with roughly 40% now using AI in the function as carriers race to automate submission triage and unstructured document processing amid a softening market.

headline: India's GIFT City rolls out new MGA licensing regime for foreign insurers
summary: The International Financial Services Centres Authority introduced a regulatory framework allowing managing general agents to operate for foreign insurers out of GIFT City, a move industry figures are calling a pivotal build-or-broker decision point for Indian insurance distribution.

headline: ICICI Prudential debuts India's first guaranteed-maturity ULIP
summary: ICICI Prudential Life launched ICICI Pru Signature Secure, billed as the Indian industry's first unit-linked insurance plan with a built-in guaranteed maturity benefit of up to 140% of premium paid, alongside life cover and no allocation charges.

headline: Target-date fund assets climb to $4.8 trillion as collective investment trusts gain ground, Morningstar finds
summary: Morningstar's 2026 landscape report shows target-date fund assets grew more than 20% year-over-year, with falling fees and rising use of lower-cost collective investment trusts reshaping how retirement plan sponsors pick defaults.

headline: McKinsey: US retirement industry nears an inflection point as decumulation accelerates
summary: McKinsey analysis finds the defined contribution system is approaching a tipping point as baby boomer withdrawals increasingly outpace younger workers' contributions, pushing recordkeepers and asset managers to rethink decumulation products.

headline: Private Equity Firm Flexpoint Ford Takes Stake in Insurance Carrier Platform Novel Financial
summary: Flexpoint Ford invested in Novel Financial Holdings, an independent holding company backing managing general underwriters and carriers that write roughly $2 billion in annual premium, broadening Novel's ownership base as it scales.

headline: MGA platform Novel Financial Holdings lands strategic backing from Flexpoint Ford
summary: Novel Financial Holdings, which oversees carriers writing about $2 billion in annual premium tied to managing general underwriters, received a growth investment from private equity firm Flexpoint Ford.

headline: Reliance Global Group recruits Coinbase and Capital One veteran as CTO
summary: Reliance Global Group named a new Chief Technology Officer with backgrounds from Coinbase and Capital One, alongside a new COO and EVP, to steer the company's AI-driven insurance product roadmap and its strategy of rolling up independent agencies.

headline: Reliance Global Taps Ex-Coinbase, Capital One Executive as CTO for AI Agency Roll-Up
summary: Insurance agency consolidator Reliance Global Group named a new Chief Technology Officer with a Coinbase and Capital One background, alongside a new COO and EVP, to lead development of AI-native insurance products and its agency acquisition strategy.

headline: Reinsurance Group of America promotes finance veteran to CFO
summary: RGA named Executive Vice President Laura Cockrill as chief financial officer effective immediately, succeeding Axel Andre, who is leaving the reinsurer; Cockrill has more than 25 years of experience across the company's finance functions.

headline: US P&C insurers post strong 92.4 combined ratio as premium growth cools sharply
summary: Verisk and APCIA reported that US property-casualty carriers notched a 92.4 combined ratio and roughly $15.8 billion in underwriting gains for Q1 2026, even as premium growth decelerated markedly from prior years.

headline: Ambience Healthcare Expands AI Nursing Suite With Ambient Flowsheet Documentation
summary: Ambience Healthcare introduced Nursing Summary and Ambient Flowsheet Documentation tools that convert a nurse's spoken patient assessment directly into structured EHR entries, extending its inpatient AI system from pre-shift prep through charting.

headline: Ambience Healthcare expands ambient AI into inpatient nursing documentation
summary: Ambience Healthcare rolled out a Nursing Suite adding automated shift summaries and ambient flowsheet documentation, aiming to cut manual charting burden for inpatient nurses while keeping clinicians reviewing every entry.

headline: Bengaluru cyber-insurance startup Mitigata raises $15 million Series B led by Bessemer
summary: Mitigata, which combines cybersecurity monitoring with cyber insurance for Indian businesses, closed a $15 million Series B led by Bessemer Venture Partners to expand internationally and scale its AI-powered security operations center.

headline: AI tool wins first-of-its-kind FDA clearance for detecting hidden heart disease from routine ECGs
summary: Pathway Labs' EchoNext became the first FDA-cleared AI tool to flag six types of structural heart disease from a standard 12-lead ECG, trained on hundreds of thousands of paired ECG-echocardiogram records and now being distributed via OpenEvidence.

headline: US P&C insurers swing to $16.3 billion underwriting gain in strongest Q1 in decades
summary: The US property-casualty industry posted a $16.3 billion net underwriting gain in Q1 2026, reversing a year-earlier loss on lower catastrophe losses and easing incurred-loss trends, according to AM Best data.

headline: Point32Health's TPA arm HPI names Tim O'Brien as president
summary: Health Plans, Inc., a national third-party administrator of self-funded benefit plans, appointed Tim O'Brien president, bringing experience from leading Vitori Health through its sale to Global Excel Management.

headline: IRDAI consults industry on insurer-funded policyholder protection fund
summary: India's insurance regulator opened a consultation on whether insurers should make ongoing contributions to a new Policyholders' Education and Protection Fund, with industry comments due mid-July.

headline: Embedded Insurance and Finance Draw Closer Regulatory Scrutiny as Sector Matures
summary: As insurance and financial products embedded directly into everyday apps and checkouts move from novelty to mainstream, regulators including the UK's FCA are moving to extend open-finance data-sharing rules to cover insurance, pensions, lending and savings.

headline: AI-native agency roll-up Equal Parts snaps up Texas independent agency D3
summary: Equal Parts, which buys independent insurance agencies and migrates them onto its AI operating platform Ultron, acquired Amarillo-based D3 Insurance, extending its roll-up strategy to a fourth state as it pursues $1 billion in premium within two years.

headline: FDA clears AI tool that spots hidden heart disease from routine ECGs
summary: Pathway Labs' EchoNext became the first AI system cleared to flag structural heart conditions like heart failure and valve disease directly from a standard 12-lead ECG, reportedly outperforming cardiologists in large-scale validation testing.

headline: Soft commercial market hands US brokers new negotiating leverage, CIAB finds
summary: CIAB's Q1 2026 survey found average commercial premiums fell 1.2% across all account sizes, the first broad decline in nearly nine years, while independent agents kept growing their share of the $1.1 trillion US P&C distribution market.

headline: Allianz Retire+ hires senior distribution lead as its guaranteed-income annuity gains adviser traction
summary: Allianz Retire+ reported a 31% jump in uptake of its AGILE lifetime-income product since January and named a new senior manager for retirement solutions to build on the momentum following recent fee cuts and product enhancements.

headline: Goldman Sachs leads $110M round for AI decisioning startup Taktile eyeing insurance claims
summary: Taktile raised a $110 million Series C led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives with Tiger Global and Index Ventures participating, positioning its AI decisioning platform to speed up high-stakes banking and insurance-claims calls.

headline: HOPPR Rolls Out AI Draft-Reporting Agent for Radiology Workflows
summary: HOPPR commercially launched Presto, an AI reporting agent that drafts radiology reports directly inside existing systems like PowerScribe without requiring new software or platform migrations.

headline: Bengaluru cyber insurtech Mitigata lands $15M Series B from Bessemer
summary: Mitigata, an IRDAI-regulated cyber insurance broker serving over 800 organizations, raised a $15 million Series B led by Bessemer Venture Partners to expand its combined security, compliance and insurance platform.

headline: HOPPR debuts Presto agent to slot AI draft reporting into radiologists' existing tools
summary: HOPPR commercially launched Presto, an AI agent that drafts radiology reports directly inside systems like PowerScribe without requiring a new platform, pulling structured findings into radiologists' own templates.

headline: Matic scoops up Policygenius' home and auto book alongside new PE backing
summary: Embedded insurance platform Matic secured a minority growth investment from Primus Capital while simultaneously acquiring nearly 30,000 property and casualty policies from Policygenius, folding those customers into its 70-plus carrier marketplace.

headline: Bengaluru cyber insurance startup Mitigata lands $15 million Series B
summary: Mitigata, an IRDAI-regulated cyber insurance broker, raised a $15 million Series B led by Bessemer Venture Partners to expand its AI-powered cyber resilience platform internationally and scale its security operations center.

headline: Matic buys Policygenius's 30,000-policy home and auto book, adds Primus Capital as investor
summary: Embedded insurance platform Matic acquired Policygenius's property and casualty insurance portfolio of nearly 30,000 policies and secured a minority growth investment from Primus Capital to fund further expansion.

headline: Corebridge and Equitable set July 30 shareholder vote on $22B merger
summary: Corebridge Financial and Equitable Holdings have scheduled simultaneous special shareholder meetings for July 30, 2026 to approve their all-stock combination into a new holding company, New Equitable, which would manage roughly $1.5 trillion in assets across retirement, life and wealth businesses.

headline: AI-native wealth manager Arca exits stealth with $64 million and Vanguard's former CEO on its board
summary: Founded by ex-Plaid product leader Rron Rexha, Arca raised a $15.5 million seed round and $48.5 million Series A led by General Catalyst, adding former Vanguard chief Bill McNabb and Altruist CEO Jason Wenk as advisors while managing over $1 billion in client assets.

headline: AI-native RIA Arca raises $64M with backing from Vanguard's former CEO
summary: Arca, an AI-native wealth management startup founded by a former Plaid product lead, raised $64 million across seed and Series A rounds led by Venrock and General Catalyst, with former Vanguard CEO Bill McNabb and Altruist CEO Jason Wenk on its board; the firm now manages more than $1 billion in client assets.

headline: Ryan Specialty's wholesale unit RT Specialty names new CEO in planned handover
summary: RT Specialty confirmed that Ryan Specialty co-president Brendan Mulshine will take over as CEO effective August 1, 2026, with outgoing chief Ed McCormack moving to vice chairman, alongside several other leadership moves across the wholesale brokerage's practice groups.

headline: Matic buys Policygenius's property-casualty book while taking on new capital partner
summary: Insurance-technology platform Matic acquired roughly 30,000 home and auto policies from Policygenius's property-casualty portfolio and simultaneously secured a minority growth investment from Primus Capital to fund further embedded-insurance partnerships and acquisitions.

headline: AI-decisioning startup Taktile raises $110 million Series C led by Goldman Sachs
summary: Taktile, which helps banks and insurers automate underwriting, claims and other high-stakes decisions with AI, closed a $110 million round led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, with Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Tiger Global and Y Combinator also participating.

headline: New Plug-and-Play Platform Aims to Lower Barriers for Launching MGAs
summary: Exclusive Underwriting Managers launched a turnkey managing general agent platform designed to streamline the operational infrastructure needed for retail brokers, wholesale brokers and program underwriters to start new programs.

headline: Taktile raises $110 million Series C led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives
summary: Taktile, whose agentic decision platform helps banks and insurers automate underwriting, claims and fraud decisions, closed a $110 million Series C round, bringing its total funding to $184 million as it expands across the U.S., EMEA and Latin America.

headline: Annuities creep into more target-date funds, but plan adoption stays cautious
summary: Assets in target-date strategies embedding annuities nearly doubled year over year to about $44 billion, yet that remains under 1% of the broader $4.8 trillion target-date market as plan sponsors continue weighing guaranteed-income options.

headline: French health insurer Alan lands $550 million round to push 'prevention insurance' worldwide
summary: Alan announced a €480 million ($550 million) Series G led by Prosus at a €5.5 billion valuation, funding to expand its model of bundling health coverage, prevention and AI-powered care navigation beyond France after crossing €800 million in annual recurring revenue.

headline: New York issues consumer guidance as Essential Plan eligibility narrows
summary: New York's Attorney General published guidance for residents after federal rule changes stripped Essential Plan eligibility from roughly 450,000 lawfully present immigrants and higher-income enrollees effective July 2026.

headline: Insurers' net investment income hits 26-year high as yields keep climbing
summary: US insurers' aggregate net investment income rose 5.7% to $371 billion in 2025, a fourth straight annual record, with portfolio yields climbing toward an estimated 4.2% in 2026 before expected Fed easing narrows future gains.

headline: Goldman Sachs Leads $110 Million Round for AI Decisioning Startup Taktile
summary: Taktile, whose agentic AI platform automates high-stakes underwriting, claims and fraud decisions for banks and insurers, raised a $110 million Series C led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives with Tiger Global and other backers, bringing total funding to $184 million.

headline: Specialty MGA Amiga taps veteran underwriter to lead new Hong Kong financial lines push
summary: Amiga Specialty appointed longtime cyber, D&O and professional-liability underwriter Ralph Sherbahn to lead its newly launched Hong Kong operation as it builds out financial-lines coverage across Asia Pacific.

headline: Fidelity to add guaranteed income to target-date lineup via new CIT suite
summary: Fidelity partnered with Nationwide and New York Life to build "Fidelity Freedom Lifetime," a target-date collective investment trust suite with an embedded guaranteed-income option, set to reach employers on Fidelity's recordkeeping platform in early 2027.

headline: Federato plants flag in APAC, opens Sydney office to chase AI underwriting demand
summary: AI-native underwriting platform Federato is expanding into Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Japan and Korea, opening a Sydney base and hiring a regional VP as it targets commercial-lines carriers and MGAs across the region.

headline: Private equity now owns nearly 1 in 10 US private hospitals
summary: A tracker of private-equity hospital ownership counted 447 PE-owned facilities as of June 2026, about 9.5% of all private hospitals, with a disproportionate share of their real estate held by REITs.

headline: APAC wealth management market on track to reach $41.8 trillion by 2031
summary: PwC projects Asia-Pacific wealth management assets to grow from an estimated $29.6 trillion this year to $41.8 trillion by 2031, with private banks holding roughly 37% share even as fintech-enabled advisors grow fastest.

headline: UpDoc Becomes First FDA-Cleared AI Platform With Patient-Facing Chat
summary: UpDoc received FDA clearance for what it describes as the first agentic clinical AI platform built around a patient-facing large language model, with early rollouts at several major health systems. The company positions the tool as a clinician support system rather than a replacement for physicians.

headline: S&P flags rising, and riskier, private credit exposure inside insurer portfolios
summary: S&P Global Ratings estimates insurers now supply roughly 23% of private credit capital, with some private-equity-affiliated life insurers exceeding 15% of assets in the category even as default rates tick higher.

headline: Corgi secures $108 million and regulatory approval to launch AI-native carrier for startups
summary: Y Combinator alum Corgi obtained carrier authority and funding to operate what it calls the first AI-native, full-stack insurer built specifically for startup companies, offering D&O, E&O and cyber coverage.

headline: Australian Retirement Trust eyes Southeast Asia for its next wave of long-term investment
summary: Executives from Australian Retirement Trust said at a Hanoi investor roundtable that Southeast Asia is becoming an increasingly attractive destination for large pension funds looking to diversify their portfolios beyond the US market.

headline: Clearwater Analytics completes $8.4 billion take-private buyout
summary: Permira and Warburg Pincus, backed by Francisco Partners and Temasek, closed their $8.4 billion take-private acquisition of investment-data platform Clearwater Analytics, delisting its shares from the NYSE.

headline: Innovaccer and AWS sign multi-year deal to scale agentic AI across health systems
summary: Innovaccer and AWS announced a strategic collaboration pairing Innovaccer's healthcare AI platform with AWS infrastructure, including Bedrock and HealthLake, to help health systems and payers move AI pilots into production faster.

headline: French health insurtech Alan closes 480 million euro Series G at a 5.5 billion euro valuation
summary: Alan, the French digital health insurer and prevention platform, raised a 480 million euro Series G round led by Prosus, with participation from Index Ventures and Teachers' Venture Growth, just months after a prior 100 million euro round, as its annualized revenue passed 800 million euros.

headline: Roughly 450,000 immigrants lose New York's Essential Plan coverage as eligibility rules tighten
summary: New York's Essential Plan enrollees between 200-250% of the federal poverty level, including many lawfully present immigrants, lost coverage on July 1, 2026 after federal changes eliminated the subsidies that made the expanded program financially viable.

headline: French health insurtech Alan closes €480 million Series G, valuing it at €5.5 billion
summary: Prosus led the round alongside existing backers Index Ventures and Teachers' Venture Growth plus new investor Dara Holdings, making it one of Europe's largest insurtech raises this year as Alan pushes into prevention-focused health coverage globally.

headline: Maybank rolls out AI-powered advisory tools built with Swiss fintech Evooq
summary: Malaysian banking group Maybank partnered with Switzerland-based Evooq to launch an AI advisory platform, Advisor Assist, giving relationship managers consolidated portfolio views, risk analytics and next-best-action recommendations. The rollout is part of Maybank's broader wealth transformation push as regional banks race to embed AI into advisory workflows.

headline: French digital insurer Alan raises EUR480 million at EUR5.5 billion valuation
summary: Alan closed a EUR480 million ($550 million) Series G round led by Prosus, with Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan participating for a third straight round, as the profitable French insurer targets Canada as a growth market.

headline: Goldman-Led $110 Million Round Backs AI-Native Claims Automation Startup
summary: A major funding round led by Goldman Sachs backed an AI claims automation platform that one large insurer is reportedly piloting to save more than $90 million, underscoring AI's dominance of insurtech investment dollars.

summary: Goldman Sachs led a $110 million investment into Taktile, with one major insurer reportedly modeling more than $90 million in claims savings from adopting the AI decisioning platform, in one of the quarter's largest insurtech rounds.

headline: Arca Wealth raises $48.5M to rip out legacy software from over $1B of RIA roll-ups
summary: Arca Wealth secured fresh growth capital to migrate the firms it has acquired onto a new AI-driven technology stack, though some industry critics argue the model is a repackaged version of an existing RIA consolidation playbook.

headline: AI-native insurer Corgi launches full-service claims TPA with 5,000 adjusters
summary: Corgi Insurance rolled out Corgi Claims, a third-party administrator that pairs a nationwide adjuster network with AI that scores severity and flags coverage gaps the instant a claim is filed, serving carriers, MGAs and self-insured programs across major commercial lines.

headline: ANV strikes deal for pan-European travel-protection MGA Assured Underwriting Group
summary: Delegated-underwriting platform ANV agreed to buy London-based Assured Underwriting Group, the UK's top underwriter of travel-insurance bonds, from private-equity owner Mobeus, pending FCA approval expected to close in Q3 2026.

headline: Annuity-Embedded Target-Date Funds Near $42 Billion as Adoption Speeds Up
summary: Target-date fund series that embed guaranteed-income annuities grew nearly 70% year-over-year to about $42 billion across 13 series by the end of March 2026, with BlackRock's LifePath Paycheck line driving much of the gain.

headline: Orion Becomes One of the First Wealthtech Platforms Certified Under Global AI Governance Standard
summary: Orion Advisor Solutions earned ISO/IEC 42001 certification for the AI management system behind its Denali intelligence layer, joining a small group of tech firms with the credential.

headline: Judge forces Mississippi Medicaid to pay Delta hospital to avert closure
summary: A Mississippi Chancery Court judge ordered the state's Medicaid division to release a $2.4 million payment to Greenwood Leflore Hospital, averting an imminent shutdown while a planned takeover by the University of Mississippi Medical Center proceeds.

headline: QBE reshuffles Asia leadership with new COO and data/AI chief
summary: QBE named Patrick Karlowski as Chief Operating Officer for Asia, succeeding Klaas Dijkstra who moves to a Chief Information Officer role, while Florence Chan was appointed Head of Data, Analytics and AI for Asia, both based in Hong Kong.

headline: Turtlemint becomes India's second insurtech to go public
summary: Insurance distribution platform Turtlemint listed on the NSE and BSE after an IPO that raised roughly $106 million, marking only the second Indian insurtech to reach public markets and signaling growing investor confidence in the country's digital insurance distribution model.

headline: IRDAI fields first wave of applications under India's new 100% FDI insurance rules
summary: India's insurance regulator has begun receiving formal applications from global insurers seeking full ownership or joint ventures now that 100% foreign direct investment is permitted, while separately requiring Prudential plc to cut its ICICI Prudential Life stake below 10% before its Bharti Life deal can be cleared.

headline: PFRDA overhauls NPS fee structure to ease burden on dormant and small accounts
summary: India's pension regulator finalized a revised charge structure for National Pension System recordkeeping agencies effective July 1, 2026, cutting fees on dormant accounts, waiving charges on small Tier II balances, and simplifying PRAN account-opening costs.

headline: Jackson named InvestmentNews' 2026 Annuities Provider of the Year
summary: Jackson National Life won the award after launching a third and fourth generation RILA suite and a new fixed-indexed annuity with an embedded guaranteed withdrawal benefit, alongside a 14th straight year of top customer-service honors.

headline: Sixth Street to become majority shareholder of pan-European life consolidator Monument Re
summary: Sixth Street signed a definitive agreement to acquire a majority stake in Monument Re, with Hannover Re remaining a key shareholder, giving the in-force life and annuity consolidator fresh capital for its European growth strategy.

headline: Digital insurance distributor Turtlemint prices IPO to raise roughly $106 million
summary: Turtlemint FinTech Solutions opened its Indian public offering, combining a fresh share issue and offer-for-sale, as its tech-enabled 'phygital' broker-advisor model targets continued growth in a still-underpenetrated market.

headline: MetLife flags softer variable investment income ahead of second-quarter results
summary: MetLife pre-announced that variable investment income for the quarter ended June 30 will likely come in between $220 million and $270 million pretax, tracking below its $1.6 billion full-year guidance pace, ahead of its August 5 earnings release.

headline: NHS launches £85 million AI-driven obesity care pilots
summary: NHS England, backed by £50 million in government funding and £35 million from Eli Lilly, is rolling out 12 projects including AI-assisted triage in Norfolk and Suffolk and 24/7 WhatsApp coaching for families in Kent, aiming to ease pressure on specialist obesity clinics.

headline: KB Asset Management launches Korea-focused qualified target-date fund
summary: KB Asset Management rolled out a new domestically focused target-date fund for Korean retirement pension accounts, concentrating holdings in local stocks and bonds rather than global benchmarks.

headline: Jackson National named InvestmentNews' 2026 Annuities Provider of the Year
summary: Jackson National Life Insurance was recognized for product innovation, education and service at the InvestmentNews Awards, underscoring its continued scale in fixed and registered index-linked annuities as the carrier also marked a 14th consecutive year atop SQM's customer-service ranking.

headline: Prudential-HCL joint venture becomes India's eighth standalone health insurer
summary: IRDAI granted a health insurance licence to the Prudential-HCL joint venture (70% Prudential, 30% HCL Group) at its 136th board meeting, making it India's eighth standalone health insurer and the regulator's third new registration this year.

summary: India's insurance regulator issued a consultation paper requiring brokers and other intermediaries that earn more than roughly Rs 10 crore in annual commissions to disclose commission income, related-party dealings and profit details, and to publish them on their websites, as part of a broader push to curb mis-selling.

headline: UK's FCA pushes further insurance rule simplification, easing cross-border and disclosure burdens
summary: The Financial Conduct Authority published a new consultation proposing to narrow the territorial scope of its insurance conduct rules and strip out disclosure requirements it views as duplicative, continuing a broader effort to streamline regulation for insurers, intermediaries and MGAs.

headline: IRDAI chief says Bima Sugam marketplace will offer its first policies by September
summary: IRDAI chairman Ajay Seth said the long-awaited Bima Sugam digital insurance marketplace will launch initial motor, health and term products by end-September, with a separate consultation on distribution reforms due by end-July.

headline: NatWest finalizes £2.7B Evelyn Partners buy, creating UK's biggest wealth manager
summary: NatWest completed its acquisition of Evelyn Partners, combining Evelyn's £69 billion in assets under management with NatWest's £59 billion private banking book to form a roughly £127 billion combined wealth platform.

headline: Startup Corgi Launches AI-Native Platform to Speed Up Insurance Claims
summary: Insurtech Corgi unveiled a new AI-driven platform designed to accelerate claims handling end-to-end for insurers.

headline: EZLynx Adds Real-Time Commercial Quoting Directly Into Agent Workflow
summary: EZLynx launched Instant Commercial Quoting, surfacing real-time carrier quotes for general liability, BOP and workers' comp inside the submission workflow without a separate rater or portal, powered by the Ivans Distribution Platform.

headline: Empower to absorb Milliman's retirement recordkeeping arm in $340 million deal
summary: Empower agreed to buy Milliman's retirement and benefits administration business, picking up roughly 1,100 defined-contribution plans and 400 defined-benefit plans covering more than $130 billion in combined assets, while Milliman keeps its actuarial consulting unit.

summary: Savant closed a partnership with South Portland-based Richard Brothers Financial Advisors, adding about $240 million in client assets and giving the RIA its first Maine office among 70 locations nationwide.

summary: The acquisition folds Eazy Digital's client base and Bangkok team into Igloo, with its founder becoming Igloo's Thailand country head, extending Igloo's push into Southeast Asian digital distribution amid regional insurance reform.

summary: After outbidding a rival offer from Victory Capital, Trian Fund Management and General Catalyst completed their take-private acquisition of Janus Henderson at $52 per share, delisting the asset manager from the NYSE.

summary: The US cyber insurance market logged an eighth straight quarter of pricing cuts even as third-party claims rose roughly 30%, a trend likely to pressure loss ratios given the longer tail on such claims.

summary: Two of the largest wealth-management M&A deals in years closed within weeks of each other, with LPL Financial absorbing roughly 2,900 advisors and $285 billion in assets from Commonwealth Financial Network, while Osaic picked up Boston-based RIA platform CW Advisors and its $13.5 billion book.

summary: FIS Global Retirement is rolling out a new AI-enabled, cloud-based recordkeeping platform this July that unifies its legacy Omni and Relius systems, which together serve 650 clients and 68 million participants.

summary: Wisconsin's Department of Employee Trust Funds implemented a one-time reset of annuity-deducted health and life insurance premiums for WRS retirees in July 2026 ahead of full payment-schedule alignment in August.

summary: The national RIA absorbed 88-year-old New York advisory firm Shufro-Glass Group in a roughly $760 million deal, pushing its total client assets above $157 billion.

headline: Global Reinsurance Capital Hits Record $790 Billion, Tilting Leverage to Buyers
summary: A surge in traditional and alternative capital pushed global reinsurer capital to an all-time high heading into the mid-year renewals, strengthening cedents' negotiating position on price and terms.

headline: California's Insurance Chief Wins Court Fight Over Market-Stabilization Bulletins
summary: A Los Angeles judge rejected a Consumer Watchdog lawsuit challenging Commissioner Ricardo Lara's bulletins limiting how much FAIR Plan wildfire losses insurers can pass on to policyholders, upholding his stabilization approach.

summary: Amwins Specialty Casualty Solutions acquired Jackson-Lloyd, a pioneer in non-subscriber occupational accident programs for Texas employers, adding to its accident and health portfolio.

summary: Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey began accepting proposals on July 1, 2026 for its HealthEZ third-party administration platform targeting mid-sized self-funded employers, with plans taking effect January 1, 2027.

headline: CMS Launches Medicare GLP-1 Bridge Offering $50 Weight-Loss Drug Copay
summary: CMS's new Medicare GLP-1 Bridge took effect July 1, 2026, giving eligible Part D beneficiaries with qualifying conditions access to drugs like Zepbound and Wegovy for a flat $50 monthly copay through the end of 2027.

summary: A growing number of hospitals and health systems are dropping certain Medicare Advantage contracts in 2026, citing persistent prior-authorization denials and slow reimbursement from payers.

summary: Independence Health System's Butler Memorial Hospital is on track to join WVU Medicine this fall under a merger agreement that includes an $800 million capital investment, with $165 million earmarked specifically for Butler's facilities.

summary: Aon's midyear renewal report shows global reinsurance capital hit an all-time high of $790 billion as of March 31, 2026, driving property-catastrophe price cuts of up to 25% for top-performing accounts.

summary: India's insurance regulator is letting insurers sell three-to-five-year health policies with continuity benefits like waiting-period carry-forward, as insurers such as ICICI Lombard urge customers toward higher sum-insured coverage.

summary: The Cigna Group elevated President and COO Brian Evanko to succeed David Cordani as chief executive effective July 1, 2026, with Evanko also joining the company's board.

summary: Governor Hochul directed the state's Department of Financial Services to issue new guidance implementing FY2027 budget reforms intended to lower New York auto insurance rates and crack down on fraudulent claims, effective July 1.

summary: As Heritage Valley Health System formally joined Allegheny Health Network on July 1, insurer parent Highmark and the merging systems jointly committed roughly $285 million over a decade to fund clinical and IT upgrades, underscoring how payer-provider capital is intertwined in the deal.

summary: About 450,000 New Yorkers, largely lawfully present immigrants, lost Essential Plan coverage as of July 1 after federal budget law changes eliminated their ACA subsidy eligibility, pushing them onto marketplace plans with premiums and cost-sharing.

summary: Moffitt Cancer Center became out-of-network for Humana Medicare Advantage PPO and HMO plans starting July 1, forcing Tampa-area cancer patients to weigh higher out-of-pocket costs or switch coverage, though Humana may extend continuity-of-care exceptions through year-end.

headline: Lemonade trims reinsurance cession again in latest July renewal
summary: Lemonade reduced its quota-share cession to roughly 18% of premium from about 20% in its July 1, 2026 reinsurance renewal, a smaller adjustment than last year's steep cut, while expanding its European catastrophe protection.

headline: MemorialCare's longtime CEO Barry Arbuckle steps up to executive chairman
summary: After more than two decades leading MemorialCare, Barry Arbuckle moved into a new executive chairman role effective July 1, 2026, with Dr. David Kim succeeding him as president and CEO in a long-planned succession.

summary: MassMutual announced it rose to No. 100 on the 2026 Fortune 500 list, extending a streak of more than three decades on the ranking as the mutual insurer marks 175 years in business.

summary: A preview of Vanguard's forthcoming How America Saves 2026 report suggests automatic enrollment and auto-escalation features are pushing account balances to new highs despite market volatility.

summary: AXA is weighing continued insurance business expansion against its longer-horizon investment strategy as it navigates a shifting rate and asset-allocation environment.

summary: Insurers filed proposed 2027 ACA marketplace premiums by the July 15 deadline, with most payers requesting increases in the 10-20% range, setting up another round of affordability debate ahead of open enrollment.

headline: Express Scripts becomes first major PBM to settle with FTC over insulin pricing practices
summary: Cigna's Express Scripts settled FTC allegations that it inflated insulin costs through secretive manufacturer deals, agreeing to eliminate spread pricing and delink compensation from drug list prices ahead of 2027 reforms.

headline: AI in APAC healthcare enters a new phase in 2026
summary: Asia-Pacific health systems are moving beyond pilot-stage AI deployments in 2026, with broader adoption of clinical decision support and imaging tools across the region's hospitals, per Healthcare IT News.

headline: 27% of health systems now hold commercial AI licenses to ease clinical workload
summary: A new survey finds 27% of U.S. health systems have signed commercial AI licenses aimed at reducing clinician workload, part of a broader push to integrate predictive AI tools with electronic health records.

headline: Health IT vendors roll out new radiology and nursing documentation AI tools
summary: A July 2026 health IT product roundup highlights new AI radiology draft-reporting tools designed to integrate with existing systems without platform migrations, alongside expanded ambient documentation tools for inpatient nursing workflows.

headline: Europe's largest pension asset manager names its first female CEO
summary: Alineke van den Berge-Blindenbach, previously APG Asset Management's chief operating officer, became CEO effective July 1, 2026, succeeding Ronald Wuijster after serving as interim chief since March.

headline: Nontraded BDCs hand investors nearly $6 billion in liquidity in Q2
summary: Sponsors of nontraded net-asset-value business development companies returned close to $5.9 billion to investors in the second quarter of 2026, showing continued demand for private-credit liquidity vehicles even with rates still elevated.

headline: Zurich pushes into European life sciences insurance market
summary: Zurich Insurance Group is rolling out a dedicated life sciences insurance line across key European markets starting July 2026, extending capabilities it has already built up in the United States.

headline: Colorado forces insurers to reveal the wildfire scores behind home insurance pricing
summary: A new Colorado law taking effect July 1, 2026 requires insurers that use wildfire or catastrophe risk models to disclose scores to homeowners, credit mitigation work in pricing, and offer a formal appeals process for disputed scores.

headline: Australia's 'Payday Super' and higher contribution caps take effect
summary: New rules starting July 1, 2026 require Australian employers to pay superannuation contributions with every payroll cycle rather than quarterly, alongside increased concessional and non-concessional contribution caps and a higher transfer balance cap for retirees.

headline: Trump Accounts launch with advisors still short on guidance
summary: The new child savings vehicle known as Trump Accounts opened to contributions on July 4, 2026, but financial planners say unresolved rules on fees, Roth conversions and financial-aid treatment make it hard to advise clients on how the accounts compare to 529 plans.

headline: Insurance broker software market valued at $1.96B in 2026 as AI reshapes servicing
summary: The insurance broker technology market is growing at a 7.9% CAGR as AI raises the capability floor for lead qualification, quote turnaround, client servicing and renewals.

headline: ACA marketplace premiums set for steepest jump since 2018 as enhanced subsidies lapse
summary: Insurers are proposing a median 18% rate increase for 2026 ACA marketplace plans as enhanced premium tax credits expire, a change expected to more than double what subsidized enrollees pay out of pocket and shrink enrollment by up to 4.8 million people.

headline: CMS finalizes 2026 Medicare Advantage and Part D payment updates, raising plan payments 5.06%
summary: CMS's final Calendar Year 2026 rate announcement increases average payments to Medicare Advantage plans while average monthly premiums are expected to fall slightly to about $14, with supplemental benefits holding stable.

headline: July property reinsurance renewals soften further as capital keeps flowing in
summary: Guy Carpenter reported that abundant reinsurance capital pushed July 1 property renewals toward double-digit rate reductions, continuing a cedent-favorable trend from mid-year renewals.

headline: US P&C insurers post $15.8B underwriting gain in Q1 2026, reversing year-ago loss
summary: Private US property/casualty insurers swung to a first-quarter underwriting profit of $15.8 billion, a sharp reversal from an $864 million underwriting loss in the same period last year.

headline: Prudential adopts Hueler Income Solutions to add a 'personal pension' option to its own 401(k)
summary: Prudential Insurance Company of America began offering Hueler's Income Solutions platform inside its own retirement savings plan, letting participants convert a portion of savings into a self-funded annuity-based income stream.

headline: Orion becomes one of the first wealthtech firms to earn ISO/IEC 42001 AI-management certification
summary: The portfolio accounting provider passed an independent audit of the AI Management System governing its Denali AI layer, joining a small group of roughly 100-150 organizations worldwide with the AI governance certification.

headline: US RIA M&A already tops $100 billion in deal volume in 2026
summary: Registered investment advisor dealmaking is running at a record pace this year, with private equity-backed consolidators and mid-market mergers driving volume well past the $100 billion mark before mid-year.

headline: Wealth Enhancement to absorb 88-year-old New York advisory dynasty Shufro-Glass in $760M deal
summary: Wealth Enhancement agreed to acquire the Shufro-Glass Group of Shufro Rose, adding more than $760 million in client assets and pushing the national RIA's total client assets above $157 billion once the deal closes in August.

headline: India Extends New NPS Investment Options to Central Autonomous Body Employees
summary: The Indian government widened National Pension System investment choices, including a Life Cycle-75 High option and an Aggressive Life Cycle Fund, to employees of central autonomous bodies, letting subscribers pick strategies matched to their risk appetite and retirement horizon.

headline: Korea's National Pension Service Pivots From Fund Commitments to Direct Deals
summary: South Korea's National Pension Service is reducing reliance on blind-pool fund commitments in favor of direct real estate investments and club deals, reflecting a broader trend among large APAC retirement funds toward greater control over capital deployment.

headline: Pay-per-mile MGA Mile Auto buys 60-year-old agency partner Insurance House
summary: Tech-enabled auto MGA Mile Auto acquired Georgia-based Insurance House, combining AI-driven, mileage-based underwriting with six decades of independent-agency relationships to create a nearly $100 million premium platform across 10 states.

headline: Digital health funding enters a 'maturity era' in H1 2026 with fewer, bigger deals
summary: Galen Growth's H1 2026 digital health report finds capital increasingly concentrated in fewer, larger growth-stage rounds rather than spread across early-stage startups, alongside rising M&A exit value even as deal counts fell.

headline: MemorialCare taps new CEO as 24-year chief becomes executive chairman
summary: Longtime MemorialCare CEO Barry Arbuckle moved into the role of executive chairman effective July 1, handing the chief executive title to President David Kim after leading the Fountain Valley, California system for 24 years.

headline: NAIC research arm examines how AI is reshaping insurance regulation
summary: The NAIC's Center for Insurance Policy and Research hosted a webinar dissecting a new academic paper on artificial intelligence and insurance regulation, part of the association's continued scrutiny of insurer AI and big-data use.

headline: India's wealth management industry eyes $1.7 trillion by 2030 even as fiduciary advisor supply stays thin
summary: India's asset and wealth management market is projected to nearly double by 2030 on retail financialization and digital infrastructure, but the country still has fewer than 1,000 SEBI-registered investment advisors serving over 200 million investors.

headline: Gallagher's Risk Placement Services acquires Kansas MGA Med James
summary: Arthur J. Gallagher's wholesale brokerage unit Risk Placement Services acquired Med James, an Overland Park, Kansas-based managing general agency and wholesale broker focused on commercial and personal lines property/casualty risks.

headline: Marsh names UK chief claims officer as Aon appoints new EMEA co-CEO
summary: Marsh appointed Helen Haggie as UK chief claims officer for Marsh Risk effective July 20, while Aon named Tracy-Lee Kus as one of its new co-chief executives for Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

headline: ACA marketplace premiums jumped 58% in 2026 after enhanced subsidies expired
summary: Average ACA marketplace premiums rose 58% in 2026 as more generous pandemic-era subsidies lapsed, pushing more consumers into high-deductible bronze plans as total enrollment fell by 1.2 million to 23.1 million people.

headline: CMS finalizes 2026 rule strengthening Medicare Advantage prior-authorization protections
summary: CMS's 2026 final rule requires Medicare Advantage plans to issue prior-authorization decisions within 72 hours for expedited requests and seven calendar days for standard requests, while also clarifying appeals processes for enrollees.

headline: Indian parliamentary panel calls for doubling Ayushman Bharat coverage to ₹10 lakh
summary: A parliamentary standing committee recommended raising the coverage cap under India's Ayushman Bharat public health insurance scheme from ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh per family, citing the rising cost of complex procedures like organ transplants and cancer treatment.

headline: Hospital and private-equity M&A activity expected to keep rising through 2026
summary: Hospital dealmaking is on track to accelerate further in 2026, with private equity playing a growing role alongside traditional health system mergers even as reimbursement and drug-pricing policy uncertainty persists.

headline: Insurtech Openly secures growth funding and expands Allianz Re reinsurance partnership
summary: Homeowners insurtech Openly, which sells exclusively through independent agents, closed a growth funding round led by existing backers with new participation from Allianz X, alongside an expanded long-term reinsurance agreement with Allianz Re.

headline: Insurtech Pace raises $46 million Series B for AI-driven insurance operations
summary: Pace closed a $46 million Series B round to expand its AI agents for policy servicing, claims processing, renewals and submissions, adding to a wave of 2026 funding concentrated in AI-native insurance automation startups.

headline: Catastrophe bond market hits record $65.6 billion outstanding after blockbuster second quarter
summary: Total catastrophe bond and related insurance-linked securities issuance topped $16.1 billion year-to-date in 2026, with second-quarter issuance alone exceeding $11.3 billion across 48 transactions, pushing the outstanding market to a new high.

headline: Manulife overhauls executive leadership team, names Patrick Graham CEO of Manulife Canada
summary: Manulife Financial restructured its executive leadership team, appointing Patrick Graham as President and CEO of Manulife Canada as part of a broader realignment of senior roles across the insurer.

headline: Global reinsurance capital reaches $790 billion even as premium growth stays muted
summary: Aon's mid-year Reinsurance Market Dynamics report finds industry capital hit a record $790 billion, but premium growth of just over 1% highlights a widening imbalance between abundant capacity and softer demand.

headline: Reinsurers show more flexibility on structure and price at July 1 renewals
summary: Gallagher Re reports that reinsurers offered greater flexibility on contract structures and pricing at the mid-year renewal, as record capital continued to soften property catastrophe rates across most regions.

headline: Zurich launches dedicated life sciences insurance product across nine European countries
summary: Zurich is rolling out a specialist life sciences insurance product covering Belgium, Denmark, France, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and the UK, joining Markel and QBE in a specialty segment brokers say few insurers fully understand.

headline: Target-date funds with built-in retirement income features surpass $100 billion
summary: Assets in target-date funds that embed guaranteed or systematic retirement-income features crossed $100 billion, as more defined-contribution plan sponsors adopt income-generating default options for near-retirees.

headline: RIA M&A on pace to set a new full-year record in 2026, Echelon projects
summary: Echelon's newly published RIA and Wealth Management M&A Multiples Report projects full-year 2026 deal volume will reach roughly 475 transactions, edging past 2025's record of 466 as consolidation among independent advisory firms continues.

headline: Cigna completes CEO handoff as Evanko takes the reins from longtime chief Cordani
summary: The Cigna Group's leadership transition became effective, with President and COO Brian Evanko formally stepping into the CEO role while David Cordani, who led the company for nearly 17 years, moved into the executive chairman position after a multi-year succession plan.

headline: Highmark-owned Allegheny Health Network finalizes takeover of two Pennsylvania hospitals
summary: Allegheny Health Network completed its acquisition of Heritage Valley Health System's two acute-care hospitals in southwestern Pennsylvania, expanding the Highmark Health-owned network to 16 full-service inpatient facilities as the newly acquired sites are rebranded under the AHN name.

headline: MemorialCare completes long-planned leadership succession after 24-year CEO tenure
summary: California health system MemorialCare moved longtime CEO Barry Arbuckle into a new executive chairman role and elevated President David Kim to chief executive, capping a multi-year succession process the outgoing leader initiated with the board years in advance.

headline: Italy switches on immediate automatic pension enrollment for new hires
summary: As of July 1, Italy replaced its old six-month opt-in delay with automatic enrollment of newly hired private-sector workers into supplementary pension funds starting on their hire date, giving them 60 days to opt out instead.

headline: Select Medical goes private in $3.9 billion insider-led buyout
summary: A consortium led by Select Medical's own executive chairman alongside private equity firm Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe completed a take-private deal valuing the specialty hospital operator at about $3.9 billion, delisting it from the NYSE.

headline: Lloyd's spells out 2026 supervisory priorities as it pushes a capital-efficiency strategy
summary: Lloyd's of London outlined its market oversight priorities for 2026, including new credit-risk codes for the year of account and an updated realistic disaster scenario data collection, as the marketplace executes a five-year strategy centered on underwriting discipline and returns.

headline: UK clears the way for savers to be moved into collective pension schemes without asking first
summary: New regulations taking effect July 31, 2026 let UK defined-contribution pension benefits be transferred into authorised collective defined contribution (CDC) schemes without individual member consent, alongside rules enabling new multi-employer CDC arrangements.

headline: AI-powered MGA Mile Auto acquires The Insurance House
summary: Mile Auto, a pay-per-mile auto insurance MGA, acquired agency The Insurance House effective July 1, creating a combined operation with nearly $100 million in annual premium serving over 55,000 policyholders across roughly 1,600 agencies.

headline: India's insurers begin transition to new Ind AS accounting standards
summary: India's insurance sector started moving to new Ind AS accounting rules mandated by IRDAI for greater reporting transparency; standalone health insurers adopted the framework first, while LIC and major life and general insurers secured a one-year exemption.

headline: PLANSPONSOR's 2026 recordkeeping survey finds service model shifting as plans expand beyond savings
summary: Recordkeepers face continued fee compression even as sponsors demand more technology, participant advice and financial wellness tools, with 403(b) plans in particular requiring specialized multi-vendor compliance support.

headline: Reinsurance property rates fall up to 25% at July renewals as capital base hits $790 billion
summary: Record capital inflows and a quieter 2025 hurricane season drove some of the steepest reinsurance property rate declines in decades at the July 1 renewal date, easing costs for primary insurers.

headline: Canadian ETF assets cross $100 billion mark earlier than ever in first half of 2026
summary: Canada's ETF industry reached $104 billion in year-to-date asset growth by the end of June, the earliest the market has ever crossed the $100 billion threshold in a given year.

headline: RIA consolidators expect deal valuations to flatten through second half of 2026
summary: A new survey finds 82% of RIA acquirers expect valuations to hold steady rather than climb further, with firms managing $1-5 billion in assets remaining the most sought-after acquisition targets.

headline: Agentic AI adoption accelerates among RIAs, though usage still trails wirehouses
summary: A recent survey found roughly a quarter of advisory firms have no agentic AI in use at all, while others already have agents in production, with adoption still far higher among captive wirehouse and bank advisors than independent RIAs.

headline: Morgan Stanley unifies wealth and institutional units under new RIA-focused offering
summary: Morgan Stanley repositioned services under an Integrated Firm for RIAs and Family Offices initiative, combining its investment management and institutional equities divisions to better compete for outside advisory relationships.

headline: APAC wealth management market projected to reach $41.8 trillion by 2031
summary: The Asia-Pacific wealth management market is forecast to grow from roughly $29.6 trillion in 2026 to $41.8 trillion by 2031, with India's HNW population expected to grow faster than any other major APAC market through 2030.

headline: Hanover Insurance names COO Richard Lavey as CEO-elect ahead of 2026 succession
summary: Hanover Insurance Group said CEO John Roche will retire December 31, 2026, with current COO Richard Lavey named CEO-elect as the P&C insurer plans a phased leadership transition through investor updates later this year.

headline: Sedgwick, Crawford and CorVel cement AI-led lead in $544.7 billion global TPA market
summary: A new market analysis frames insurance third-party administration as a $544.67 billion global industry increasingly dominated by AI-equipped incumbents Sedgwick, Crawford & Company and CorVel Corp.

headline: Zywave launches Apex, an AI-native growth stack built for insurance distribution
summary: The insurance broker technology specialist introduced Zywave Apex, aimed at speeding up quoting, sharpening account intelligence and giving agencies clearer pipeline visibility across the front office.

headline: Global insurtech funding tops $1.54 billion year-to-date as AI captures 95% of capital
summary: Insurtech funding through the year's first stretch has already outpaced all of 2025's comparable period, though two large rounds alone account for roughly 60% of the total, underscoring how concentrated the recovery remains.

headline: Gyde raises $60 million as insurtech funding concentrates in a handful of AI-native mega-deals
summary: Newly launched insurance startup Gyde raised $60 million in funding, part of a broader 2026 pattern in which the top five insurtech deals have captured the large majority of all capital raised.

headline: India's health insurers post record premium collections after GST exemption on individual policies
summary: General insurers collected roughly Rs 1.24 lakh crore in health insurance premiums over eleven months of the current fiscal year, the industry's highest-ever total, following September 2025's GST exemption on individual health policies.

headline: Bristol NHS Foundation Trust launches as one of the UK's biggest health trusts after merger
summary: University Hospitals Bristol and Weston NHS Foundation Trust merged with a neighboring trust on July 1 to form the new Bristol NHS Foundation Trust, creating an organization with about 28,000 staff and roughly £2.6 billion in annual turnover.

headline: Medicare Advantage penetration holds at 55% as UnitedHealth, Humana dominate
summary: More than half of eligible Medicare beneficiaries are now enrolled in Medicare Advantage, with UnitedHealth Group and Humana together accounting for 46% of all MA enrollees, while special-needs-plan offerings keep expanding.

headline: EIOPA locks in new proportionality framework under revised Solvency II
summary: Europe's insurance regulator held an event marking the new proportionality framework under the revised Solvency II Directive, part of a broader rules package covering liquidity risk, group solvency and disclosure due to apply from January 2027.

headline: IRDAI signals commission-reform paper to curb insurance mis-selling
summary: India's insurance regulator is preparing a consultation paper, expected by end of July, that would spread agent and distributor commissions across a policy's full term instead of paying them upfront, mirroring practices in the US, UK and Europe.

headline: Asia-Pacific non-life premium growth seen cooling to 2.5% in 2026
summary: Non-life insurance premium growth across Asia-Pacific is forecast to slow to 2.5% in 2026 from 2.9% in 2024, while life premium growth is expected to improve to 1.1% after a negative 2024.

headline: Vestmark's outsourced RIA platform grows fivefold to $50 billion
summary: Vestmark Advisory Services' assets under management jumped from $10 billion to $50 billion in 18 months, helped by referral ties with BlackRock, T. Rowe Price and Capital Group and the launch of an AI portfolio-monitoring tool called Vestmark Pulse.

headline: Sanford Health and Marshfield Clinic complete $10 billion Midwest hospital merger
summary: Sanford Health and Marshfield Clinic Health System finished their merger less than six months after announcing it, forming a $10 billion nonprofit system spanning 56 hospitals, 4,500 providers and nearly 56,000 employees across the rural Midwest.

headline: UK Insurtech Investment Hits £4.2 Billion as London Market Shows Resilience
summary: UK-focused insurtech investment reportedly reached a record £4.2 billion in 2026, with Series B funding rounds up 12% year-on-year, underscoring London's continued pull as a hub for insurance technology capital.

headline: Medicare Advantage plan menu shrinks even as enrollment keeps climbing
summary: A KFF analysis updated for July shows Medicare Advantage now covers 55% of eligible beneficiaries even though the number of available plans nationwide fell about 9% year over year, while federal per-person payments to plans rose roughly 14%, adding tens of billions in program spending.

headline: Smaller Indian cities overtake metros as the growth engine for high-value health cover
summary: Distribution data shows Tier-3 cities now account for over 41% of unlimited sum-insured health policy purchases in the current fiscal year, surpassing Tier-1 metros whose share has fallen sharply from roughly half of such sales two years ago, signaling a demand shift toward smaller-city buyers.

headline: On-body computing patch flags dangerous heart arrhythmias without cloud processing
summary: Researchers at the University of Chicago have built a flexible wearable patch that detects life-threatening arrhythmias with roughly 99.6% accuracy while processing all data locally on the body rather than sending it to the cloud, illustrating a broader shift of clinical-grade AI toward the point of care.

headline: Australia's superannuation overhaul takes effect, raising caps and taxing large balances
summary: From July 1, 2026, Australia's concessional super contribution cap rose to A$32,500 and a new Division 296 tax began applying extra levies of 15-25% on earnings tied to balances above A$3 million, reshaping retirement savings strategy.

headline: UK Regulator Debuts Annual Insurance Priorities Report, Pledges to Simplify Rules While Guarding Consumers
summary: The Financial Conduct Authority issued its first annual regulatory priorities report for insurers, consolidating prior guidance and emphasizing protection of vulnerable consumers, better claims handling, and a push to cut regulatory complexity while still supporting sector growth and innovation.

headline: Life insurers head into second half of 2026 favoring quiet block and reinsurance deals over big mergers
summary: Industry analysts expect life and annuity M&A to stay measured through the rest of 2026, with closed-block transactions, reinsurance arrangements and distribution-driven deals dominating rather than large-scale carrier mergers.

headline: US pension risk transfer deals grow in number but shrink in size as funding surpluses persist
summary: LIMRA data shows the first half of 2026 was marked by a rising count of smaller defined-benefit buy-in transactions even as total US pension risk transfer deal volume edged lower, with insurers still expecting strong appetite for the rest of the year.

headline: P&C insurers' book yields hit decade high in 2025 even as income growth cools
summary: Property-casualty insurers' portfolio book yield climbed to a ten-year high of 4.39% in 2025, though net investment income as a share of invested assets slipped modestly from its 2024 peak as reinvestment rates began to normalize.

headline: Global insurer invested assets climb to $9.6 trillion as insurers keep pivoting toward private markets
summary: A Goldman Sachs Asset Management survey finds US insurers' cash and invested assets grew 6.7% year-over-year to $9.6 trillion at the end of 2025, with respondents expecting continued rotation into private credit and asset-backed finance for incremental yield.

headline: Property reinsurance rates fall as much as 25% at July renewals on record capital
summary: Abundant reinsurance capital pushed property catastrophe rates down as much as 25% at the July 1 renewal, with Guy Carpenter's global property rate-on-line index posting its steepest annual decline since the late 1990s.

headline: American Growth Insurance raises $70 million to acquire and rebuild US brokerages with AI
summary: Tech-forward brokerage growth platform American Growth Insurance raised $70 million in committed equity led by Atomic and Rockbridge Growth Equity, aiming to close several more independent agency acquisitions and rebuild their operations around AI agents.

headline: Fulcrum raises $25 million to scale AI automation across US insurance brokers
summary: Fulcrum raised $25 million in seed and Series A funding led by CRV to expand its AI platform for insurance brokers, which automates proposal creation, policy checks and coverage comparisons and has cut policy delivery timelines from 15 days to same-day.

headline: Health insurers propose median 14% premium increases across ACA exchanges for 2027
summary: Insurers in 16 states and Washington, D.C. have proposed a median 14% premium increase for next year's ACA exchange plans, citing rising healthcare costs and the scheduled expiration of enhanced federal subsidies.

headline: Sutter Health and Allina Health sign definitive deal to form $26 billion nonprofit system
summary: Sacramento-based Sutter Health signed a definitive agreement to acquire Minneapolis-based Allina Health, creating a combined 39-hospital, $26 billion nonprofit system spanning California, Minnesota and Wisconsin, with Sutter committing $2 billion to Allina's home markets.

headline: UK trustees navigate a wave of new pension rules taking effect this summer
summary: Following Royal Assent of the Pension Schemes Act 2026, UK trustees and schemes are now implementing a value-for-money framework for defined contribution schemes, small pot consolidation rules, and new collective defined contribution transfer regulations coming into force in late July.

headline: Singapore convenes regional leaders to showcase next-wave clinical AI deployment
summary: Smart Health Asia 2026 drew thousands of attendees and executives from major Singaporean hospitals to spotlight how digital-health tools are moving from pilot projects to everyday clinical use across the region.

headline: Cigna hands CEO reins to Brian Evanko as Cordani steps back
summary: The Cigna Group installed President and COO Brian Evanko as CEO effective July 1, 2026, while longtime chief executive David Cordani moved into an executive chairman role.

headline: Benefits and health TPAs trading at 5x-7x EBITDA as buyer appetite holds
summary: Mid-sized benefits and health third-party administrators generating $750,000 to $2 million in EBITDA are currently being underwritten at roughly 5x to 7x multiples, reflecting steady acquirer demand for recurring-fee TPA businesses.

headline: Severe convective storms overtake hurricanes as costliest US insured weather peril
