headline: YC-backed Klaimee lands $5.5M to insure autonomous AI agents
summary: Klaimee raised a $5.5 million seed round led by FundersClub to build insurance-backed performance warranties for autonomous AI agents, with Y Combinator, Robinhood Ventures and a group of angels also participating.

headline: Hospital executives urged to take direct ownership of clinical AI governance
summary: A STAT commentary argues hospital CEOs and boards must take direct accountability for AI governance, warning that oversight and clinician accountability will determine whether AI strengthens or undermines patient trust as adoption accelerates.

headline: Federato report finds 64-point gap between P&C leadership and underwriters on real-time risk visibility
summary: Federato's 2026 State of P&C Insurance Technology report found 91% of P&C leaders believe they have real-time portfolio control, but only 27% of underwriters agree, with fully AI-integrated insurers 3.6 times more likely to actually have that visibility.

headline: Creative Planning expands into commercial insurance with Lovell acquisition
summary: The $710 billion RIA Creative Planning acquired Kansas City-area commercial insurance brokerage Lovell Insurance Group, continuing a run of specialized acquisitions that bring tax, legal and risk-management services under one roof.

headline: Insurance agency M&A hits slowest first half since 2016
summary: OPTIS Partners counted 292 U.S. and Canadian insurance agency deals in the first half of 2026, down 15% year over year and the weakest first-half tally in a decade, though dealmakers see the pace nearing a bottom.

headline: Goosehead Insurance CEO Mark Miller to retire at year-end
summary: Goosehead Insurance disclosed that founder-era chief executive Mark Miller will step down as CEO effective December 31, 2026, as the personal-lines distribution firm plans its next leadership phase.

headline: Ambient AI scribes gain traction as a fix for clinician burnout
summary: Health systems are expanding ambient AI documentation tools well beyond early pilots, with reported burnout reductions of 20-30 percentage points at some organizations, even as costs of $100-$600 per provider per month keep return-on-investment questions open.

headline: Gallagher brings in dedicated Nordics deal-insurance lead as its M&A practice grows
summary: Broking giant Gallagher hired Gabriella Eriksen Wingren, previously of EQT and PwC Sweden, to head transaction solutions for the Nordics within its private equity and M&A practice, adding dedicated warranty-and-indemnity expertise as the region's deal activity picks up.

headline: Lloyd's unveils "Accelerate 2030" AI strategy as London market races to keep pace
summary: Lloyd's launched a market-wide AI strategy and adoption toolkit to help managing agents build governance frameworks for artificial intelligence, part of a broader push among the UK's largest financial institutions to deploy AI faster.

headline: EIOPA presses private equity buyers to prove long-term commitment to policyholders
summary: Europe's insurance watchdog said private equity firms seeking to acquire European insurers must demonstrate they can support policyholders long-term rather than pursue quick-profit exits, as PE-backed insurer deals draw more regulatory scrutiny.

headline: Human Interest launches AI-powered compliance guarantee for 401(k) plan sponsors
summary: The retirement platform's new tool proactively evaluates payroll and recordkeeping data against core compliance metrics, giving plan administrators real-time health indicators in their employer dashboard.

headline: Neal and Wyden introduce bill cracking down on outsized 'mega' retirement accounts
summary: House Ways and Means Ranking Member Richard Neal and Senator Ron Wyden introduced legislation aimed at curbing unusually large IRA and retirement-account balances, part of a broader push on retirement-savings fairness.

headline: CNBC names One Inc among top 500 global fintech companies for third straight year
summary: One Inc, a digital payments network built for the insurance industry's premium and claims disbursement workflows, was recognized in the Payments category of CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026 list, developed with Statista.

headline: DOL proposal would open 401(k) plans to private-market investments
summary: A new Department of Labor proposal would let 401(k) fiduciaries add private-market investments to plan lineups, setting out 'safe harbor' steps for selecting such alternatives, building on the direction SECURE 2.0 had already signaled.

headline: WealthTech funding cools sharply in Q2 2026 after blockbuster Q1
summary: US WealthTech funding fell about 62% quarter-over-quarter to roughly $932 million in Q2 2026 even as the US kept about 54% of global deal share, with Germany's Bunch raising a $35 million Series B among the period's larger rounds.

headline: HSBC offloads Singapore life and health insurance arm to Allianz for $2.1B
summary: HSBC agreed to sell its Singapore life and health insurance business to Allianz for roughly $2.1 billion, moving to a capital-light bancassurance model as it refocuses on wealth and wholesale banking in Asia.

headline: India's hospital chains post double-digit growth but margins tighten
summary: An EY-Parthenon analysis found major Indian hospital chains grew revenue and EBITDA more than 15% year-on-year in FY26, even as aggressive bed-capacity expansion squeezed operating margins across the sector.

headline: Globe Life lifts 2026 guidance after 7% Q2 revenue growth and stronger health premiums
summary: Globe Life reported second-quarter sales up 6.7% year over year to $1.6 billion, with health premium climbing 16% on strength at United American, prompting the insurer to raise its full-year earnings guidance.

headline: Mapfre to acquire Safety Insurance for $1.54 billion
summary: Spain's Mapfre agreed to acquire Massachusetts-based Safety Insurance for $1.54 billion in cash, with Safety shareholders set to receive $105 per share, a 44% premium to the pre-announcement stock price.

headline: Fixed annuity rates climb toward 7% as carriers compete for retirement savers
summary: Top fixed annuity rates reached as high as 6.80% on seven-year terms in late July, with Knighthead Life among carriers offering the most competitive guaranteed rates to income-seeking retirees.

headline: Mapfre to acquire Safety Insurance Group for $1.54 billion, creating a New England auto leader
summary: Safety Insurance Group agreed to an all-cash $1.54 billion acquisition by a Mapfre affiliate at $105 per share, a deal expected to create the second-largest private passenger auto insurer in New England.

headline: AllianceBernstein poaches AIA strategist to lead new APAC insurance solutions team
summary: The $905 billion asset manager hired David Luo from AIA Group as head of insurance solutions for Asia-Pacific, based in Hong Kong, to help insurers with asset allocation and capital-efficient portfolio strategies.

headline: Arax signs deal for $3 billion RIA Transcend Capital Advisors, its seventh 2026 acquisition
summary: Arax Advisory Partners agreed to acquire New Jersey-based Transcend Capital Advisors, a multi-state RIA founded by former NYSE CEO Duncan Niederauer, expanding Arax's national wealth platform with more than 1,000 client relationships.

headline: PFRDA Makes Pension Funds Liable for Third-Party Failures Under NPS
summary: India's pension regulator notified amended exit-and-withdrawal rules making pension funds accountable to subscribers for lapses by outside entities engaged to run specific-purpose schemes, alongside new regulatory-sandbox rules to test pension innovations.

headline: Global commercial insurance pricing keeps falling as soft market persists into Q2 2026
summary: Marsh's latest Global Insurance Market Index shows commercial rates declining again in the second quarter of 2026, extending a multi-quarter softening trend driven by abundant capacity, even as US casualty pricing continues to buck the downward trend.

headline: Bengaluru insurtech NeuralKart lands seed funding for AI underwriting tools
summary: NeuralKart, which builds AI-driven decision tools to automate underwriting, claims processing and industrial safety checks, raised a Rs 2.35 crore seed round led by Inflection Point Ventures.

headline: Insurers lean on agentic AI to rebuild underwriting and claims workflows
summary: A new industry report finds property and casualty insurers are increasingly adopting agentic AI to power decision-centric underwriting, claims and customer service operations, often via orchestration layers that connect the new tools with legacy policy administration systems.

headline: Globe Life lifts full-year profit guidance after broad-based Q2 underwriting gains
summary: Globe Life raised its 2026 earnings-per-share guidance after posting a 7% rise in total premium revenue for the second quarter, with life insurance underwriting margin outperforming and health premiums surging.

headline: Arax adds $3 billion RIA Transcend Capital Advisors in its seventh acquisition of 2026
summary: RedBird-backed aggregator Arax signed a definitive agreement to acquire Transcend Capital Advisors, a fiduciary-model RIA serving over 1,000 client relationships, continuing its run as one of the fastest-growing wealth platforms in the country.

headline: WellSky expands care-transition dashboards to 2,000 hospitals to curb discharge delays
summary: WellSky expanded its CarePort Care Transitions Dashboard Suite with new intelligence dashboards that give hospital and health-system teams real-time visibility into referral bottlenecks and discharge-performance benchmarks, drawing on a network spanning over 2,000 hospitals and 120,000 post-acute providers.

headline: Catastrophe reinsurance prices post steepest annual fall in 25 years
summary: Guy Carpenter's Global Property Catastrophe Rate-on-Line Index fell 16% year-over-year at the June and July renewals, the steepest annual decline in a quarter-century, as record reinsurer capital pressures pricing.

headline: India proposes first overhaul of insurance rules in nearly 90 years
summary: The Finance Ministry released draft Insurance Rules, 2026 to replace regulations dating to 1939, adding stricter agent requirements, clearer shareholding rules and greater product-disclosure transparency; a 30-day public comment period is open.

headline: European Insurtech Funding Tops €900 Million in First Half of 2026, UK Keeps Top Spot
summary: European insurtechs raised over €900 million in H1 2026, the strongest first-half total in recent years even as deal volume fell, with the UK leading in deal count and digital insurance brokers capturing the bulk of capital.

headline: Global commercial insurance rates fall for 8th straight quarter, Marsh finds
summary: Marsh's Q2 2026 Global Insurance Market Index recorded a 6% average decline in commercial insurance rates worldwide, with property down 12% and cyber down 4%, while U.S. casualty bucked the trend with a 7% increase amid persistent claims-cost pressure.

headline: Mapfre to acquire Safety Insurance Group in a $1.54 billion all-cash deal
summary: Massachusetts-based Safety Insurance agreed to be acquired by an affiliate of Spain's Mapfre for about $1.54 billion, or $105 per share in cash, after Safety reported second-quarter net income of $34.5 million.

headline: Insurtech Corgi reportedly raises again at $4 billion valuation, its third round in eight weeks
summary: AI-native startup carrier Corgi reportedly raised fresh capital at a $4 billion valuation, marking its third funding round in eight weeks as investors race to back full-stack insurance platforms built for startups.

headline: AI insurtech Corgi's valuation triples to $4B in third funding round in eight weeks
summary: San Francisco insurtech Corgi closed a second extension of its Series B at a $4 billion valuation, up from $2.6 billion three weeks earlier and $1.3 billion at the start of May, with the company reportedly on pace for a $450 million annualized revenue run rate by year-end.

headline: Insurance people moves: AIPSO names new CEO, Canopius taps HSBC exec as group COO
summary: Les Willis was named president and CEO of AIPSO succeeding a retiring 32-year veteran, while Canopius appointed an HSBC executive as group COO among a wave of other senior insurance leadership changes reported this week.

headline: Howden names new Japan natural-resources head and Australia aviation partner
summary: Howden appointed Junichiro Ito as head of natural resources for Japan and Elizabeth Antoine as a partner for aviation in Australia, part of a broader wave of APAC insurance broking leadership moves this week.

headline: Insurers Push AI Adoption Past Underwriting Into Service and Product Design
summary: A new GlobalData industry poll finds underwriting still tops the list of AI use cases for insurers, but its lead is narrowing as carriers increasingly apply AI to customer service and product development, pointing to broader enterprise-wide adoption.

headline: ACA marketplace enrollment set to plunge as premium subsidies shrink and the 'subsidy cliff' returns
summary: With enhanced pandemic-era premium tax credits expired, KFF projects effectuated ACA marketplace enrollment could fall to roughly 17.5 million people in 2026 from 22.3 million in 2025, driven largely by middle-income shoppers now facing the return of an income cap on subsidy eligibility and average monthly premium payments up around 58%.

headline: Advisor software makers push AI planning agents further into daily workflows
summary: Wealthtech vendors rolled out new AI tools in quick succession, including Altruist's forthcoming 'Hazel' agent meant to shrink an 18-hour financial-planning process to minutes and RightCapital's 'Iris' assistant that flags data gaps, while Orion became one of the first wealthtech firms certified under the ISO/IEC 42001 AI-management standard.

headline: RIA M&A activity shatters records with first-half deal count up nearly 40% year over year
summary: Independent RIA consolidation is accelerating in 2026 as private-equity-backed acquirers and roll-ups compete for scale, with deal volume in the first half already approaching 40% above last year's pace.

headline: Cigna raises 2026 earnings outlook after employer-plan profits jump on premium hikes
summary: Cigna's employer-sponsored plan segment delivered stronger-than-expected profit in the second quarter after premium increases, leading the insurer to raise its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to at least $30.45, joining peers in a beat-and-raise quarter.

headline: AIPSO names Les Willis president and CEO as Charles Kwolek retires after 32 years
summary: The Automobile Insurance Plans Service Office promoted Executive Vice President Les Willis to president and CEO, succeeding longtime leader Charles Kwolek, who is retiring after a 32-year career with the organization.

headline: Recordkeeper JULY expands executive bench with two senior hires
summary: JULY Business Services promoted Blake Willis to president of retirement services and hired Josh Bulgin as its first chief commercial officer, part of a leadership build-out to support the firm's next phase of growth.

headline: Selective Insurance raises investment income guidance after 18% Q2 gain
summary: Selective Insurance Group's after-tax net investment income rose 18% year over year to $119 million in the second quarter, prompting the insurer to raise its full-year net investment income guidance to $480 million from an original $465 million target.

headline: Chubb's underwriting profit climbs nearly 19% as catastrophe losses ease
summary: Chubb reported second-quarter 2026 P&C underwriting income of $1.94 billion, up 18.8% year-over-year, with its combined ratio improving to 83.8% as pre-tax catastrophe losses fell to $475 million from $630 million a year earlier. The results stand out against a broader Q2 earnings season where several peers saw combined ratios worsen on rising cat losses.

headline: Munich Re names AI, cyber and climate as top themes for reinsurers
summary: Munich Re and ERGO's 2026 Tech Trend Radar identified AI, cyber resilience, climate analytics and emerging liability as the defining strategic themes for reinsurers this year, with 63% of surveyed executives wanting cover against AI-related risks.

headline: Allianz to buy HSBC Life Singapore in €2 billion bancassurance push
summary: Allianz agreed to acquire HSBC's Singapore composite insurer and pair the deal with a 15-year exclusive bancassurance distribution partnership with HSBC Singapore, valuing the combined arrangement near S$2.9 billion.

headline: Allianz Buys HSBC's Singapore Life Arm, Locks In 15-Year Bank Distribution Deal
summary: Allianz agreed to acquire HSBC Life Singapore for roughly $2.9 billion while simultaneously signing a 15-year exclusive bancassurance distribution agreement with HSBC Singapore, giving it a bank-channel foothold in the city-state.

headline: NHS speeds up AI deployment to tackle waiting lists across England
summary: NHS England is accelerating rollout of AI tools including an app-based triage assistant, ambient note-taking for outpatient visits, and expanded AI-assisted chest X-ray screening now used in about half of trusts, backed by roughly £10 billion in funding over three years.

headline: AIPSO hands the CEO reins to Les Willis after Kwolek's 32-year run
summary: AIPSO, which administers residual auto insurance market plans, promoted longtime Executive Vice President Les Willis to President and CEO, succeeding Charles Kwolek as he retires after three decades with the organization.

headline: Selective Insurance's investment income jumps as reinvestment yields keep climbing
summary: Selective Insurance Group reported after-tax net investment income of $119 million for the second quarter, up 18% year-over-year, with its fixed-income portfolio yielding 4.4% as insurers keep benefiting from reinvesting maturing bonds at higher rates.

headline: IRDAI chief pushes to eliminate 'dark patterns' from insurance apps and websites
summary: IRDAI Chairperson Ajay Seth called for eliminating deceptive digital design practices, or 'dark patterns,' from insurers' apps and websites, framing consumer-trust protections as essential to expanding digital insurance access.

headline: Innovaccer and AWS sign multi-year deal to deploy agentic AI across health systems and payers
summary: Innovaccer and Amazon Web Services signed a multi-year strategic collaboration to help health systems and payers move agentic AI deployments from pilot to production at the security, compliance and scale healthcare organizations require.

headline: ONC releases USCDI version 7 and names nine EHIgnite Challenge Phase 1 winners
summary: The Office of the National Coordinator published version 7 of the US Core Data for Interoperability standard, adding 30 new data elements, and named nine Phase 1 winners of its EHIgnite Challenge to turn dense health records into clearer AI-generated summaries for patients and clinicians.

headline: CMS finalizes higher-than-proposed Medicare Advantage payment rates for 2027
summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services locked in a 2.48% average Medicare Advantage rate increase for 2027, well above the 0.09% initially proposed, delivering billions of dollars in additional payments to private insurers.

headline: Samaritan-MultiCare tie-up in the Pacific Northwest edges toward regulatory sign-off
summary: The planned combination of Oregon's Samaritan Health Services and Washington-based MultiCare Health System, which would create an 18-hospital system, is moving through state regulatory review with an August timeline for next steps.

headline: Altruist targets August for general release of its AI financial-planning agent
summary: Altruist is expanding early access to Hazel, an AI agent that compresses an roughly 18-hour financial-plan build into minutes, ahead of a general launch targeted for August priced from $50 per advisor seat monthly.

headline: Centene swings to $1.1 billion Q2 profit, raises guidance for second time this year
summary: Centene reported $53.6 billion in Q2 revenue, up 10% year over year, and returned to profitability after a loss in the same quarter last year, prompting its second earnings-outlook increase of 2026.

headline: UnitedHealthcare to exit some Medicare Advantage PPO plans affecting 600000 members
summary: UnitedHealthcare said it will pull out of certain Medicare Advantage PPO plans as new CMS marketing rules take effect October 1 2026, raising switching risk for affected enrollees amid broader industry benefit pullbacks.

headline: WisdomTree posts sixth straight quarter of record AUM at $162.9 billion
summary: WisdomTree's assets under management hit a record $162.9 billion in the second quarter, driven by the Atlantic House acquisition, market appreciation and $3.1 billion of net inflows, marking its sixth consecutive record quarter.

headline: Catastrophe bond issuance hits record $17.3 billion in first half of 2026
summary: Global catastrophe bond issuance reached a record $17.3 billion in the first six months of 2026, per AM Best, as investors increasingly favor cat bonds over private reinsurance for their transparency.

headline: India's Bima Sugam insurance marketplace to launch motor, health and term products by September
summary: The government-backed Bima Sugam platform is on track to roll out its first motor, health and term insurance products by the end of September as participating insurers complete technology integration work.

headline: AXIS Capital posts higher Q2 fee income from strategic capital partner arrangements
summary: AXIS Capital reported another quarter of rising fee income from its third-party capital and insurance-linked securities partnerships, part of a broader industry shift toward fee-generating alternative capital structures.

headline: U.S. P/C industry logs its best underwriting result in a decade
summary: The U.S. property/casualty industry's combined ratio improved 3.6 points to 93 in 2025, its strongest underwriting performance in ten years, though results remain uneven between softening property rates and pressured casualty lines.

headline: Reinsurance buyers keep the upper hand at mid-year renewals
summary: Brokers report cedents secured further rate relief and more flexible terms at July 1 reinsurance renewals, extending a softening cycle fueled by record global reinsurance capital and a quieter-than-feared catastrophe season.

headline: IAG taps OpenAI's new Presence platform for disaster-claims voice agents
summary: Australian insurer IAG became a launch customer for OpenAI's newly announced Presence agent platform, planning AI voice agents to triage simple, non-event claims during natural-catastrophe surges so human specialists can focus on complex cases.

headline: IRDAI Figures Show Indian Insurance Premiums More Than Tripled Over the Decade
summary: New regulator data shows life insurance premiums growing roughly 2.5-2.6 times and total insurance premiums surging 3.6 times over the past ten years, with brokers now placing 42% of general insurance premium as India pushes toward universal coverage by 2047.

headline: Serbian-Hungarian digital motor insurer Ominimo becomes the Balkans' first unicorn
summary: Digital motor insurer Ominimo closed a EUR20.1 million Series B round backed by the EBRD's venture arm at a EUR1.4 billion valuation, reaching profitability and unicorn status only about two years after its 2024 launch on the strength of data-driven pricing technology.

headline: IRDAI weighs overhaul of insurance distributor commissions to curb mis-selling
summary: India's insurance regulator is considering replacing large upfront commission payouts to distributors with payments staggered over a policy's life, an effort to improve customer outcomes and align India's distribution rules with global norms.

headline: Cincinnati Financial misses earnings as combined ratio worsens to 100.8% in Q2
summary: The insurer's underwriting profitability deteriorated by nearly six points from the prior year, partly due to a rise in catastrophe losses, leaving second-quarter results short of analyst expectations.

headline: AI-focused MGA Mile Auto expands with acquisition of Insurance House
summary: The combined operation now serves more than 55,000 policyholders through roughly 1,600 independent agencies across ten states, adding scale to Mile Auto's technology-driven underwriting model.

headline: Amwins adds occupational-risk specialist MGA Jackson-Lloyd to its portfolio
summary: The wholesale giant continues to build out niche underwriting capabilities through bolt-on acquisitions, this time picking up a specialty MGA focused on occupational loss protection.

headline: AI-first brokerage builder AGI raises $70M after a year of testing its model across agencies
summary: American Growth Insurance secured $70 million to scale its AI-native brokerage platform, after a year piloting the operating model across ten agencies and reporting more than 50% higher average agency profitability.

headline: Sun Life debuts integrated private wealth platform to chase Asia's HNWI boom
summary: Sun Life launched "Sun Life Private Wealth," staffed by roughly 400 people across Hong Kong, Singapore, Bermuda, Dubai, Canada, Ireland and the US, targeting clients with at least $1 million in investable assets as Asian insurers race into wealth management.

headline: INSTANDA links up with Diesta to bring payments into no-code policy administration
summary: No-code policy administration platform INSTANDA partnered with insurance payments infrastructure firm Diesta so carriers, MGAs and brokers can move from product launch to premium collection and reconciliation faster.

headline: Budapest-founded Ominimo becomes region's newest insurtech unicorn at $1.6 billion
summary: EBRD led a $22.5 million Series B for Ominimo, an AI-driven motor insurance MGA operating across European markets, pushing its valuation to $1.6 billion as it pursues its own insurance license.

headline: Insurer Stocks Rally as Investors Rotate Into Safe Havens Amid AI Jitters
summary: US insurance shares jumped as much as 2.8% on the S&P 500 Insurance Index as traders nervous about an AI-driven market pulled money into defensive names, with brokers like Willis Towers Watson among the biggest gainers.

headline: RIA dealmaking sets new second-quarter record as PE-backed buyers dominate
summary: Echelon Partners' Q2 2026 report found 120 RIA transactions worth $378 billion in AUM changed hands, the busiest second quarter on record, with private-equity-backed acquirers again driving the bulk of activity.

headline: Budapest motor-insurance fintech Ominimo hits $1.6 billion valuation on fresh Series B
summary: Ominimo, which applies AI and data analytics to motor insurance pricing, raised $22.5 million in a Series B round that values the profit-focused company at roughly $1.6 billion.

headline: Zywave survey finds AI now a deciding factor in how employers pick brokers
summary: Zywave's 2026 Broker Services Survey shows artificial intelligence has shifted from a background trend to an explicit criterion employers weigh when choosing and evaluating their insurance brokers.

headline: UK Launches First National Digital Pathology Network With UCLH Neurology
summary: University College London Hospitals' neurology department joined the NPIC digital pathology platform, described as the UK's first national infrastructure for AI-assisted pathology. The onboarding expands a growing national push to digitize tissue diagnostics for AI analysis.

headline: Vertafore rolls out an AI agent to automate employee benefits plan setup for brokers
summary: Vertafore launched a new Velocity AI Benefit Plan Agent inside its BenefitPoint module, aimed at helping brokers automate benefit-plan configuration during the busy renewal season with claimed accuracy around 90%, part of a wider six-agent AI platform it unveiled earlier this year.

headline: Cincinnati Financial's investment income jumps as bond yields climb
summary: Cincinnati Financial reported a 12% year-over-year rise in second-quarter 2026 investment income, aided by stronger fixed-income yields and insurance cash flow, contributing to a sharp increase in net income and earnings per share versus a year earlier.

headline: US managing general agent premiums climb to roughly $128 billion
summary: A new Conning study finds the US MGA and delegated-underwriting market grew to about $128 billion in premium in 2025, driven by continued private equity and venture capital interest, technology adoption, and ongoing consolidation among program administrators.

headline: LIC installs a new finance chief and risk officer weeks ahead of quarterly results
summary: India's Life Insurance Corporation named Shatmanyu Shrivastava as chief financial officer and Varadarajan Muthuvenkataraman as chief risk officer effective July 28, 2026, rounding out its finance and risk leadership just before its Q1 FY27 earnings.

headline: UK annuity rates climb to their highest in nearly two decades
summary: Standard Life reported that annuity rates for a healthy 65-year-old rose to roughly 7.75% in July 2026, an 18-year high, as insurers keep passing through elevated gilt yields to retirees converting pension pots into guaranteed income.

headline: Insurers start rolling out policies to cover damages caused by AI systems
summary: As businesses adopt AI more aggressively, insurers and MGAs are launching new specialty products designed to cover losses and liability arising specifically from AI system failures and errors, filling a gap left by traditional coverage.

headline: Baylor Scott & White's health plan retreats from Texas Medicaid and ACA markets, cutting 321 jobs
summary: Baylor Scott & White Health Plan is exiting the individual marketplace and Medicaid managed care business in Texas by the end of August, eliminating 321 positions as it refocuses on Medicare Advantage and employer coverage.

headline: Wellstar Health System cuts 761 corporate jobs in one of 2026's largest health-system layoffs
summary: Georgia-based Wellstar Health System eliminated 761 corporate and administrative roles, about 2% of its workforce, while stating frontline clinical staff were not affected.

headline: Carlyle and Bain wage bidding war for $160 billion RIA Wealth Enhancement Group
summary: Two of the largest private equity firms are competing to acquire Minneapolis-based Wealth Enhancement Group at a valuation of roughly $7 billion including debt, underscoring continued consolidation pressure among large RIAs.

headline: Empower posts record quarterly earnings as its retirement and wealth business keeps scaling
summary: Empower reported second-quarter 2026 base earnings of $332 million, up 34% year-over-year, with assets under administration surpassing $2.1 trillion and strong net inflows across its workplace retirement and personal wealth units.

headline: OpenAI Signs Its First International Hospital Deal With Israel's Sheba Medical Center
summary: Sheba Medical Center in Israel agreed to deploy OpenAI's enterprise healthcare AI platform across its clinical, research and operations teams, marking OpenAI's first hospital rollout outside the United States and giving staff access to AI-assisted clinical reasoning tools.

headline: Vizient Forecasts Healthcare IT Spending to Jump 8% in 2027
summary: Supply-chain data firm Vizient's summer 2026 outlook projects hospitals will boost spending on IT hardware, software and cybersecurity by roughly 8% in 2027, outpacing overall healthcare inflation as health systems keep investing heavily in technology and AI infrastructure.

headline: Curant.ai raises $3.1 million seed round to scale AI-powered claims automation
summary: The Utah-based startup, led by Diagram with participation from Humania Insurance and Element Ventures, builds AI software that extracts data from documents to speed disability claims adjudication for insurers.

headline: Allstate seeks Illinois homeowners rate hikes up to 10.4% as losses mount
summary: Allstate filed for new homeowners rate increases of up to 10.4% affecting more than 200,000 Illinois policyholders, citing severe weather and rising repair costs, reigniting debate over state rate-oversight rules.

headline: AI-Focused RIA Arca Raises $64M Backed by General Catalyst and an Anthropic Partnership
summary: Arca, a registered investment advisor built around AI-assisted advisory workflows, launched with $64 million in funding from investors including General Catalyst, Index Ventures and Venrock, and already manages over $1 billion in client assets.

headline: Texas TPA Proficient Benefit Solutions Adds AI Layer via Elevate Tie-Up
summary: Consumer-directed benefits platform Elevate is partnering with Texas-based TPA Proficient Benefit Solutions to automate HSA, FSA and HRA administration for its employer clients, aiming to cut manual processing and speed account servicing.

headline: IRDAI approves new policyholder-protection and penalty regulations at its 137th Authority meeting
summary: India's insurance regulator approved a raft of reforms — including new policyholder education and protection fund rules, a revised penalty framework, and amendments affecting third-party administrators — to align with the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act and simplify compliance.

headline: Sun Life debuts global private-wealth platform to chase Asia's HNWI boom
summary: Sun Life launched a new global private wealth platform aimed at Asia's fast-growing high-net-worth population, betting on the region's expanding pool of affluent clients.

headline: NatWest partners with insurtech Uinsure to deliver home insurance quotes in under a minute
summary: NatWest launched an exclusive home insurance proposition with insurtech Uinsure offering sub-minute quotes from a panel of top UK insurers, alongside a new in-app tracker that alerts customers when better-value cover becomes available.

headline: M&G Closes £150 Million Bulk Annuity Deal for UK Pension Scheme
summary: Prudential Assurance, part of M&G, finalized a £150 million bulk purchase annuity transaction covering around 1,200 members of a UK pension scheme sponsored by an insurance company, reflecting continued strong competition in Britain's pension de-risking market.

headline: Florida's insurance-crisis fixes are leaving homeowners with less claims leverage, report finds
summary: A national regulators' report found several Florida property insurers closed more claims without payment in 2025 than in 2023, suggesting the state's reforms aimed at stabilizing the market have shifted more risk onto homeowners.

headline: AI insurtech Corgi raises fresh capital at $4 billion valuation, its third round in three months
summary: San Francisco-based Corgi closed another funding round in late July that pushed its valuation to about $4 billion, marking its third capital raise in under three months amid a broader resurgence in insurtech investor interest.

headline: CMS Confirms Medicare Part D Premium Subsidy Will Expire After 2026
summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services confirmed it will let a demonstration program that has been holding down Part D premiums lapse at the end of the 2026 plan year. Analysts warn the move could push drug-plan premiums higher for a large share of Medicare's senior population starting in 2027.

headline: Manipal Health commits roughly $414 million to expand hospital capacity as its IPO closes
summary: Manipal Health Enterprises plans to invest about ₹3,560 crore over the next three to four years to grow its hospital network, disclosed as its roughly ₹9,275 crore initial public offering wrapped up subscription on July 31; a large share of IPO proceeds will retire acquisition debt and buy out remaining minority stakes from recent deals like Sahyadri Hospitals.

headline: Wellington, Vanguard and Blackstone jointly debut blended public-private funds
summary: The three asset managers launched new closed-end funds combining public and private market exposure in single portfolios, initially distributed through Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank, as part of a distribution alliance the firms announced in 2025.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life set to report Q2 2026 earnings August 5 after prior-quarter miss
summary: Analysts expect F&G to post roughly $0.82 EPS on $1.49 billion of revenue when it reports second-quarter results, following a first-quarter miss versus consensus estimates.

headline: Allianz agrees to acquire HSBC's Singapore health and life insurance business for €2 billion
summary: Allianz will take over HSBC's Singapore life and health insurance operations in a €2 billion deal expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending approval from Singapore's Monetary Authority, expanding Allianz's Asian footprint.

headline: Great-West Lifeco's Empower unit crosses $2 trillion in U.S. workplace retirement assets, unveils platform acquisition
summary: Great-West Lifeco reported 15% year-over-year growth in base earnings per share for the second quarter and said its Empower retirement business surpassed $2 trillion in client assets while announcing a deal to strengthen its U.S. retirement platform.

headline: Kaiser-backed Risant Health loses its founding CEO as Ryu steps aside
summary: Jaewon Ryu is stepping down as CEO of Risant Health, the Kaiser Permanente subsidiary that acquires and operates nonprofit hospital systems, with retired Presbyterian Healthcare Services chief Dale Maxwell taking over on an interim basis during a national search.

headline: Humana to shed more Medicare Advantage plans in 2027 as profits are squeezed
summary: Humana posted Q2 net income of $694 million and reaffirmed its 2026 profit outlook, but said it will exit additional Medicare Advantage markets in 2027 as it works to protect margins amid rising medical costs.

headline: IRDAI grants ProTec General Insurance a license, its fourth approval of 2026
summary: India's insurance regulator granted a certificate of registration to ProTec General Insurance, the fourth new insurer license IRDAI has issued so far in 2026.

headline: Investcorp makes first wealth-management bet, taking majority stake in $3 billion RIA
summary: Alternative asset manager Investcorp acquired a majority stake in Berger Financial Group, a Minnesota-based RIA managing roughly $3 billion, marking Investcorp's debut investment in the wealth-management sector.

headline: Banyan Risk Opens New MGA Line for Digital Asset and Crypto Risk
summary: Bermuda-based insurtech Banyan Risk launched a Digital Assets & Emerging Risks product backed by QBE's Lloyd's Syndicate 1886, offering D&O, professional liability and crime coverage tailored to crypto exchanges, custodians and fintech platforms in fast-evolving markets.

headline: ThinkSono wins first FDA clearance for AI-guided blood clot ultrasound
summary: UK-founded ThinkSono received FDA 510(k) clearance for its AI-powered ultrasound guidance software for evaluating suspected deep vein thrombosis, letting non-specialist staff capture diagnostic-quality scans after brief training, based on a 1,691-patient multicenter study.

headline: UnitedHealth Group Posts 86.7% Medical Cost Ratio in Second-Quarter 2026 Results
summary: UnitedHealth Group reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of $112 billion and $8 billion in operating earnings, with a medical cost ratio of 86.7% reflecting tighter cost and pricing discipline across its benefit offerings.

headline: Tiptree re-enters specialty P&C with $100 million Universal Shield acquisition
summary: Tiptree Inc. agreed to acquire Universal Shield Insurance Group, a specialty P&C insurer writing admitted and excess & surplus lines, for $100 million in cash, redeploying capital from its earlier Fortegra sale into a new specialty platform.

headline: UK's PRA finalizes post-implementation tweaks to Solvency UK reporting and own-funds rules
summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority published a policy statement (PS18/26) on July 29 amending reporting, disclosure and own-funds requirements under Solvency UK, with new liquidity reporting rules taking effect September 30, 2026.

headline: UK PRA finalizes Solvency UK reporting and disclosure overhaul
summary: The Bank of England's Prudential Regulation Authority published PS18/26, finalizing amendments to Solvency UK reporting and disclosure rules, including moving a key matching-adjustment return to XBRL format, with insurers required to comply for reporting dates from December 31, 2026.

headline: UK pension trustees told to brace for DC megafund rules as new pensions law takes effect
summary: With the Pension Schemes Act 2026 having received Royal Assent, advisers are highlighting a revised implementation roadmap, a Value for Money framework consultation and new scale requirements that will eventually push smaller DC schemes toward consolidation into multi-billion-pound master trusts.

headline: Acies MGU launches ports-and-terminals specialist TEDmar International
summary: Acies MGU unveiled TEDmar International, a new managing general agent focused on marine ports and terminals risk, led by veteran marine underwriters, as part of a wider wave of specialty MGA launches this week.

headline: Allianz to buy HSBC's Singapore life and health insurance unit in €2 billion deal with 15-year distribution tie-up
summary: Allianz agreed to acquire HSBC Life Singapore and sign a 15-year exclusive bancassurance partnership with HSBC in the city-state, a combined €2 billion transaction expected to close in the first half of 2027.

headline: WellSpan Health expands its Hippocratic AI partnership across clinical operations
summary: WellSpan Health broadened its multi-year partnership with generative voice AI company Hippocratic AI to support more clinical operations and improve the patient experience across its health system.

headline: Shareholders clear the way for Corebridge and Equitable's $22 billion tie-up
summary: Stockholders of both Corebridge Financial and Equitable Holdings voted overwhelmingly to approve their all-stock merger, moving the combined retirement, life and asset-management platform - projected at roughly $1.5 trillion in AUM - closer to a year-end closing.

headline: Canadian insurer Definity beats earnings estimates even as its combined ratio ticks up
summary: Definity's operating net income rose over 10% year-on-year to C$118 million in Q2, outperforming forecasts despite a modest deterioration in underwriting margin.

headline: Cyber insurers say AI-native attacks haven't yet produced a claim, but AI-assisted fraud keeps rising
summary: Resilience's midyear cyber report found human error still drove 85% of incurred losses in the first half of 2026, with no confirmed losses yet from fully autonomous AI attacks, even as AI-enhanced phishing and deepfake fraud attempts continue climbing.

headline: Sapiens taps CFO Paul Wheeler as next CEO to lead AI-native push
summary: Insurance software vendor Sapiens announced a planned leadership transition naming CFO Paul Wheeler as CEO Designate, with Executive Chairman Mike Ettling continuing to support the AI-native evolution of the company's platform.

headline: India adopts sweeping insurance reforms with 100% FDI and new policyholder fund
summary: IRDAI's late-July reform package allows 100% foreign direct investment in insurers under the automatic route, adopts new Policyholders' Education and Protection Fund regulations, and for the first time creates a statutory framework letting insurers merge with non-insurance entities.

headline: Raymond James lures a $5.4 billion Comerica advisory team to its employee channel
summary: Three veteran wealth advisors who together managed about $5.4 billion left Comerica, recently absorbed into Fifth Third Bank, to join Raymond James's employee advisor unit in Newport Beach, California, part of a wave of large team moves reshaping the independent channel this year.

headline: US home insurance claim costs hit an all-time high even as claim frequency falls
summary: A new LexisNexis home insurance trends report finds that average claim severity jumped roughly 26% year-over-year and is up more than 90% since 2019, its highest level in seven years, as rebuilding costs outpace a decline in how often claims are filed.

headline: TPG-Backed Broker Third Wave Adds Five Gulf Coast Firms, Building Out In-House Plan Administration
summary: Third Wave Insurance, backed by private equity firm TPG, agreed to acquire five insurance and benefits-advisory agencies across Louisiana, Mississippi and Florida. Analysts framed the deal as being less about scale and more about giving the roll-up its own employee-benefits plan-administration capability.

headline: Advisor Alternatives Platform CAIS Raises $170M, Tops $2 Billion Valuation
summary: CAIS, which gives independent financial advisors access to alternative investments, closed a $170 million Series D led by Vista Equity Partners with support from Carlyle, Blue Owl and other institutional investors, pushing its valuation above $2 billion and lifetime funding toward $600 million.

headline: Claims-AI Startup Curant.ai Closes $3.1M Seed as Insurers Seek Enterprise-Grade Automation
summary: Utah-based Curant.ai raised a $3.1 million seed round led by Diagram, with participation from Humania Insurance and Element Ventures, to expand a platform that automates claims adjudication and data extraction for insurance carriers.

headline: AIA Singapore Rolls Out Digital-First Benefits for Over a Million Corporate Members
summary: AIA Singapore unveiled upgrades to its group insurance plans, including specialist clinic visits without a GP referral, digital pre-authorization submissions, and round-the-clock teleconsultation, aimed at improving healthcare access for corporate members amid rising medical-inflation concerns.

headline: Sapiens taps its own CFO to lead next phase of AI-driven overhaul
summary: Core-systems vendor Sapiens named CFO Paul Wheeler as incoming CEO, with Executive Chairman Mike Ettling stepping back after serving as interim chief. Wheeler will formally take the helm around the company's October summit as Sapiens pushes further into becoming an AI-native insurance software provider.

headline: Intermountain Health cuts documentation time 27% with Microsoft's Dragon Copilot
summary: Intermountain Health clinicians using Dragon Copilot for 10 or more encounters saw a 27% reduction in time spent on notes per appointment, based on Epic data, as the system scaled the ambient-AI tool across its enterprise.

headline: India's insurance regulator finalizes 100% foreign ownership rules and tougher enforcement powers
summary: IRDAI's board approved a reform package implementing 100% FDI under the automatic route alongside liberalized investment norms, simplified restructuring, and expanded powers to penalize insurers and fund a new policyholder protection fund.

headline: WHO's global health funding gap widens after US pulls Gavi channel funding
summary: The Trump administration moved to cut off WHO's access to Gavi vaccine-alliance funding, deepening an agency budget shortfall now estimated near $1.9 billion of a planned $4.2 billion 2026-27 budget and adding to strain on global immunization and health-system programs.

headline: New Lloyd's-Backed MGA Launches to Cover Ports and Terminals Risk
summary: Acies MGU launched an MGA backed by a consortium of Lloyd's of London capacity offering property, liability and operational coverage for port and terminal operators, with capacity up to $25 million.

headline: Sapiens hands CEO role to CFO Paul Wheeler as it pushes AI-native software strategy
summary: Insurance software vendor Sapiens named finance chief Paul Wheeler as its next CEO, with outgoing leader Mike Ettling continuing as executive chairman to support the transition as the company builds out AI-native offerings.

headline: Prudential posts higher Q2 2026 profit as annuity and retirement businesses strengthen
summary: Prudential Financial reported second-quarter 2026 net income climbing to $985 million and adjusted operating income rising to $1.44 billion, reflecting continued strength across its life insurance and retirement product lines.

headline: Mapfre takes a stake in Spanish digital insurer Tuio to deepen AI push
summary: Spanish insurance giant Mapfre agreed to buy a 38.9% stake in Tuio, a fully digital Spanish insurtech with over 100,000 customers, as part of a broader push into agile, AI-driven distribution that follows Mapfre's separate $1.5 billion purchase of Safety Insurance in the US.

headline: Arch RoamRight embeds travel insurance directly into TravelJoy's advisor booking platform
summary: Arch RoamRight partnered with travel-planning platform TravelJoy so travel advisors can quote and sell its travel insurance policies without leaving their existing booking workflow.

headline: CNO Financial raises 2026 profit guidance after a blowout annuity quarter
summary: CNO Financial Group's operating earnings per share jumped 45% year-over-year in Q2 2026 on record annuity premiums and fixed indexed annuity growth, prompting the insurer to lift its full-year earnings outlook by roughly 8% at the midpoint.

headline: Spanish insurer Mapfre buys a 38.9% stake in digital insurance distributor Tuio
summary: Mapfre agreed to take a significant minority stake in Tuio, a specialist digital insurance distribution platform built around advanced AI capabilities, deepening the insurer's push into tech-driven distribution.

headline: AXA posts higher profit and reaffirms strategy after exiting asset management
summary: AXA reported a roughly 2% rise in profit in line with expectations, with CEO Thomas Buberl expressing confidence in the outlook as the French insurer refocuses on its core insurance operations following this year's €5.1 billion sale of its asset-management arm.

headline: Zywave Expands Its Apex AI Platform With New Broker Growth Tools
summary: Insurance software vendor Zywave broadened its Apex AI platform with new prospecting, renewal, quoting and client-management tools aimed at helping agencies and brokerages automate front-office growth activities as part of a Summer 2026 release.

headline: &Partners recruits $1.8 billion Mississippi team from Wells Fargo
summary: Hybrid RIA &Partners added a four-advisor Meridian, Mississippi team managing $1.8 billion that departed Wells Fargo Advisors to launch as 32 North Wealth, capping a month that brought &Partners to 121 advisor practices and roughly $58 billion in assets.

headline: Artisan Partners reports $183 billion in assets under management
summary: Artisan Partners Asset Management disclosed preliminary assets under management of $183.0 billion as of July 31, 2026, giving an early read on mid-year flows for the publicly traded asset manager.

headline: Increase launches FDIC-member bank charter for fintech builders
summary: Banking infrastructure provider Increase launched an FDIC-member bank aimed at giving fintech and insurtech builders more direct, compliant access to core banking rails.

headline: Silver and Lynx take AI-powered claims automation live for benefits TPAs
summary: Silver and Lynx moved their embedded AI claims-automation tool into production on the Lynx platform, letting TPAs auto-adjudicate FSA, DCFSA, HRA and Medicare Advantage claims by reading receipts, EOBs and other unstructured documents.

headline: CMS's FY2027 Inpatient Payment Proposal Pushes Hospitals Further Toward Certified EHR Technology
summary: CMS's newly released FY2027 Inpatient Prospective Payment System proposal encourages hospitals and critical access facilities to adopt and demonstrate use of certified electronic health record technology, continuing the push for deeper interoperability.

headline: CMS finalizes FY2027 hospital payment rule with 2.3% rate increase
summary: The final inpatient prospective payment system rule raises Medicare hospital payments by about $2.1 billion in fiscal 2027 for facilities meeting quality-reporting and EHR requirements, while trimming disproportionate-share hospital payments by $200 million.

headline: NAIC's first nationwide homeowners study finds premiums up as much as 43% in the West since 2018
summary: A first-of-its-kind NAIC analysis of seven years of market conduct data found average homeowners premiums rose 18% in the Northeast, 25% in the Midwest, 27% in the Southeast and 43% in the West even after adjusting for inflation.

headline: Sovereign wealth fund Mubadala takes full control of $27.7B RIA Evoke Advisors via MAI Capital
summary: MAI Capital closed its purchase of Los Angeles-based Evoke Advisors, marking what's reported as the first time a sovereign wealth fund has taken full ownership of a major North American wealth manager, with Mubadala pledging $5 billion in growth capital over three years.

headline: Elevance Health rolls out an AI-driven cancer-care coordination program
summary: Elevance Health launched an enhanced oncology support model that pairs predictive analytics with certified nurse navigators to steer cancer patients toward the right care and cut avoidable hospital stays.

headline: FDA fast-tracks review of a rare-disease drug that could change care for a devastating bone disorder
summary: The FDA granted priority review to garetosmab for fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva after a phase 3 trial showed it significantly cut abnormal bone growth and flare-ups, a decision hospitals treating this ultra-rare condition are watching closely.

headline: 401(k) industry keeps building toward alternative-asset investing as DOL rulemaking plays out
summary: Following the White House push to widen retirement-plan access to private equity, private credit and other alternatives, recordkeepers, asset managers and advisers are preparing infrastructure even though plan sponsors remain cautious about fiduciary and litigation exposure.

headline: Equitable Holdings reports healthy net inflows across retirement, wealth and AllianceBernstein
summary: Equitable's second-quarter 2026 results showed $1.7 billion of net inflows in its Retirement segment, $2.0 billion of advisory net inflows in Wealth Management and $0.8 billion of net inflows at AllianceBernstein, even as net investment income from alternatives came in lower than the prior period.

headline: Florida storm damage tops $1.5 billion as underpaid-claims complaints mount statewide
summary: Recent storms have driven insured losses in Florida past $1.5 billion, with policyholder advocates reporting a surge in disputes over claims they say insurers are settling for less than the actual cost of repairs.

headline: India's Insurance Regulator Moves Toward Permanent Licensing for Health TPAs
summary: IRDAI issued its formal response to industry feedback on proposed amendments to the rules governing health-claims third-party administrators, signaling it will proceed with a shift to perpetual TPA registration subject to annual fees and compliance, while shelving a proposed TPA-listing framework for later.

headline: India's Newgen Software Hands CEO Role to Longtime COO Tarun Nandwani
summary: Newgen Software, an Indian enterprise-software provider widely used by BFSI clients, promoted chief operating officer Tarun Nandwani to CEO for an 18-month term following the departure of longtime chief Virender Jeet, and created a new Chief Growth Officer post for Pramod Kumar.

headline: Universal Health Services trims 2026 outlook despite double-digit operating margin
summary: UHS posted an 11.1% operating margin in the second quarter but lowered its full-year 2026 forecast as rising expenses offset revenue growth.

headline: EU AI Act's high-risk rules for insurance underwriting take effect this month
summary: The European Union's AI Act provisions governing high-risk AI use in insurance risk assessment and pricing became fully applicable in August 2026, raising compliance requirements for insurers using automated underwriting.

headline: UK property insurers face one of their toughest operating environments in years
summary: Browne Jacobson analysis finds record claims payouts, climate-driven catastrophe losses and a fragile pricing recovery are squeezing margins and capacity across the UK property insurance market in 2026.

headline: Wealth Enhancement adds three RIAs totaling more than $1.1 billion in assets
summary: The Minneapolis-based aggregator continued its rapid acquisition pace, striking three separate RIA deals that together bring in over $1.1 billion of client assets.

headline: CVS Health taps a UnitedHealthcare veteran to run Aetna
summary: CVS Health named a former UnitedHealthcare executive as the new chief executive of its Aetna insurance unit, part of a broader leadership reset across the company's health-benefits business. The appointment continues a pattern of cross-payer executive movement among the largest national health insurers.

headline: Asia-Pacific Life Insurers Positioned for Multi-Year Run Toward a $1.6 Trillion Market
summary: Analysts expect Asia-Pacific life insurance to grow roughly 7.3% annually, expanding from about $1.2 trillion today to $1.6 trillion by 2029, with India's Shriram Life and HDFC Life pointing to bancassurance expansion and favorable demographics as growth drivers.

headline: Prudential Financial's Q2 profit nearly doubles as assets under management reach $1.64 trillion
summary: Prudential reported second-quarter net income of $985 million, up sharply from $533 million a year earlier, with total assets under management climbing to $1.642 trillion.

headline: RIA dealmaking shatters records, on pace for nearly 500 transactions in 2026
summary: Wealth management M&A hit its busiest first half on record with 262 deals, as repeat private-equity-backed acquirers and a wave of platform capital raises pushed sponsor-backed activity to an all-time high.

headline: IRS to issue opinion letters for pre-approved DC plans by August 31
summary: The IRS expects to issue Cycle 4 opinion letters for pre-approved defined contribution plans around August 31, with a formal announcement in its Internal Revenue Bulletin setting the deadline for plan sponsors to adopt updated pre-approved plan documents.

headline: Third-party reinsurance capital projected to grow 6% to $130 billion in 2026
summary: AM Best and Guy Carpenter project alternative and third-party reinsurance capital will grow 6% to $130 billion in 2026, as investors keep channeling capital into insurance-linked securities and collateralized reinsurance vehicles.

headline: Insurance TPA market valued at $592.5 billion in 2026, projected to top $845 billion by 2031
summary: The global insurance third-party administrator market is valued at $592.52 billion in 2026 and forecast to reach $845.30 billion by 2031, a 7.36% CAGR driven by self-funded health plan growth and AI-driven claims automation.

headline: Newgen Software names Tarun Nandwani CEO for 18-month term
summary: Newgen Software, whose BPM and automation platforms serve banks and insurers, appointed 33-year company veteran Tarun Nandwani as CEO for an 18-month term starting August 1, alongside a broader leadership reshuffle naming Pramod Kumar as Chief Growth Officer.

headline: Roche to acquire AI pathology firm PathAI for up to $1.05 billion
summary: Roche agreed to acquire Boston-based digital pathology company PathAI for up to $1.05 billion -- $750 million upfront plus $300 million in milestones -- expanding its AI-assisted pathology portfolio built on the companies' partnership since 2021.

headline: Health systems report major time savings from AI documentation tools
summary: Intermountain Health cut time spent on visit notes by 27% using Microsoft's Dragon Copilot, while Cooper University Healthcare and Mercy reported clinicians saving over an hour of documentation time per shift using similar ambient AI scribe tools.

headline: Marpai's TPA and PBM platforms add 35,000 member lives in August
summary: Marpai said two major TPA clients representing roughly 35,000 member lives went live August 1, part of a projected 192,000-life expansion the company expects will push it to positive cash flow and EBITDA this quarter.

headline: Guidewire appoints AI transformation specialist to its board
summary: Insurance software vendor Guidewire named veteran insurance executive and AI transformation specialist Dr. Alexander Vollert to its board, with his term beginning August 1.

headline: AIA and Manulife post double-digit new-business growth across Asia
summary: AIA's China and Hong Kong operations drove group value of new business up double digits, while Manulife's Asia segment grew core earnings 21% and new business value 13%, both citing strength in Hong Kong, Singapore and mainland China.

headline: Voya extends 401(k) recordkeeping deal with law firm Baker Botts
summary: Voya Financial renewed its role as recordkeeper for international law firm Baker Botts effective August 1, continuing to serve more than 1,800 plan participants and roughly $900 million in retirement assets.

headline: Family-office wealthtech Asset Vantage names Nicole Eberhardt global CEO
summary: Asset Vantage, an AI-led SaaS platform serving more than 400 families across 10 countries, appointed Nicole Eberhardt as global chief executive effective August 1 to lead its next phase of product and international growth.

headline: Reinsurance sidecars and ILS capital step in as traditional reinsurers pull back from MGAs
summary: Broker Gallagher Re says growing use of third-party capital, reinsurance sidecars and insurance-linked-securities investors is helping managing general agents replace underwriting capacity that major reinsurers have scaled back.

headline: IRS confirms higher 2026 contribution ceilings for 401(k) and IRA savers
summary: The IRS raised the 2026 401(k) elective-deferral limit to $24,500 and the IRA contribution limit to $7,500, giving workers more room to shelter retirement savings as inflation adjustments continue.

headline: Global catastrophe reinsurance pricing posts its steepest annual drop in 25 years
summary: Guy Carpenter's property-catastrophe rate-on-line index fell 16% year-over-year at the June/July renewals as record capital levels pressured pricing, even as a summer of frequent catastrophe events complicates the outlook for later renewals.

headline: Federated Mutual buys trucking-focused insurtech MGA HDVI
summary: Federated Mutual Insurance acquired High Definition Vehicle Insurance, a telematics-driven trucking MGA, absorbing a book of business handled through more than 100 agencies and 500 producers.

headline: U.S. MGA market swells to roughly $128 billion as specialization reshapes distribution
summary: The U.S. managing general agent market grew to about $128 billion in total premium flow in 2025, with MGA-written direct premium up 12% from 2024 as carriers and private equity firms extend their reach into specialty distribution.

headline: Prior authorization denial rates vary wildly across major health insurers, new data shows
summary: First-of-its-kind data shows prior authorization denial rates ranging from 2% to 25% among major insurers, with at least one in eight standard requests denied across Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care and ACA marketplace plans.

headline: UnitedHealthcare, Humana and Aetna scale back Medicare Advantage offerings for 2026
summary: Major payers UnitedHealthcare, Humana and Aetna are trimming their Medicare Advantage plan footprints for 2026, part of an industry-wide pullback as insurers manage rising medical costs and tighter margins in the program.

headline: Global insurtech funding hits $2.44 billion in strongest quarter since 2022
summary: Insurtech venture funding surged to $2.44 billion across 95 deals in the second quarter of 2026, the highest quarterly total in four years, though investors are increasingly favoring mature, AI-ready companies over early-stage startups.

headline: Asia commercial insurance rates keep falling, with Vietnam property the outlier
summary: Marsh's latest index shows Asia commercial insurance rates fell about 5% in the second quarter, matching the prior quarter's pace, while Vietnam property rates rose 13% on regulatory pricing tariffs even as Taiwan and Korea saw steep declines.

headline: TWFG's Q1 filing details $22.5 million acquisition of Texas MGA Asset Protection Insurance Associates
summary: TWFG's SEC filing shows the insurance distributor acquired APIA, a Texas-based MGA focused on property owners and real estate investors, for $22.5 million cash plus up to $7 million in earnout payments.

headline: Private equity-backed buyers drove roughly 76% of insurance agency acquisitions in first-half 2026
summary: BroadStreet Partners and Inszone Insurance Services led first-half 2026 insurance distribution M&A with 37 and 33 deals respectively, as PE-backed and hybrid buyers accounted for about three-quarters of all agency acquisitions even as overall deal pace slowed.

headline: Insurer general account assets approach $8.7 trillion as carriers keep migrating into private credit
summary: Combined life and P&C insurer invested assets reached roughly $8.68 trillion at year-end 2025, with the 2026 Insurance Investment Outsourcing Report tracking a continued multiyear migration into private credit and alternatives amid new regulatory reporting rules.

headline: Pooled employer plan adoption jumps nearly 45% as recordkeepers chase DC growth
summary: The 2026 PLANSPONSOR Recordkeeping Survey found 10,797 employers had adopted pooled employer plans for 401(k)/403(b) participants, up from 7,454 a year earlier, as almost 60% of recordkeepers now service PEPs.

headline: India's insurance regulator rolls out a wave of policyholder-friendly health rules
summary: IRDAI is implementing reforms tied to the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act, including shorter pre-existing-condition waiting periods, removal of age caps on buying cover, and new insurer/hospital performance scorecards, as health premiums in India grew more than 27% year-on-year.

headline: FDA advances plan to stream clinical trial data to regulators in real time
summary: The FDA is finalizing selection criteria and completing pilot site selections in August for its real-time clinical trials initiative, building on two proof-of-concept studies that already report endpoints and safety signals to the agency as they happen.

headline: Mayo Clinic's longtime president and CEO plans to depart by year-end
summary: Gianrico Farrugia, who has led Mayo Clinic as president and CEO, has said he intends to step down at the end of 2026, setting up a leadership transition at one of the country's most prominent academic health systems.

headline: SimplyGo and EFGH explore embedded micro-insurance partnership for gig and mobility platforms
summary: Mobility platform SimplyGo and EFGH entered a strategic partnership to explore embedded micro-insurance services, the latest example of fintech and mobility platforms bundling coverage directly into digital products.

headline: Annuity sales notch 10th straight quarter above $100 billion as Q2 hits $123.9 billion
summary: LIMRA reports the annuity market kept up its remarkable run in the second quarter of 2026, marking a tenth consecutive quarter above the $100 billion sales mark and setting a new quarterly high, with registered index-linked annuities among the fastest-growing products.

headline: American Financial Group's P&C investment income jumps 23% on alternative portfolio gains
summary: American Financial Group reported second-quarter 2026 net investment income of $221 million in its property and casualty operations, up 23% year over year, driven by stronger returns from its alternative investments including managed CLOs.

headline: Global insurance TPA market forecast to reach $845 billion by 2031 on AI-driven claims growth
summary: A new market report values the global insurance third-party-administrator sector at roughly $592.5 billion in 2026, projecting growth to $845.3 billion by 2031 as insurers increasingly outsource claims processing to tech-enabled TPAs.

headline: ACA marketplace premiums jump 26% on average as subsidy expiration looms
summary: Newly unveiled 2026 ACA marketplace filings show average premiums rising 26% before accounting for expiring enhanced subsidies, pushing more consumers toward cheaper, higher-deductible bronze plans.

headline: Commercial P&C market conditions turn more favorable for buyers in midyear 2026 update
summary: Alera Group's midyear market update finds commercial insurance conditions easing for many businesses, even as RBC Capital Markets warns that softer primary property pricing and elevated catastrophe losses could pressure insurer earnings.

headline: UK's Pension Schemes Act 2026 becomes law, reshaping DC pensions for 20 million-plus savers
summary: The newly enacted Pension Schemes Act 2026 requires UK pension schemes to prove they deliver value for money, enables automatic consolidation of small deferred pension pots, and pushes the market toward larger, better-performing default funds -- reforms the government says could add up to £29,000 to a typical saver's pot.

headline: FCA moves to simplify pay rules and reporting for UK investment advisers
summary: British regulators proposed replacing overlapping AIFM, UCITS and MIFIDPRU remuneration codes with one streamlined framework and floated a simpler annual return for MiFID portfolio managers, with the consultation running into late September 2026.

headline: BCG: softer pricing and mounting risks are resetting the US P&C market
summary: A BCG analysis found US property-casualty insurers are entering a correction phase as competitive pricing pressure and emerging risks such as AI liability and climate volatility reshape underwriting strategy heading through 2026.

headline: State regulators sharpen focus on solvency, catastrophe risk and AI oversight
summary: NAIC leadership set its 2026 committee agenda around financial solvency rules, natural catastrophe resilience, and supervision of insurers' use of emerging technology including AI.

headline: Wave of health system CEO transitions continues through 2026
summary: Large US health systems including Ascension, Community Health Network, Temple Health and PeaceHealth have installed new CEOs this year, reflecting a broader wave of executive turnover across hospital leadership in 2026.

headline: Guaranteed-income target-date assets nearly double to $44 billion in a year
summary: Target-date series that embed a guaranteed lifetime-income option saw assets jump 70% to $44 billion by the end of March 2026, up from $25 billion a year earlier, as more plan sponsors add in-plan annuity features.

headline: Target-date fund investors pay up to six times more than a DIY two-ETF portfolio
summary: An analysis found that many mainstream target-date mutual funds charge fees several times higher than replicating the same glide path with a simple two-ETF stock/bond combination, renewing scrutiny of retirement-plan default fees.

headline: Insurers Plan AI, Storm and Cyber Risk Strategies for Second Half of 2026
summary: Carriers are shifting claims operations from AI-assisted adjuster workflows toward more autonomous, agentic AI processes for the back half of 2026, alongside continued focus on catastrophe and cyber exposure planning.

headline: State AI Insurance Rules Gain Ground as Federal Preemption Fight Looms
summary: More than half of U.S. states have now adopted the NAIC's model bulletin on AI use in insurance, even as a federal executive order raises questions about federal preemption of state insurance regulatory authority.

headline: Insurance Software Provider SSP Joins MGAA and Debuts AI Product Platform
summary: SSP UK and Ireland joined the Managing General Agents' Association and launched a new AI-powered product configuration platform aimed at speeding up how MGAs build and bring insurance products to market.

headline: UK Regulator Raises Fees on Insurance Brokers for 2026/27
summary: The Financial Conduct Authority confirmed that UK insurance brokers will pay 1.3% more in regulatory fees for the 2026/27 financial year compared with the prior year.

headline: Georgia shifts annual TPA license renewal deadline to August 1 under new rule
summary: Georgia's insurance regulator implemented a rule change moving third-party administrators' annual license renewal date to August 1, with licenses now running through year-end 2026.
source_name: Georgia Office of Commissioner of Insurance and Safety Fire

headline: Insurers Shift AI From Pilots to Production Across Underwriting, Claims and Fraud Detection
summary: Carriers are increasingly running live operations on AI rather than piloting it, with underwriting turnaround compressing from days to minutes and claims processing speeding up sharply as straight-through processing rates climb.

headline: Hospital Financial Performance Trails 2025 Despite Slight Gains in Margins and Expenses
summary: Kaufman Hall's latest national hospital flash data shows operating performance running behind 2025 levels even with modest recent improvement, as systems continue to grapple with rising bad debt, labor costs and a shifting government-heavy payer mix.

headline: Pension buy-in interest rates hit highest levels since 2023 as PRT market builds momentum
summary: Duration-7 and duration-15 annuity purchase interest rates have climbed to their highest points since 2023, and with pension liabilities declining, an August pricing update from October Three says conditions remain favorable for plan sponsors pursuing de-risking deals through the third quarter.

headline: Asset Vantage names Nicole Eberhardt global CEO to lead wealthtech expansion
summary: Family-office wealthtech platform Asset Vantage, which supports more than $400 billion in assets across 400-plus families in 10 countries, appointed Nicole Eberhardt as global CEO effective August 1, elevating its former North America managing director to lead product and market expansion.

headline: CMS backs off proposed Medicare Advantage payment cut, raising 2027 rates nearly 5%
summary: CMS finalized Medicare Advantage payment rates for 2027 well above its initial proposal, delivering private insurers close to a 5% average per-enrollee increase after industry pushback on planned cuts.

headline: Bank of England's new insurer liquidity reporting rules take effect September 30
summary: New Bank of England liquidity reporting requirements for large UK Solvency II insurers with significant derivatives or securities-lending exposure come into force on September 30, 2026, closing a gap flagged in an earlier PRA consultation.

headline: NatWest launches embedded home insurance through Uinsure partnership
summary: UK bank NatWest rolled out a new home insurance offering built on Manchester-based insurtech Uinsure's digital infrastructure, part of a broader wave of embedded-insurance partnerships between banks and insurtechs this year.

headline: Insurtech investors write fewer, much larger checks in 2026
summary: The median insurtech funding round size roughly doubled to $30 million in 2026 from $16.5 million a year earlier, as investors consolidate capital behind fewer companies with proven AI-driven underwriting or claims capabilities.

headline: Active fixed-income managers keep beating benchmarks inside target-date funds
summary: J.P. Morgan Asset Management research finds actively managed fixed-income sleeves inside target-date funds have outperformed their benchmarks net of fees in 94% of rolling three-year periods, reinforcing active management's role in DC default investments.

headline: Sun Life and Wilton Re form strategic life and annuity reinsurance partnership, launching Windsor Life Re
summary: Sun Life and Wilton Re signed a definitive agreement combining reinsurance and asset-management capabilities across life and annuity blocks, with Wilton Re establishing the U.S./Bermuda-domiciled Windsor Life Re to support future in-force block origination.

headline: Guaranteed income options gain interest among DC plan sponsors, though adoption still lags
summary: A defined-contribution plan sponsor survey found growing interest in guaranteed retirement income options, but only 17% of sponsors said they are very or extremely likely to add one within the next 12-18 months, underscoring a gap between interest and adoption.

headline: LIMRA reports steady Q2 growth in life insurance sales, led by whole life and variable universal life
summary: LIMRA's Q2 2026 individual life insurance survey found total new premium rose 3% year-over-year to $4.75 billion, with whole life climbing 9% to become the largest driver of growth and variable universal life posting the fastest growth rate at 13%, aided by a rebound in equity markets.

headline: Congress enacts sweeping PBM reform, reshaping disclosure duties for TPAs and self-funded plans
summary: New federal pharmacy-benefit-manager reform enacted in early 2026 brings fresh compliance and disclosure obligations for PBMs and third-party administrators working with ERISA self-funded group health plans, employment-law advisors say.

headline: BrokerTech Ventures' 2026 accelerator cohort gets broker and carrier distribution access
summary: BrokerTech Ventures' 2026 accelerator cohort of nine insurtech startups each received $50,000 in seed funding plus immediate access to BTV's broker and carrier network to pilot their technology.

headline: Intermountain Health cuts documentation time 27% with ambient AI scribe tool
summary: Intermountain Health reported a 27% reduction in time spent on clinical notes per appointment after deploying Microsoft's Dragon Copilot ambient AI scribe, part of a broader wave of health systems adopting documentation AI.

headline: 403(b) fee lawsuits keep spreading to plan sponsors as ERISA litigation wave persists
summary: Plaintiffs' firms continue extending a decade-long wave of 401(k) excessive-fee litigation into 403(b) plans, alleging sponsors failed to follow prudent processes for overseeing recordkeeping fees and fund menus.

headline: Vertafore earns fifth straight 5-Star rating for AI-driven agency and MGA technology
summary: Vertafore was recognized for the fifth consecutive year as a 5-Star Technology and Software Provider, citing its Velocity AI Platform and AI agents that speed up workflows for agencies, MGAs and carriers.

headline: IRDAI approves two general insurers to raise foreign ownership beyond 74% under new FDI norms
summary: India's insurance regulator approved two general insurance companies to increase foreign shareholding beyond the previous 74% ceiling, among the first movers since the government opened the door to 100% foreign investment in insurers.

headline: Casualty lines stay under pressure from nuclear verdicts even as broader P&C market softens
summary: IMA Financial Group's Q2 2026 market update found excess liability, umbrella and commercial auto lines still strained by claim severity and large jury verdicts, a contrast to easing property rates across much of the commercial P&C book.

headline: Corgi raises $108 million to scale its AI-native insurance carrier for startups
summary: Corgi Insurance raised $108 million across a new Series A and earlier seed funding after winning regulatory approval to operate as a full-stack, AI-powered carrier, with annual recurring revenue already topping $40 million.
