headline: Vizient projects 8% jump in healthcare IT spending for 2027
summary: A roundup of health IT news notes Vizient forecasts an 8% increase in healthcare information-technology spending next year, as systems continue investing in AI-enabled clinical and administrative tools.

headline: EU's toughest AI Act rules for high-risk systems officially kick in, with insurers in scope
summary: As of August 2, 2026, the European Union's AI Act provisions covering high-risk AI systems become legally binding, requiring insurers and other financial firms using AI in underwriting or claims decisions to meet new documentation, risk-management, and registration obligations unless a proposed delay is formally adopted in time.

headline: Escalating Medicare Advantage plan exits threaten coverage for thousands of seniors
summary: Forbes reports a wave of insurer exits from Medicare Advantage markets for 2027 could displace large numbers of older adults as carriers retreat from unprofitable counties nationwide.

headline: EU AI Act's high-risk obligations become binding for life and health underwriting
summary: The EU AI Act's high-risk system obligations became enforceable on August 2, classifying AI used for underwriting, pricing and risk-scoring in life and health insurance as high-risk and subject to conformity assessments and human oversight, though a late-July political deal pushed some sensitive-use deadlines to December 2027.

headline: Life insurers' private-credit book swells toward $2 trillion, raising systemic-risk questions
summary: Life insurers' exposure to private credit and other illiquid alternative investments continues to climb, with analysts flagging concentration and valuation concerns even as carriers defend the strategy as a source of higher yield.

headline: Wildfire risk pushes catastrophe bond sales to fresh records
summary: Insurers are issuing catastrophe bonds tied to wildfire exposure at a pace approaching all of 2025's total, transferring more climate risk to capital markets investors as wildfire seasons intensify.

headline: P&C carriers widen adoption of AI vendors for underwriting and claims
summary: A roundup of technology usage across the property and casualty sector highlights insurers increasingly deploying AI-driven underwriting, telematics and claims tools from vendors including Cytora and Nauto.

headline: Westfield Specialty hires AIG veteran to lead Nordic distribution push
summary: Westfield Specialty appointed Nicole Preis, formerly a senior client and broker engagement director at AIG, as Head of Distribution for the Nordics, part of the specialty insurer's continued European expansion.

headline: DBS poaches a Standard Chartered veteran to run its India wealth franchise
summary: Singapore's DBS Group has hired former Standard Chartered banker Nitin Chengappa to lead its India wealth management business, betting on rising demand for tailored products from the country's newly rich.

headline: 360 ONE WAM aims to capture a quarter of India's ultra-rich families
summary: India's 360 ONE Wealth, which already serves close to 10% of the country's ultra-high-net-worth market, is targeting a 12-13% share and eventually hopes to reach roughly a quarter of the nation's 40,000-45,000 ultra-wealthy families over the next several years.

headline: Guidewire launches agentic AI framework for insurers to build their own claims and underwriting agents
summary: Guidewire's new Qusar release gives P&C carriers an Agentic Framework to build, deploy and govern AI agents across policy, claims, billing and underwriting workflows, aiming to cut decision times from days to minutes.

headline: UK Regulator Refreshes Superfund Rulebook Ahead of New Pension Schemes Act Regime
summary: The Pensions Regulator issued updated technical guidance for defined-benefit superfunds, including revised funding-level and wind-up-trigger definitions, to bridge the gap before the formal superfund regime created by the Pension Schemes Act 2026 comes into force.

headline: Insurance industry sees a fresh wave of senior appointments across wholesale and program business
summary: A round of executive moves this week spanned wholesale E&S, risk advisory, actuarial leadership and insurtech distribution roles at major brokers and carriers.

headline: Catastrophe bond issuance smashes records as wildfire-exposed deals surge
summary: Cat bond issuance topped $11 billion in the second quarter, the largest quarter on record, with wildfire-exposed issuance for the year climbing past $5 billion as investor appetite for insurance-linked securities keeps growing.

headline: Cover Genius buys German insurtech Friendsurance to expand DACH bancassurance push
summary: Embedded-protection platform Cover Genius acquired Berlin-based Friendsurance, combining its embedded insurance technology with Friendsurance's digital bancassurance and regulatory expertise across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

headline: Specialty carrier Everspan adds three senior leaders across reinsurance and underwriting
summary: Everspan Group named David Kenyon (ex-Zurich) head of reinsurance, Bevan Greibesland (ex-HDI Global) chief underwriting officer, and Forest Clay Stewart (ex-Chubb) chief operating officer, splitting out roles that had previously been combined.

headline: States race to prepare enrollees as Medicaid work-requirement deadline nears
summary: State Medicaid agencies are in a mandated outreach window through August 31 to notify expansion-population members that they must soon document 80 hours a month of work, school or other qualifying activity, with Nebraska already live and national enforcement starting for new applicants in January 2027.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life brings on Michael Bailey as new finance chief
summary: F&G Annuities & Life named Michael Bailey as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer effective August 3, part of a broader executive leadership transition disclosed to the SEC.

headline: American Family to acquire specialty insurer Bowhead Specialty in $1.2 billion deal
summary: American Family agreed to buy the remaining shares of Bowhead Specialty Holdings for $34 per share in cash, a roughly $1.2 billion transaction that deepens its existing partnership with the casualty and professional-liability specialty insurer.

headline: AI advisor tools keep multiplying as Kitces tracks a wave of August product launches
summary: Kitces' August AdvisorTech roundup highlights a new Zeplyn integration with Schwab Advisor Center, Feathery's $30 million raise for workflow automation, and fresh Series A rounds for AI-powered compliance startups Hadrius and Greenboard.

headline: Hospital sector braces for federal funding cuts after a period of financial recovery
summary: Fitch Ratings says the tone across roughly 222 not-for-profit hospitals and health systems has turned more cautious as a multi-year financial recovery meets incoming federal policy cuts and an aging population.

headline: Amwins more than doubles its worldwide catastrophe coverage facility for renewable energy risks
summary: Wholesale broker Amwins Global Risks expanded its natural catastrophe facility to $50 million per placement, up from $20 million, broadening the coverage beyond severe convective storms to earthquake, flood, wildfire, and windstorm risks for renewable energy projects globally.

headline: Report Finds Health Insurers Still Struggle to Personalize Wellness Programs
summary: An industry analysis found many health insurers' wellness and prevention programs remain built on broad demographic segments rather than individualized behavioral and health data, leaving a gap between insurers' stated ambitions for personalized member engagement and what they currently deliver.

headline: Data Firm H1 Teams Up With Novo Nordisk to Speed AI-Driven Clinical Trials
summary: Healthcare data company H1 announced a partnership with pharmaceutical giant Novo Nordisk to apply AI tools to clinical development, aiming to accelerate how the drugmaker identifies researchers, trial sites and patient populations.

headline: Brazil Explores Bringing India's Narayana Health Hospital Model Into Its Public System
summary: Brazilian President Lula met with Narayana Health chairman Dr. Devi Shetty to discuss a possible BRICS-backed partnership that would apply India's low-cost, digitally enabled hospital management approach to Brazil's public healthcare system, potentially involving the New Development Bank.

headline: TWFG expands specialty MGA footprint with APIA acquisition
summary: TWFG Insurance acquired APIA Inc., broadening the insurance distribution holding company's specialty managing general agency capabilities.

headline: Private capital and record demand are reshaping the life insurance and annuity business
summary: Insurance Business America reports insurers are redesigning products and distribution around growing private-capital involvement and sustained consumer demand for annuities as the sector enters a new era.

headline: Shinhan Asset Management's target-date fund series tops 2 trillion won in assets
summary: South Korean retirement savers have poured over 600 billion won into Shinhan's TDF lineup this year alone, pushing total assets past the 2 trillion won mark as investors favor its retirement-timed allocation strategy amid market volatility.

headline: AlphaCore expands into New Jersey with $700 million Brave Family Advisors deal
summary: AlphaCore Wealth Advisory acquired Brave Family Advisors, a $700 million New Jersey RIA founded in 1992, adding eight staff including four advisers and opening AlphaCore's first Summit, NJ office as part of a Northeast expansion push.

headline: Pet insurance MGAs fuel rapid, profitable growth as US penetration still trails Europe
summary: AM Best data shows US pet insurance direct premiums rose 16.5% in Q1 2026 toward a projected $6.4 billion for the year, with managing general agents driving distribution even though penetration remains around 4.6%, far below the UK's 25%-plus and Sweden's nearly 40%.

headline: AI governance becomes central theme as insurers move past experimentation
summary: Insurers are shifting from AI experimentation toward structured adoption, with governance, accountability and decision oversight emerging as central themes at industry events like MGAA 2026 as carriers embed AI into core operational workflows.

headline: Insurtech funding hits four-year high as AI captures 99% of capital
summary: Gallagher Re reported global insurtech funding reached $2.44 billion in Q2 2026, the highest quarterly total in four years, with AI-focused companies capturing 99.1% of all investment and mega-rounds over $100 million driving much of the increase.

headline: India's government raises $3.3 billion selling down its stake in state insurer LIC
summary: New Delhi upsized an offer-for-sale of Life Insurance Corporation of India shares to 6.5% after strong demand, raising roughly $3.3 billion at a discounted price to trim the government's holding toward 90% and meet public-float rules.

headline: CMS finalizes FY2027 hospital inpatient payment rule
summary: CMS's FY2027 Inpatient Prospective Payment System and Long-Term Care Hospital final rule, published in the Federal Register on August 4, 2026, updates Medicare hospital payment rates, revises graduate medical education policy and expands quality reporting requirements ahead of an October 2026 effective date.

headline: Insurers Lean on AI-Driven Underwriting as Catastrophe Claim Severity Hits Records
summary: Conning and other analysts flagged that catastrophe losses remain the top challenge for P&C carriers in 2026, with home-insurance claim severity at record levels, pushing insurers toward AI-assisted risk modeling even as reinsurance capital eases pricing pressure.

headline: PGIM's assets climb to $1.49 trillion as Prudential's Q2 results beat estimates
summary: Prudential Financial's second-quarter 2026 results topped analyst expectations, helped by PGIM's asset management fee income rising on market gains and PGIM's assets under management climbing to $1.49 trillion, up from $1.43 trillion the prior quarter.

headline: Employers weigh underwriters' AI fluency when picking life insurance carriers
summary: A growing share of employers and brokers are factoring an insurer's artificial-intelligence underwriting capabilities into carrier selection, as AI reshapes how life insurance risk gets assessed.

headline: Think tank warns UK pension megafund push won't automatically boost returns
summary: A Pensions Policy Institute study concluded that consolidating UK schemes into megafunds mainly cuts costs rather than reliably delivering higher investment returns, tempering expectations around the government's DC reform agenda.

headline: Property catastrophe reinsurance rates keep falling as capital hits record highs
summary: Property catastrophe reinsurance pricing fell 15-20% across many program layers at the mid-2026 renewals as global reinsurer capital climbed to a record roughly $790 billion, driven largely by growing third-party capital.

headline: Orion launches fractional share trading for advisors custodying with Schwab
summary: Orion rolled out fractional share trading built into its order management system for RIAs custodying with Schwab Advisor Services, letting advisors implement model allocations to the dollar instead of rounding to whole shares.

headline: Health Care Administrators Association names its 2026-2027 board of directors
summary: The HCAA, a trade group for self-funded health plan third-party administrators, appointed its board and officers for the 2026-2027 term, naming Professional Benefit Administrators' Jeff Walter as president to lead advocacy and education efforts for the self-funding industry.

headline: Allianz to buy UOB's asset management arm for about $433M
summary: Allianz Global Investors agreed to acquire United Overseas Bank's asset management unit for roughly S$555 million, part of a push by the German insurer's CEO to expand its footprint across Southeast Asia.

headline: Jackson Financial signals openness to buying a life insurer to diversify beyond annuities
summary: Jackson's incoming CEO Don Cummings indicated the company is open to acquisitions or block deals involving life insurance liabilities as it looks to diversify its business mix beyond its core annuity franchise.

headline: Allianz expands its Asian asset-management footprint by buying UOB's fund unit
summary: Allianz Global Investors agreed to pay roughly $433 million (S$555 million) for United Overseas Bank's asset management arm in Singapore, part of Allianz's push to grow its presence in Asia under its current CEO.

headline: Mubadala-backed RIA giant Corient snaps up $21 billion ultra-wealthy specialist Summit Trail
summary: Miami-based aggregator Corient has agreed to acquire New York's Summit Trail Advisors, a registered investment advisor overseeing roughly $21 billion for ultra-high-net-worth families, with the deal expected to close in the third quarter.

headline: Ascensus Wraps Up Purchase of Retirement-Tech Administrator AmericanTCS
summary: Retirement services giant Ascensus, which administers roughly $930 billion in assets, closed its acquisition of Pittsburgh-based AmericanTCS, adding trust, custody and workflow-automation technology used by third-party administrators, advisers and plan sponsors.

headline: Federated Insurance to Buy Trucking-Focused Insurtech HDVI
summary: Mutual insurer Federated Insurance is acquiring HDVI, a Chicago-based managing general agent that underwrites and services commercial auto coverage for mid-size trucking fleets across roughly 25 states; deal terms were not disclosed.

headline: Indian Insurance Marketplace InsuranceDekho Hires New Group CFO
summary: Online insurance aggregator InsuranceDekho appointed Rohan Mittal, a finance executive with nearly two decades of experience across listed and high-growth companies, as its new Group Chief Financial Officer to oversee capital strategy as it enters its next growth phase.

headline: Specialty insurer rolls out coverage built for AI data centers and crypto mining rigs
summary: A unit of Ryan Specialty launched a new managing general underwriter dedicated to insuring computing hardware used in artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, and cryptocurrency mining operations. The move responds to surging demand for specialty property coverage as data-center and AI infrastructure buildouts accelerate.

headline: Carlyle takes minority stake in Prime Capital Financial at $1.8 billion-plus valuation
summary: Carlyle agreed to provide a $600 million hybrid capital solution and take a minority stake in Prime Capital Financial, valuing the nearly $50 billion-AUM RIA at over $1.8 billion, as prior investor Abry Partners exits its position.

headline: $400 million insurance and benefits brokerage prepares to spin off as standalone company
summary: A roughly $400 million insurance and employee-benefits brokerage business is being spun off from its parent to operate as an independent company.

headline: Standard Life to buy Aegon UK for GBP2bn, creating the UK's largest retirement savings business
summary: Standard Life agreed to acquire Aegon's UK pensions and savings arm in a GBP2 billion deal, forming a combined retirement business serving 16 million customers with roughly GBP480 billion in assets under administration.

headline: Travel-insurance fintech Faye raises $50m Series C to build an AI travel wallet
summary: Faye raised a $50 million Series C led by Madrona at an estimated $500 million valuation, and plans to expand its Faye Wallet product so travelers can manage money and get AI-assisted claims support abroad.

headline: Ahmedabad insurtech InRisk Labs raises $27m Series A
summary: InRisk Labs raised $27 million in a Series A round led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Northpoint Capital, after its reinsurance subsidiary EarthRe became the first incorporated reinsurer licensed at GIFT City's International Financial Services Centre.

headline: InsuranceDekho elevates chief revenue officer Abhishek Bansal to CEO
summary: Indian insurance marketplace InsuranceDekho promoted Chief Revenue Officer Abhishek Bansal to chief executive of its insurance business as part of a broader senior-leadership restructuring.

headline: everyoneINVESTED and Prometeia pair up on behavioral-finance wealthtech
summary: The two wealthtech vendors partnered to embed everyoneINVESTED's behavioral-finance profiling tools into Prometeia's investment-advisory and portfolio-management platform.

headline: Auto Insurance Premiums Set to Climb in 32 States Through Year-End 2026
summary: Rising repair costs, vehicle technology expenses and severe weather claims are projected to push average auto insurance premiums higher in 32 U.S. states by the end of 2026, extending increases already seen in 27 states during the first half of the year.

headline: US annuity sales set new quarterly record as rate and market jitters spur demand
summary: LIMRA reported total US annuity sales climbed 4% year-over-year to a record $123.9 billion in Q2 2026, marking the eleventh straight quarter above $100 billion, with registered index-linked annuities leading growth.

headline: Oscar Health posts record first-half results and lifts its full-year forecast
summary: The ACA-focused insurer reported six-month revenue of $9.53 billion and a 75.0% medical loss ratio, and now guides full-year operating earnings to $500-$700 million with membership near 2.96 million.

headline: Record summer A&E crowding exposes NHS hospital capacity and heat strain
summary: NHS emergency departments logged a record 2.5 million attendances in July amid back-to-back heatwaves, while nearly half of trusts reported ward temperatures above 33C, underscoring capacity and infrastructure pressure on the health service.

headline: Target-date fund assets climb to $5.3 trillion as income-focused series from Vanguard and Transamerica prepare to launch
summary: US target-date fund assets across mutual funds and collective investment trusts grew 11% in the first half of 2026 to $5.3 trillion, with new retirement-income-focused TDF series from Vanguard and Transamerica set to launch later this year.

headline: LIMRA holds $450 billion-plus annuity sales forecast for 2026 despite expected Fed rate cuts
summary: Despite anticipated Federal Reserve rate cuts through the rest of 2026, LIMRA is maintaining its forecast that annuity sales will stay above $450 billion, with registered index-linked annuities on pace to exceed $75 billion as the category keeps growing.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life swings to $81 million Q2 loss as alternative investment income lags
summary: F&G Annuities & Life reported a second-quarter 2026 net loss of $81 million, reversing a year-earlier profit, as softer opportunistic sales margins and underperforming alternative investments weighed on adjusted earnings despite continued strong annuity demand.

headline: Brighthouse Financial's annuities segment earnings climb to $349 million in Q2
summary: Brighthouse Financial's second-quarter 2026 annuities segment adjusted earnings rose to $349 million from $332 million a year earlier, per the insurer's SEC filing, as annuity sales continue to anchor results amid a broader strategic review.

headline: Corient buys $21 billion Summit Trail Advisors in its largest deal yet
summary: Corient, the world's largest multi-family office and non-bank wealth manager with roughly $556 billion in AUM, agreed to acquire ultra-high-net-worth-focused RIA Summit Trail Advisors, deepening its push into the wealthiest client segment.

headline: Retirement plan providers push deeper into AI for personalized participant guidance
summary: Recordkeepers and advisory firms are rolling out AI tools that combine participant data with large language models to deliver real-time, personalized retirement guidance and forecast income shortfalls, even as fiduciary oversight of these new tools becomes a bigger governance concern.

headline: CorVel's claims volumes post their biggest jump in over a year as AI tools scale
summary: CorVel reported that claims volume rose 8% year-over-year in its June quarter, the largest increase since December 2024, as the workers' comp TPA continues rolling out AI-driven summarization and reserve-prediction tools across its CareMC platform.

headline: Parametric insurtech InRisk Labs lands $27 million to expand into climate and cat risk
summary: Ahmedabad-based InRisk Labs raised a $27 million Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Northpoint Capital, money it plans to use to build out underwriting, actuarial and catastrophe-modeling capabilities and push into natural catastrophe, marine cargo and motor lines.

headline: Major insurers post stronger Q2 profits as medical cost trends ease
summary: UnitedHealth Group, Centene and other large payers reported improved second-quarter 2026 results, with UnitedHealth posting roughly $5.4 billion in profit and Centene topping $1 billion as insurers credited better cost management even as Elevance Health's benefit expense ratio worsened.

headline: India's Wealth Managers Court Ultra-Wealthy Clients as Asian Private Banking Evolves
summary: At the India Wealth Management Forum in Mumbai in early August, wealth manager 360 ONE signaled plans to capture a larger share of the country's ultra-high-net-worth market as regional banks lean further into advisory-led, AI-augmented service models.

headline: Consumer Trust in AI-Driven Insurance Nearly Doubles Year Over Year
summary: A new Insurity survey finds 39% of consumers now view AI use by their insurer favorably, almost double last year's figure, with trust rising when AI is applied to underwriting, claims speed and clearer customer interactions alongside human oversight.

headline: Sutter Health and Allina Health Sign Definitive Agreement to Form $26 Billion, 39-Hospital Nonprofit System
summary: Sutter Health and Allina Health signed a definitive agreement to combine into a 39-hospital, $26 billion nonprofit system spanning California, Minnesota and Wisconsin, including a $2 billion investment in the Upper Midwest for ambulatory care and AI capabilities.

headline: MetLife's second-quarter profit climbs 15% as group benefits segment leads growth
summary: MetLife reported second-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings of roughly $1.6 billion, up 15% year over year, with its group benefits unit posting a 25% jump in adjusted earnings on stronger underwriting and volume growth.

headline: Oscar Health's medical loss ratio improves sharply to 79.2% in Q2
summary: Oscar Health's second-quarter 2026 medical loss ratio fell to 79.2% from 91.1% a year earlier, which the ACA-focused insurer attributed to disciplined pricing and $164 million of favorable reserve development.

headline: WellSky debuts dashboards aimed at cutting delayed hospital discharges
summary: Home-health and care-transition software vendor WellSky launched Care Transition Intelligence Dashboards, designed to turn discharge-planning data into actionable insights for hospitals and post-acute providers.

headline: High earners face mandatory Roth catch-up contributions under new 2026 rule
summary: Starting in 2026, workers 50 and older earning above roughly $150,000 from an employer must direct catch-up 401(k) contributions to Roth (after-tax) accounts rather than pre-tax, under a SECURE 2.0 provision taking effect this year.

headline: Catastrophe reinsurance prices post steepest annual drop in 25 years
summary: Global property-catastrophe reinsurance prices fell 16% year-on-year at the June/July renewals -- the largest annual decline since the late 1990s -- as record capital levels pressured pricing even as storm frequency and severity keep climbing.

headline: Keylane acquires UK claims-tech specialist 360Globalnet to bolster its P&C offering
summary: Dutch insurance software provider Keylane bought 360Globalnet, adding its no-code SiteView digital claims platform to help insurers automate claims workflows and digital site visits across Europe, APAC and North America.

headline: Tokio Marine takes minority stake in Singapore insurtech Igloo
summary: Tokio Marine invested about $5 million for a 1.65% equity stake in Igloo, a full-stack insurtech operating across eight Southeast Asian markets, extending the Japanese carrier's push deeper into the region's digital insurance space.

headline: Savvy adds Blue Barn Wealth and Paragon Private Wealth, crossing $8 billion in AUM
summary: The two independent firms bring roughly $550 million in combined assets to Savvy's network, part of a run that has brought in over $4 billion in recruited assets in 2026 and quadrupled the platform's total AUM year over year.

headline: CVS Health tops Q2 estimates and lifts guidance as Aetna shows signs of recovery
summary: CVS Health beat second-quarter earnings and revenue estimates and raised its 2026 guidance as its Aetna insurance unit continued to recover, though shares slipped after the company flagged expected membership declines at Caremark.

headline: Assurant's net investment income jumps 19% in first half of 2026
summary: Assurant reported net investment income of $302.0 million for the first six months of 2026, up from $253.5 million a year earlier, driven by higher yields and larger fixed-maturity holdings.

headline: AI spending in P&C insurance set to triple in 2026, but most carriers still aren't capturing value at scale
summary: Industry surveys show property-casualty insurers tripling AI's share of technology spending in 2026, yet only about 38% report generating value at scale from AI in core underwriting and claims workflows, even as consumer resistance to AI-driven quotes keeps falling.

headline: Finnish pension insurer Veritas posts record 6.9% quarterly return
summary: Veritas Pension Insurance reported a record-high 6.9% return for the second quarter of 2026, adding to signs that European life and pension insurers are benefiting from resilient risk-asset performance.

headline: RIA M&A activity jumps nearly 40% in first half of 2026
summary: Nationwide RIA merger-and-acquisition activity climbed roughly 40% in the first half of 2026 versus a year earlier, with WealthManagement.com pointing to continued consolidation among registered investment advisors heading into 2026 planning season.

headline: Allianz Global Investors completes €376 million acquisition of UOB Asset Management
summary: AllianzGI agreed to acquire Singapore's UOB Asset Management, adding roughly S$42 billion in assets and forming a long-term distribution partnership with UOB to reach the bank's more than eight million regional customers.

headline: Target-date funds near $5 trillion as plans add lifetime-income and private-market features
summary: With assets nearing $5 trillion, target-date funds are being redesigned around personalization, embedded guaranteed-income options, and growing exposure to private markets within employer retirement plans.

headline: Sedgwick report finds FCA claims oversight and AI governance atop UK regulatory agenda
summary: Sedgwick's 2026 Claims Administration Intelligence Report finds the UK's FCA has placed claims outcomes and oversight of outsourced and delegated arrangements at the top of its regulatory agenda, keeping accountability with principal insurers even when claims are outsourced.

headline: Payers post broad Q2 2026 profit gains as medical cost trends ease
summary: UnitedHealth, Cigna, Elevance, Centene and Molina all reported year-over-year profit growth in the second quarter of 2026, with several insurers raising full-year earnings guidance as cost-trend fears eased and stocks rallied off yearly lows.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life posts mixed second-quarter 2026 results
summary: F&G reported a Q2 2026 GAAP net loss of $81 million but adjusted net earnings of $85 million, as the annuity and life insurer navigated realized investment losses against steady underlying growth.

headline: Gallagher expands into Canadian digital tenant insurance with Apollo Insurance Solutions buy
summary: Arthur J. Gallagher announced the acquisition of Vancouver-based Apollo Insurance Solutions, a digital broker and MGA that uses an AI-driven platform to place tenant insurance across Canada, with terms of the deal undisclosed.

headline: AMN Healthcare beats guidance as travel-nurse and search revenue rebound
summary: AMN Healthcare's second-quarter revenue and earnings topped guidance, with travel nursing, allied staffing and physician search and locum tenens demand all growing year-over-year.

headline: Swiss Re's life and health reinsurance profit climbs to $1.05 billion in first half of 2026
summary: Swiss Re reported first-half 2026 net income of $2.8 billion, up 9% year-over-year, with its life and health reinsurance segment posting $1.05 billion in profit versus $839 million a year earlier, aided by disciplined underwriting and a benign catastrophe environment.

summary: Former MoneyLion executives launched Astraeus, an AI-native infrastructure platform built around a semantic layer that encodes relationships between clients, advisers, accounts and regulatory requirements for advisory firms, backed by more than $10 million in funding.

headline: Zurich's P&C business posts record first half as capital strength climbs
summary: Zurich Insurance's property and casualty segment delivered its strongest first-half performance on record, with business operating profit rising 16% to $2.8 billion, while the group's Swiss Solvency Test ratio climbed to 266%, well above its 160% minimum target.

headline: Rockefeller adds $2.1 billion Merrill team in Columbus expansion
summary: Rockefeller Capital Management's Global Family Office recruited a multigenerational, multibillion-dollar advisory team led by Sidney Jones from Merrill, extending Rockefeller's wealth management footprint into a new Columbus, Ohio office.

headline: The Institutes names Gen Re CEO Kara Raiguel to chair its board
summary: Industry education group The Institutes appointed Gen Re President and CEO Kara Raiguel to chair its Board of Trustees, with Selective's John Marchioni and Tokio Marine HCC's Susan Rivera joining as vice chairs.

headline: AI-focused startups captured 99% of Q2 2026 insurtech funding

headline: Zurich secures $1bn reinsurance backstop for its data-center portfolio
summary: Zurich Insurance entered a new quota-share reinsurance arrangement providing up to $1 billion of capacity to support its fast-growing data-center construction and property book, as AI-driven demand for data-center coverage surges.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life posts GAAP loss on mark-to-market swings despite strong retail annuity demand
summary: F&G reported an $81 million net loss for the second quarter of 2026 driven by mark-to-market effects, even as core retail annuity sales of $1.8 billion outperformed a contracting fixed indexed annuity market.

headline: APAC Warranty & Indemnity Insurance Claims Surge as Rates Hit Record Lows
summary: Data from Aon, Marsh and Gallagher show APAC transactional-risk insurance claim notifications jumped 76% year-on-year in 2025, with Marsh clients alone collecting over $80 million in payouts even as W&I and tax liability premium rates sank to record lows.

headline: Insurers file for a second straight year of double-digit ACA marketplace price hikes
summary: New preliminary filings across all 50 states show insurers proposing a median 15% premium increase for 2027 plans, following a roughly 20% jump in 2026, with insurers citing hospital and drug cost growth, GLP-1 spending, and continued uncertainty over expired enhanced subsidies.

headline: AI-native brokerage network American Growth Insurance makes first agency acquisition

summary: US wealthtech companies raised $557.8 million across 91 deals in the second quarter of 2026, down 41% from the prior quarter and 54% below the same period a year earlier, even as deal count actually rose, pointing to investors making more, smaller bets.

headline: Private credit now the largest slice of life insurer bond portfolios as NAIC tightens oversight

headline: UK DC schemes face a 2030 deadline to reach £25bn 'megafund' scale
summary: Under the Pension Schemes Act 2026, multi-employer defined contribution schemes running a main default arrangement must build assets to at least £25 billion by 2030 to keep qualifying for automatic-enrolment contributions, pushing the market toward consolidation.

headline: AI-native brokerage network AGI closes its first acquisition with Heller-Kowitz buy
summary: Atlanta-based American Growth Insurance completed its first acquisition, picking up Baltimore agency Heller-Kowitz across personal lines, commercial lines, benefits and life, a year after building and testing its AI-driven operating model.

headline: Federated Mutual Acquires Trucking Insurtech HDVI to Expand Telematics-Based Coverage
summary: Federated Mutual Insurance acquired High Definition Vehicle Insurance (HDVI), a technology-first commercial trucking insurer that uses telematics data for underwriting, with HDVI continuing to operate as a largely autonomous subsidiary.

headline: S&P sees India's insurance sector poised for 'massive' long-term growth despite near-term headwinds
summary: S&P Global Ratings said structural reforms, low insurance penetration and a supportive regulatory environment should drive substantial long-term growth for India's insurance industry, even as slowing economic growth and profitability pressures pose near-term risks.

headline: India's general insurance industry grows 9% to reach Rs 3.36 lakh crore in FY26
summary: India's general insurance sector closed FY26 with gross direct premium income up 9% year-on-year to roughly Rs 3.36 lakh crore, with private insurers, including standalone health insurers, growing faster than public-sector peers.

headline: FCA wealth management survey pushes discretionary managers on tech and governance
summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority published a wealth management survey report urging discretionary portfolio managers to use technology responsibly, tighten financial-crime controls and ensure governance keeps pace with growth.

headline: LIC posts 23% profit jump in Q1 as new business value surges 61%
summary: India's Life Insurance Corporation reported a 23% year-on-year rise in net profit to roughly Rs 13,492 crore for the June quarter, with value of new business up 61% and premium income growing nearly 7%.

headline: CVS raises 2026 earnings outlook again as Aetna's insurance recovery accelerates
summary: CVS Health lifted its full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $7.90-$8.10, its second raise this year, as improved medical-cost management at Aetna and strength across its pharmacy and retail segments drove the beat-and-raise quarter.

headline: Trump executive order pushes 401(k) access to private equity and crypto
summary: President Trump signed an executive order on August 7 directing the Department of Labor, SEC and Treasury to review and revise guidance to make it easier for participant-directed 401(k) plans to include alternative investments such as private equity and cryptocurrency.

headline: Great Eastern's Singapore business outpaces Malaysia recovery in first half
summary: Great Eastern reported first-half 2026 weighted new sales up 15% year over year to S$813.2 million, led by strong Singapore agency growth, while its Malaysia unit posted more modest gains amid softer product demand.

headline: Health Affairs proposal calls for a "Fair Pay, Fair Play" overhaul of TPA regulation
summary: A Health Affairs proposal argues Congress should give self-funded employers a more accountable, transparent alternative to today's third-party administrators, most of which are owned by large insurers and carry less scrutiny than PBMs.

headline: Rockefeller Poaches 14-Person, $2 Billion Merrill Lynch Team in Ohio
summary: Rockefeller Capital Management's Global Family Office unit recruited Jones Wealth Partners, a Merrill Lynch team managing about $2 billion in assets led by 43-year Merrill veteran Sidney Jones, expanding Rockefeller's Ohio footprint with a new Columbus office.

headline: LIC of India's profit jumps 24% on strong new-business premium growth
summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India's consolidated net profit rose nearly 24% to roughly Rs 13,584 crore for the quarter ended June 2026, with new-business premium up almost 7%, even as the state-run insurer proceeds with an August offer-for-sale of shares.

headline: European wildfires expose widening insurance protection gap
summary: A summer of record wildfires across France, Spain and Greece is pushing insurers including Zurich and Munich Re to warn that Europe's disaster-recovery costs are increasingly outpacing available insurance coverage.

headline: Motilal Oswal AMC crosses Rs 2 lakh crore in assets on a wave of new SIPs
summary: Motilal Oswal Asset Management said its combined mutual fund, AIF and PMS assets surpassed Rs 2 lakh crore as of early August 2026, after adding more than 56 lakh new systematic investment plans and about Rs 16,479 crore of SIP inflows during FY2026.

headline: PIMCO keeps drawing outside client cash as top shareholder Allianz raises its stake
summary: PIMCO pulled in 31.7 billion euros of third-party net inflows in the second quarter and continued gathering assets into July, even as parent Allianz moved to increase its ownership stake in the asset manager.

headline: Black Book flags Europe's highest-risk hospital markets for cyberattacks
summary: A new Black Book Research report on Europe's healthcare cybersecurity hotspots identifies the continent's most exposed hospital markets, citing ransomware, thin supplier diversity and slow recovery as recurring risks to patient safety.

headline: Fidelity to add a guaranteed-income sleeve to its Freedom target-date fund lineup
summary: Fidelity is expanding its Freedom Lifetime series with an insurance-backed guaranteed income option supported by Nationwide and New York Life, blending active and index funds ahead of an early-2027 rollout.

headline: Japan's largest life insurers report $96 billion in unrealized bond losses

headline: T. Rowe Price's target-date retirement funds top $622 billion in assets through mid-2026

summary: State-run insurer LIC reported a 23% year-on-year rise in first-quarter net profit to roughly Rs 13,492 crore, with value of new business surging 61% and margins expanding nearly 750 basis points.

summary: The insurer launched an eApp designed to simplify and speed up annuity application and submission for agents and clients, part of a broader digital modernization push across the life and annuity sector.

summary: Zurich arranged a $1 billion quota-share reinsurance placement to support its growing book of underwriting risk tied to data centers, part of a broader trend of insurers building capacity for technology-infrastructure exposures.

summary: Asset manager Artisan Partners disclosed preliminary AUM of roughly $183 billion as of July 31, 2026, in a regulatory filing.

summary: The August 12 gathering will bring together CEOs, family-office leaders and advisers from India, Singapore and the UAE to discuss next-gen wealth transfer, HNW insurance and AI adoption in advisory practices.

summary: A new study finds legacy recordkeeping infrastructure is straining under demand for better participant tools, with consulting estimates suggesting AI-driven modernization could save the retirement and pension industry $16 billion to $20 billion in operating costs.

headline: Amynta adds century-old agribusiness MGU Southern States Underwriters
summary: Amynta Group agreed to buy Southern States Underwriters, a Virginia-based agriculture-focused MGU founded in 1953, in a deal expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026 with existing leadership staying on.

headline: US regulators edge closer to a formal oversight regime for third-party AI vendors
summary: At the NAIC's Summer National Meeting, the Third-Party Data and Models Working Group narrowed a proposed oversight framework to focus first on pricing and underwriting vendors, weighing whether registration should be voluntary and whether the outcome should be a model law or a bulletin.

headline: AI-native insurance verification clearinghouse Axle quadruples prior funding total
summary: Axle, which runs an AI-native clearinghouse for insurance verification, raised $17.5 million in new funding, roughly four times its total prior fundraising, as part of a busy mid-August week of insurance and insurtech dealmaking.

headline: Singapore insurers confront surging medical inflation at industry summit
summary: AIA Singapore's inaugural Healthcare Summit in August 2026 gathered policymakers and health leaders to address affordability pressures, as medical inflation projections and concerns among Singapore residents about rising healthcare costs mount.

headline: Indian hospital stocks slide on proposal to cap room rents at hotel rates
summary: Shares of Apollo Hospitals, Max Healthcare and Fortis fell as much as 7% after a parliamentary standing committee recommended capping private hospital room charges at three-star hotel rates as part of an affordability push.

headline: Treasury and IRS issue standardized rollover paperwork under SECURE 2.0
summary: Treasury and the IRS released new sample forms and safe-harbor explanations to simplify direct rollovers between retirement plans, implementing a requirement from Section 324 of SECURE 2.0.

headline: Insurity teams up with ITS to help carriers close the gap between buying tech and actually running it
summary: Cloud software provider Insurity partnered with Insurance Technology Services to pair its carrier, broker and MGA platform with hands-on implementation consulting, targeting insurers' struggles to execute complex technology rollouts.

headline: US annuity sales set a new quarterly record of $123.9 billion in Q2 2026
summary: LIMRA reports total US annuity sales rose 4% year-over-year to a record $123.9 billion in the second quarter of 2026, the eleventh straight quarter above $100 billion, with registered index-linked annuities also setting a quarterly record at $23.3 billion.

headline: Insurers keep tilting portfolios toward private credit as spreads stay historically tight
summary: A 2026 insurance asset management trends report finds private fixed income has surged 141% since 2021 and is now the second-largest asset category, as insurers chase illiquidity premiums with public credit spreads compressed.

headline: Gallagher Bassett warns of a ‘structural’ shift in claims costs as AI adoption accelerates
summary: Gallagher Bassett's 2026 Carrier Perspective report finds North American insurers facing a structural, not cyclical, shift in claims costs as social and medical inflation, catastrophe losses and rapid AI adoption converge.

headline: HSBC's global insurance chief to depart after two decades at the bank
summary: Edward Moncreiffe is leaving HSBC's global insurance business for external opportunities after 20 years, with the bank reportedly planning to split his responsibilities between two regional executives.

headline: Auto insurance rates resume climbing across more than half of US states
summary: After easing in 2025, car insurance premiums are rising again in over half the country, with Connecticut drivers facing the steepest year-over-year increase at 15%, driven by higher repair costs and inflation, per Insurify data.

headline: Specialty reinsurer Pelagos misses Q2 estimates on Middle East and Qatar catastrophe losses
summary: Pelagos reported second-quarter operating earnings well below analyst consensus after $162 million in catastrophe and large losses, including charges tied to the Middle East conflict and a Qatar gas-plant explosion, weighed on underwriting results.

headline: FE fundinfo accelerates rollout of its Nexus adviser platform
summary: FE fundinfo is stepping up investment in Nexus for Financial Advisers, its AI-powered workflow platform, with plans to add more than 25 new capabilities before the end of 2026.

headline: CVS Caremark survey finds employers leaning harder on PBMs to fight drug costs
summary: A CVS Caremark and Employee Benefit News survey found 88% of employers see PBMs as well-positioned to curb prescription drug costs, with GLP-1 access and biosimilar adoption among employers' top concerns.

headline: Shinhan Asset Management's target-date funds near $15 billion as Korean investors favor long-horizon strategies
summary: Shinhan Asset Management's two qualified target-date fund series held a combined 2.02 trillion won (about $14.6 billion) as of mid-August, with the firm's investment head urging long-term TDF investing over market timing.

headline: NAIC Advances AI Risk Evaluation Tool for Insurer Market Conduct Exams
summary: The NAIC's Big Data and Artificial Intelligence Working Group is briefing regulators on its AI Systems Evaluation Tool, currently piloted by a dozen states through a market-conduct-exam program running January through September 2026, with statehouse adoption expected at the Fall National Meeting.

headline: Insurers keep squeezing higher yields from reinvested portfolios in Q2 earnings
summary: AIG reported its annualized investment yield rose 30 basis points to 4.72% with new-money yields running about 60 basis points above sales and maturities, while Selective Insurance's after-tax net investment income jumped 18% year-over-year to $119 million.

headline: Thoma Bravo to acquire broker platform Accelerant Holdings in $4 billion-plus buyout
summary: Private equity firm Thoma Bravo agreed to acquire Accelerant Holdings at a 49% premium to its prior closing price, an enterprise value topping $4 billion, in one of the largest insurance distribution buyouts announced this year.

headline: Bolt launches AI-powered insurance distribution platform for agencies and carriers
summary: InsurTech Bolt rolled out what it calls the sector's first AI-powered distribution platform, aimed at helping independent agencies, brokerages and carriers cut manual tasks and move deals faster.

headline: AI cuts underwriting cycle times but widens gap between insurers and disrupted agents
summary: Panelists report AI-driven underwriting platforms now pull data from electronic health records, prescription histories and wearables to render near-instant decisions, cutting underwriting and claims processing times by up to 40% — even as the same tools reshape, and in some cases threaten, the traditional agent's role.

headline: RGA's investment income strengthens as new-money yields climb past 6%
summary: Reinsurance Group of America's second-quarter 2026 earnings showed new money yields of about 6.02% and variable investment income returns of roughly 15%, underscoring how persistently higher interest rates continue to lift reinsurer and insurer portfolio income.

headline: Playbook rolls out AI workflow-orchestration platform for advisory firms
summary: Formerly known as Powder, Playbook launched an AI orchestration platform that lets RIAs, family offices and wealth firms automate complex operational workflows and continuously refine them.

headline: nsur.ai debuts AI underwriting assistant built for P&C carriers and MGAs
summary: Startup nsur.ai announced general availability of an AI Underwriting Assistant designed to plug into insurers' and MGAs' existing systems rather than replace them, aiming to speed up property-casualty submission handling.

headline: Thoma Bravo takes specialty insurtech Accelerant private in a deal above $4 billion
summary: Private equity firm Thoma Bravo signed a definitive agreement to acquire Accelerant Holdings for roughly $20.25 a share in cash, a nearly 49% premium, taking the data-driven specialty-risk exchange private in a transaction expected to close in the first half of 2027.

headline: NHS A&E departments log busiest month on record amid summer heatwaves
summary: England's NHS saw roughly 2.5 million A&E attendances in July 2026, the busiest month ever recorded, alongside record ambulance call volumes, even as four-hour treatment performance improved slightly month over month.

headline: Manulife taps Brett Marchand to lead its wealth business as Canada Retirement gets interim chief
summary: Manulife Wealth & Asset Management named Brett Marchand President and CEO of Manulife Wealth, succeeding Richard McIntyre, while Erica Hall steps in to lead the Canada Retirement business on an interim basis.

headline: AI clearinghouse startup Axle banks $17.5M Series A to expand insurance workflow automation
summary: Axle raised a $17.5 million Series A led by Base10 Partners, with Y Combinator and Cover Genius founders among backers, to grow its AI agents that automate insurance verification and policy-update workflows across more coverage segments.

headline: Alignment Healthcare moves to dismiss whistleblower suit alleging it inflated earnings
summary: Alignment Healthcare filed a motion to dismiss a lawsuit from a former chief data officer who alleges the Medicare Advantage insurer misclassified $8-10 million in expenses to inflate EBITDA and boost its stock price and executive bonuses.

headline: HHS announces $102 million to expand community health centers
summary: HHS awarded $102 million in New Access Points funding on Aug. 13 to expand the Health Center Program, aiming to bring primary care access to nearly 1 million more Americans.

headline: Lemonade extends its Tesla Full Self-Driving insurance discount to Tennessee
summary: Lemonade brought its Autonomous Car product, which gives Tesla owners 50% off insurance costs for miles driven under Full Self-Driving supervision, to Tennessee, its fifth state since the January 2026 launch.

headline: EIOPA elects Bank of Greece supervisor Stavros Konstantas to its Management Board
summary: Konstantas, director of occupational and private insurance supervision at the Bank of Greece, begins a two-and-a-half-year term on the EU insurance and pensions regulator's board, succeeding Ante Zigman after his move to lead Croatia's central bank.

headline: NAIC's property and casualty panel wraps summer session in Columbus
summary: The NAIC's Property and Casualty Insurance (C) Committee held its summer national meeting session on August 14 in Columbus, continuing regulatory work on catastrophe risk mitigation and market-conduct oversight.

headline: Weekly fintech funding climbs to $808 million as summer deal flow holds up
summary: Fintech venture funding rose to roughly $808 million across a dozen deals in the second week of August, up from about $673 million the prior week, as investor appetite for vertical fintech continues into late summer.

headline: Etiqa Insurance Singapore names Claudia Soh as permanent CEO
summary: Etiqa Insurance Singapore confirmed Claudia Soh as chief executive effective mid-August, after she spent six months serving as acting CEO while continuing as the insurer's chief financial officer.

headline: India's pension regulator sets goal to grow NPS subscribers more than 30-fold
summary: PFRDA chairman Sivasubramanian Ramann outlined a target to expand non-government NPS subscribers from about 9 million to 350-400 million within five years, leaning on the StAR NPS digital platform, expanded distribution, and four newly approved pension funds.

headline: Aon expands Ben Rolfe's remit to chief broking officer for the Pacific
summary: Aon broadened commercial risk leader Ben Rolfe's role to chief broking officer for the Pacific, part of a wave of senior leadership moves across APAC brokers including Suncorp, QBE and WTW.

headline: Sixfold and Sollers partner to bring AI underwriting to more carriers
summary: AI underwriting platform Sixfold teamed up with policy administration provider Sollers to embed AI-driven risk assessment more deeply into carriers' existing underwriting workflows.

headline: Protective Life lines up CEO succession as Bielen prepares to retire
summary: Protective Life Corporation announced that longtime chief executive Rich Bielen will retire at the end of 2026, with current president and CFO Paul Wells named to take over as president and CEO starting January 1, 2027.

headline: Apollo Hospitals extends outpatient care to all seven days a week
summary: Apollo Hospitals launched 'Always Open, Always Here,' opening outpatient consultations, diagnostics and scheduled procedures on Sundays across its network, a move it bills as a first for Indian healthcare aimed at reducing weekday wait times.

headline: Retirement Industry Sees Fresh Round of Executive Moves in Mid-August
summary: PLANADVISER's latest roundup of retirement-industry personnel changes highlights a new set of appointments and departures across recordkeepers, asset managers and advisory firms for the week of August 14, 2026.

headline: Hartford HealthCare Scales PatientGPT AI Assistant to Reach Over One Million Patients
summary: Hartford HealthCare is inviting more than a million adult patients to use its HHC PatientGPT natural-language health assistant by year-end, in one of the largest patient-facing generative AI rollouts by a U.S. health system to date.

headline: Chubb pursues insurance market's first annual aggregate cyber catastrophe bond
summary: Chubb is seeking annual aggregate cyber reinsurance protection through a new East Lane Re VII catastrophe bond, which would become the first aggregate cyber cat bond in the market's history as capital markets take on more cyber-loss risk.

headline: Hong Kong's new crypto rules could open an $82 billion insurance opportunity
summary: New digital-asset regulation in Hong Kong is creating a potential market for insurers to cover crypto custody, exchange and institutional-holding risk, as the territory positions itself as a digital-asset hub.

headline: Providence Health Plan to shut down entirely after Medicare Advantage sale collapses
summary: The Renton, Washington-based nonprofit's roughly 440,000-member health plan will wind down after talks with an unnamed carrier to keep its Medicare Advantage book alive fell apart; coverage continues without interruption through the end of 2026.

headline: India's life insurers see brighter FY27 outlook after GST relief on retail policies
summary: Industry commentary citing HDFC Life's chairman points to healthy life insurance demand ahead, aided by India's favorable demographics and the recent removal of GST on retail life insurance products, which has improved affordability for buyers.

headline: InsuranceDekho elevates revenue chief to head its insurance distribution unit
summary: Online insurance marketplace InsuranceDekho promoted Chief Revenue Officer Abhishek Bansal to CEO of its core Insurance Business and hired Joyeeta Ghosal as Head of Marketing, as part of a broader leadership reshuffle.

headline: Employers increasingly ditch the 'Big Three' PBMs, survey shows
summary: A National Alliance of Healthcare Purchaser Coalitions survey released in mid-August found the share of employers using Express Scripts, CVS Caremark or Optum Rx dropped from 63% to 54% year over year, with smaller employers driving the exodus to upstart pharmacy benefit managers.

headline: States race to notify Medicaid enrollees ahead of new work requirements
summary: State Medicaid agencies must conduct enrollee outreach between June 30 and August 31, 2026 about incoming federal work requirements, which researchers project could cause more than 5 million people to lose coverage by 2034.

headline: IRDAI Grants New Insurer License and Expands Foreign Investment Rules
summary: India's insurance regulator IRDAI issued a fresh general insurance registration to ProTec General Insurance and continued implementing reforms allowing up to 100% foreign ownership of insurers under the country's amended insurance laws.

headline: Gallagher maps how AI and shifting demand are reshaping life and annuity carriers
summary: A Gallagher analysis of the life and annuities sector highlights how carriers are adopting AI-driven underwriting and product innovation to respond to changing consumer expectations and demographic shifts.

headline: Medicare Advantage loss ratios climbed to a five-year high in 2025
summary: A market review finds Medicare Advantage combined loss ratios reached 90.3% in 2025, the highest in five years, adding pressure on insurer margins even as 2026 rate adjustments are expected to offer some relief.

headline: Wealth Enhancement adds $210 million Oklahoma RIA Servo Wealth Management
summary: The Minneapolis-based consolidator closed its acquisition of Servo Wealth Management on August 15, 2026, reuniting the Oklahoma City team with former colleagues already at the firm and pushing its total client assets further past $160 billion.

headline: Exer AI expands Mayo Clinic partnership to widen clinical AI tool deployment
summary: Exer AI broadened its partnership with Mayo Clinic to further integrate its AI-powered movement-assessment technology into orthopaedic clinical workflows.

headline: TPAs push beyond claims handling into prevention and AI-powered risk management
summary: Gallagher Bassett argues third-party administrators are shifting from reactive claims processing toward proactive risk prevention, pre-loss consulting and AI-driven claims tools as carriers face rising claim severity and complexity.

headline: Retirement income council calls decumulation the next frontier for defined-contribution plans
summary: The Institutional Retirement Income Council outlined five moves plan sponsors should make now to help participants convert savings into retirement income, as the industry's attention shifts from asset accumulation to drawdown.

headline: AI-native advisor platform Jump raises $80 million Series B
summary: Jump, an AI platform for financial advisors, raised an $80 million Series B led by Insight Partners with participation from F-Prime Capital and Allianz Life Ventures, four times the size of its Series A.

headline: Brokers rate the MGAs that stood out in 2026 in Insurance Business Canada's annual review
summary: Insurance Business Canada opened its 10th annual Brokers on MGAs evaluation, inviting brokers to score managing general agents on underwriting responsiveness, technical expertise, compensation and claims support.

headline: India's wealth managers grapple with fragmented data as portfolios grow more complex
summary: Industry panelists at a Hubbis discussion said rapid wealth creation and intergenerational transfer are exposing gaps in Indian wealth managers' legacy data and operating systems, pushing firms toward consolidated platforms and AI tools.

headline: Zurich and Farmers Exchanges to acquire MetLife's U.S. property and casualty business for $3.9 billion
summary: Zurich Insurance and the Farmers Exchanges agreed to buy MetLife's U.S. P&C operations for roughly $3.9 billion, part of a broader wave of targeted, capital-efficient consolidation among carriers this year.

headline: Hightower taps data infrastructure startup Dispatch to unify records across its advisory network
summary: Hightower Advisors selected fintech Dispatch to synchronize client data across custodians for its Hightower Signature Wealth channel, which has scaled to roughly $35 billion in assets across 30 locations as the firm consolidates breakaway advisor teams.

headline: Vanguard deepens its push into financial advice with deal to acquire digital RIA platform Altruist
summary: Vanguard, under CEO Salim Ramji, is moving further into financial advice through an agreement to acquire Altruist, seen as an attempt to reshape the RIA custody and advice landscape, though analysts say winning over independent advisors may prove challenging.

headline: Singapore digital insurer KoverNow secures Hong Kong license and launches local app
summary: KoverNow, a Singapore-headquartered digital insurer specializing in luxury-goods coverage, obtained an insurance intermediary license from Hong Kong's Insurance Authority and launched its mobile app in the market.

headline: Insurtech funding tops $3 billion in 2026 as AI-native platforms dominate deal flow
summary: Total insurtech funding has reached roughly $3 billion in 2026 to date, with AI-focused companies capturing the overwhelming majority of venture dollars as round sizes climb well above 2025 levels.

headline: Elevance Health becomes latest insurer to trim 2026 revenue expectations amid cost pressure
summary: Elevance Health lowered its 2026 revenue expectations, joining other national payers in signaling continued cost pressure even as some insurers point to improving medical-loss-ratio trends heading into year-end.

headline: Health systems scale Microsoft Dragon Copilot past 100,000 clinicians
summary: More than 100,000 clinicians now use Microsoft's Dragon Copilot ambient documentation assistant, with adopting health systems reporting significant reductions in charting time and after-hours documentation burden.

headline: Marpai recognized among 2025's top health-plan third-party administrators
summary: Marpai was named a top health-plan third-party administrator for 2025 by Insurance Business Review Magazine, recognition the company is highlighting as it competes for self-funded employer business.

headline: New federal law extends fee-disclosure rules to TPAs and PBMs starting 2028
summary: The Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2026 amends ERISA's service-provider compensation disclosure requirements to apply directly to third-party administrators and pharmacy benefit managers beginning in 2028, part of a broader shift redistributing PBM profits toward plan sponsors.

headline: Only 7% of health systems have dedicated software to manage prior authorizations, survey finds
summary: A survey highlighted in Healthcare IT Today found just 7% of provider organizations have dedicated software for managing prior authorizations, even as AI tools like Microsoft's Dragon Copilot cut clinical documentation time by double digits at systems including Intermountain Health.

headline: India's insurers pivot toward prevention and AI-driven coverage design
summary: Indian health insurers are reorienting products around preventive care and wellness, using AI and automation to speed claims and build more personalized, digital-first coverage as medical costs climb.

headline: CVS Health refreshes its board, adding a JPMorgan data chief as a director departs
summary: CVS Health said it will add JPMorgan Chase's chief data and analytics officer, Teresa Heitsenrether, to its board this fall, shortly after another director resigned from the board without citing any disagreement with the company.

headline: Private equity's buying spree of doctor practices cools sharply
summary: PitchBook data show private-equity acquisitions of physician practices on pace to roughly halve in 2026 versus 2025, down from a 2021 peak of 851 deals to about 105 in the first half of the year, as more than a dozen states tighten oversight of such transactions.

headline: Bolt launches industry's first AI-powered insurance distribution platform spanning admitted, E&S and wholesale
summary: Insurtech Bolt introduced Connected Distribution, an AI-driven platform unifying customer data, quoting, binding and servicing workflows for agencies, brokerages and carriers across all distribution channels.

headline: Private credit consolidation gathers pace as asset managers race to scale platforms
summary: Dealmaking among private credit managers has accelerated through 2026, with firms pursuing mergers to build scale and breadth even as skeptics raise concerns about underwriting standards across the fast-growing asset class.

headline: Guy Carpenter names global property and casualty leaders in newly created roles
summary: Guy Carpenter appointed David Duffy as global property leader and Chris Ross as global casualty leader, two newly created roles meant to mobilize the reinsurance broker's best practices for clients across the property-casualty market.

headline: Broker confidence in specialist MGAs for commercial motor risk climbs sharply
summary: A survey found nearly four in 10 brokers now have much higher confidence placing specialist commercial motor risks with MGAs than a year ago, as the sector plugs capacity gaps left behind by traditional carriers.

headline: India's Centricity raises $33 million to grow its wealth-management platform
summary: Centricity, an India-based wealthtech platform built for finance and investment professionals, closed a roughly $33 million funding round to accelerate growth of its wealth-management technology.

headline: Insurance broker deal-making slows to its weakest half-year pace in a decade
summary: OPTIS Partners found that insurance agency and brokerage M&A activity fell 15% in the first half of 2026 versus a year earlier, with just 292 deals recorded, the slowest start to a year since 2016, even as private equity buyers still accounted for more than half of all acquirers.

headline: Centene's finance chief to exit as insurer manages ACA turbulence
summary: Centene said its longtime CFO will step down, with a successor named to take over as the Medicaid- and ACA-focused insurer works through subsidy expiration and enrollment declines affecting the marketplace business.

headline: NHS opens flu jab bookings early to get ahead of winter pressures
summary: The NHS began urging eligible groups, including pregnant women and children, to pre-book flu vaccinations from August 17 for a September 1 start, moving earlier than usual after a summer of record emergency demand.

headline: Resolution Re books another UK pension risk transfer deal as it expands across Europe
summary: Reinsurer Resolution Re closed a fresh UK bulk annuity transaction, continuing to build out its footprint in the region as insurers compete for pension scheme risk-transfer business.

headline: Health Net's move to end an assisted-living benefit leaves thousands of Medi-Cal seniors scrambling
summary: Centene's Health Net told California regulators it will eliminate a CalAIM assisted-living support benefit for roughly 3,500 Medi-Cal members by year's end, citing rising costs, a decision advocates warn could leave some elderly residents without housing options.

headline: Atrium Health-WakeMed merger draws public pushback at Raleigh hearing
summary: A public hearing on the proposed Atrium Health-WakeMed combination drew mixed reaction in Raleigh, with some speakers welcoming the deal's promised $2 billion investment and others criticizing it as a takeover of the community-owned system.

headline: AE Wealth Management names Shannon Larson president in push toward $250B goal
summary: AE Wealth Management appointed Shannon Larson as president, tasked with scaling its roughly $52 billion RIA network of 600 advisors toward a stated goal of $250 billion in assets by 2035 through organic growth and technology investment.

headline: Corebridge Financial and Equitable Holdings name leadership team as $22 billion merger advances
summary: The two insurers announced the executive team that will run the combined retirement, life, wealth and asset management company after shareholders of both firms approved the all-stock deal in late July.

headline: MAI Capital enters Atlanta market with $490 million Waypoint Wealth Counsel acquisition
summary: The Cleveland-based RIA, backed by a recent Carlyle investment, added the fee-only Atlanta firm and its more than 100 households, giving Waypoint's founders access to MAI's family-office platform, lending and alternative-investment sourcing.

headline: US individual life insurance sales grow 3% in Q2 2026 as variable universal life leads
summary: Individual life insurance new annualized premium rose 3% year-over-year in the second quarter of 2026, with variable universal life posting the sharpest growth (up 11% to $800 million) and simplified-issue and final-expense products seeing double-digit policy-count growth among lower- and middle-income buyers.

headline: Munich Re to acquire cyber insurtech At-Bay for $575 million, folding it into HSB
summary: Munich Re agreed to buy US cyber insurtech At-Bay, the largest wholesale-channel writer of cyber insurance, for $575 million, placing it within its Hartford Steam Boiler specialty subsidiary to strengthen its cyber risk and proactive-security offering.

headline: Delaware Life and Clear Spring probed over $17 billion in reclassified related-party investments
summary: Federal prosecutors and the SEC are examining whether the two Group 1001 insurers, controlled by Dodgers/Lakers owner Mark Walter, properly disclosed that roughly 39% of their invested assets -- about $17 billion -- were tied to Walter-affiliated companies rather than the 3% originally reported to regulators.

headline: Willis Re buys BMS Re's US arm to plant its flag stateside
summary: Willis Re agreed to acquire the US reinsurance broking division of BMS Group, gaining six US offices and specialty expertise in property catastrophe, medical malpractice and workers' comp reinsurance.

headline: Geopolitical shocks and AI adoption are squeezing how insurers price risk
summary: Global economic and geopolitical volatility, combined with six straight years of catastrophe losses topping $100 billion, is forcing insurers to rethink commercial-line pricing models as new exposures and data sources upend established underwriting assumptions.

headline: Costco makes first-ever move into Medicare with SCAN Health Plan partnership
summary: Costco Wholesale and nonprofit insurer SCAN Group unveiled a partnership to sell co-branded Medicare Advantage plans in two states and a Medicare supplement plan in a third, pending regulatory approval, marking the retailer's debut in the senior health plan market.

headline: Medicare Advantage member satisfaction hits new low, J.D. Power finds
summary: J.D. Power's 2026 Medicare Advantage study shows overall member satisfaction fell 12 points on its 1,000-point scale, a 41-point drop from 2024, with fewer than half of members saying they trust their plan.

headline: Willis Re Agrees to Acquire BMS Re US in Reinsurance Broking Expansion
summary: Willis Re announced plans to acquire BMS Re US, a move aimed at accelerating its geographic growth in the U.S. reinsurance broking market.

headline: Thoma Bravo to Take Specialty Insurer Accelerant Private in $4 Billion-Plus Deal
summary: Private equity firm Thoma Bravo agreed to acquire specialty insurance platform Accelerant Holdings in an all-cash take-private deal valuing the company at more than $4 billion, at a 49% premium to its prior closing share price.

headline: Alliant moves to buy AI benefits platform Nava, betting on an AI-native advisory model
summary: Alliant Insurance Services agreed to acquire Nava Benefits, an AI-native employee-benefits platform whose HQ system unifies producers, service teams, HR and employees on one system, as large brokers race to bring AI engineering in-house.

headline: InsurTech Express Elevates Nichole Gaines to CEO as Founder Steps Back to Chairman
summary: InsurTech Express promoted Chief Revenue Officer Nichole Gaines to CEO and Ron Hensel to President, with founder Ken Leibow moving into an Executive Chairman role as the company enters a new growth phase.

headline: Northwell's $1.2 billion Epic rollout reaches next phase with Central Region go-live
summary: Northwell Health's phased effort to unify more than 30 legacy EHRs across 28 hospitals onto a single Epic platform continues, with its Central Region wave -- one of the largest go-lives in Epic's history -- covering more than $8 billion in revenue and 40,000 simultaneous users.

headline: Global P&C reinsurers enter H2 2026 well capitalized but facing softer pricing
summary: Morningstar DBRS says record reinsurance capital chasing only modest demand growth is pushing property catastrophe rates lower, with further softening likely into 2027 absent a major loss event.

headline: Epic Retirement Solutions acquires recordkeeper Retirement Direct
summary: Retirement plan services firm Epic Retirement Solutions acquired recordkeeping provider Retirement Direct, adding to a wave of consolidation among smaller defined-contribution recordkeepers as fee pressure pushes the industry toward scale.

headline: Wealth Enhancement extends acquisition streak with $644 million Washington state RIA
summary: Wealth Enhancement acquired Olympia, Washington-based Weinand Financial, an independent RIA with about $644 million in client assets, pushing the consolidator's total client assets past $160.7 billion.

headline: Thoma Bravo to take specialty insurer Accelerant private in $4 billion-plus deal
summary: The software-focused investment firm agreed to buy the Accelerant Risk Exchange platform for $20.25 a share in cash, a 49% premium, with Accelerant's largest investor and founders keeping equity alongside Thoma Bravo.

headline: Wawanesa Insurance rebrands as W Insurance in its California personal-lines business
summary: The San Diego-based carrier, acquired by the Automobile Club of Southern California's affiliated insurer in 2024, shortened its name for its roughly 300,000 auto, home, condo and renters policies, with no change to coverage, claims or servicing.

headline: The Brokerage, Inc. joins AgencyBloc's partner program as charter member
summary: The agency became the first Strategic-level partner in AgencyBloc's program, days after AgencyBloc and HealthSherpa launched a Medicare integration linking quoting, enrollment and client management in one workflow.

headline: Catastrophe bond market on pace for a second straight year above $20 billion in issuance
summary: Cat bond spreads tightened through the summer as issuance accelerated; Aon Securities projects full-year 2026 volume will again top $20 billion, with insurers like Mangrove Property Insurance securing record reinsurance and cat-bond coverage ahead of the Atlantic hurricane season.

headline: Global TPA market climbs toward $404 billion in 2026 on outsourcing demand
summary: The insurance third-party administrator market is estimated to expand from $372 billion in 2025 to roughly $404 billion in 2026, an 8.7% growth rate driven by insurers and employers outsourcing administration as claims complexity rises.

headline: Aon launches $200 million 'Sidecar X' facility to streamline transactional risk insurance
summary: Aon debuted Sidecar X, a facility offering up to $200 million in dedicated capacity for representations-and-warranties and tax insurance, using pre-agreed underwriting frameworks to give clients faster placement and a 10% premium discount.

headline: BrokerTech Connect: Chicago to bring together insurance and insurtech leaders
summary: BrokerTech Ventures announced BrokerTech Connect: Chicago for August 31-September 2, gathering brokers, carriers, investors and insurtech founders for sessions on AI, change management and digital-first distribution.

headline: Munich Re to acquire cyber insurtech At-Bay for $575 million
summary: Munich Re agreed to acquire At-Bay, a top-10 U.S. cyber insurer with $278 million in gross written premium, in a $575 million deal expected to close in early 2027 and strengthen Munich Re's integrated cyber risk-mitigation platform.

headline: AdvisorFinder launches tool to show advisors how AI search engines portray them online
summary: AdvisorFinder Intelligence gives financial advisors a Digital Presence Report grading their search visibility, website health and online credibility, alongside a prioritized plan to improve how AI tools recommend them.

headline: Wildfire-focused broker RockRose Risk raises $12.5 million
summary: RockRose Risk, a US insurance brokerage specializing in wildfire-exposed properties, closed a $12.5 million Series A round co-led by Crosslink Capital and Congruent Ventures.

headline: Munich Re to buy cyber insurtech At-Bay in a $575 million deal
summary: Munich Re agreed to acquire US cyber insurtech At-Bay at an enterprise value of $575 million, folding its cyber-risk monitoring and underwriting-data platform into HSB, Munich Re Specialty's technology-focused cyber arm, with closing expected in early 2027.

headline: Oracle Health rolls out upgraded AI agent for clinicians
summary: Oracle Health released enhanced Clinical AI Agent capabilities designed to help doctors prepare for visits, finish documentation faster, and improve reimbursement accuracy for health systems.

headline: Samsung Life rolls out a digital-only lump-sum annuity with a locked-in 4.13% rate
summary: Samsung Life launched a fully digital one-time-payment annuity product that lets customers pay a single upfront premium to secure a fixed 4.13% rate for five years of retirement income.
