headline: Howden Re Recruits Senior Broker to Expand International Team
summary: Howden Re hired David Simpson to join its international broking team in London, where he is expected to help drive growth across the Nordic region and Continental Europe once he completes obligations with his current employer.

headline: Wildfire-focused insurtech RockRose Risk raises $12.5M to build out risk-mitigation-plus-cover model
summary: RockRose Risk closed a $12.5 million Series A co-led by Crosslink Capital and Congruent Ventures to expand its bundled offering of wildfire mitigation services and discounted property insurance for owners in fire-prone Western states.

headline: UK regulator trims transaction-reporting obligations in broader FCA rules reset
summary: The FCA cut back the scope of transaction reporting requirements as part of a wider August 2026 regulatory reset spanning asset management, Consumer Duty, crypto and AI governance, easing compliance burdens for fintech and insurance firms.

headline: Bolt launches what it calls the first AI-driven distribution platform spanning all insurance markets
summary: Distribution-focused insurtech Bolt rolled out an AI platform giving broker partners unified access across admitted, excess & surplus and wholesale lines, aiming to cut manual work and connect quoting through renewal in one workflow.

headline: EPIC Insurance Brokers reshuffles senior leadership to prep for its next growth phase
summary: EPIC Insurance Brokers and Consultants announced a round of strategic leadership promotions, including elevating Adam Okun, as the firm positions its executive team for continued expansion under CEO Steve Denton.

headline: Oracle Health expands Clinical AI Agent with automated coding and dictation
summary: Oracle Health rolled out new Clinical AI Agent capabilities that automate professional-fee coding, enable direct-to-record dictation and expand chart-review summaries, building on tools it says have saved U.S. clinicians over 400,000 documentation hours.

headline: PLANADVISER tracks a fresh wave of retirement-advisory M&A deals
summary: PLANADVISER's mid-August roundup of retirement-plan advisory mergers shows deal activity continuing at a steady clip, as aggregators keep adding retirement-focused RIAs and advisory teams.

headline: ACA individual market risk pool grows smaller and sicker as enhanced subsidies expire
summary: With enhanced ACA premium tax credits expiring, healthier enrollees have been leaving the marketplaces, and analysts estimate enrollment fell 17-26% in 2026 while morbidity worsened 2.9-6.5%, pushing insurers to build 2027 rates on a smaller, less healthy risk pool.

headline: Mount Sinai quietly stops taking some new patients on Medicaid and Medicare Advantage plans
summary: Mount Sinai Health System removed notices -- after a Politico inquiry -- showing it had stopped accepting new patients under Centene's Fidelis Care and Wellcare Medicare Advantage plans, plus EmblemHealth Medicaid products, as of Aug. 1, while continuing to treat existing patients on those plans.

headline: Oracle Health expands its Clinical AI Agent with automated coding, dictation and chart review
summary: The new capabilities let clinicians dictate directly into documentation, auto-suggest professional-fee billing codes from visit conversations, and surface longitudinal patient context for pre-visit prep, building on an agent that has already saved physicians over 400,000 hours.

headline: Kestra Financial names ex-BlackRock executive Kelly Apple as head of wealth management
summary: Apple, who spent more than 13 years at BlackRock and previously held senior roles at DWS and Van Kampen, will lead Kestra's investment management, high-net-worth, retirement and insurance, and alternative-investment teams.

headline: Calaveras County wildfire burns over 10,000 acres, affecting more than 64,000 policyholders
summary: A California wildfire that broke out earlier in the month has scorched over 10,000 acres and touched more than 64,000 policyholders, as the NAIC's summer national meeting took up property-casualty issues the same week.

headline: Munich Re to acquire cyber insurtech At-Bay for $575 million
summary: Munich Re agreed to acquire At-Bay, a US cyber insurtech, for $575 million, folding it into Hartford Steam Boiler and marking Munich Re's largest disclosed move yet into primary cyber insurance underwriting.

headline: Munich Re to acquire cyber insurtech At-Bay for $575 million in its largest primary cyber move
summary: Munich Re agreed to acquire At-Bay, a top-10 US cyber insurer, for $575 million, roughly a 2x multiple on At-Bay's gross written premiums, folding it into its Hartford Steam Boiler specialty unit.

headline: M&G completes another UK bulk annuity deal as pension buy-in demand stays strong
summary: M&G finalized an £85 million bulk purchase annuity transaction covering roughly 740 members of the Altro Pension Scheme, part of a busy year of UK buy-in activity fueled by elevated annuity pricing rates and improved defined-benefit funding levels.

headline: Private credit managers pivot away from direct lending as fundraising cools sharply
summary: Bloomberg reports that direct-lending fundraising has slumped -- non-traded business development company fundraising fell about 82% year over year in the second quarter -- pushing asset managers toward asset-based finance and credit-secondaries strategies instead.

headline: IRDAI bars Edelweiss Life from opening new branches for six months over expense breach
summary: India's insurance regulator sanctioned Edelweiss Life Insurance for spending far above the permitted management-expense cap on non-participating business, blocking the insurer from launching any new offices for half a year.

headline: IRS floats updated funding rules for traditional employer pension plans
summary: The IRS proposed changes to the calculations used for pension plan funding, updating timing and qualification rules stemming from the SECURE Act and SECURE 2.0 Act.

headline: IRS proposes updated funding rules for single-employer pension plans
summary: The IRS issued proposed regulations updating minimum funding requirements for single-employer defined benefit pension plans, scheduled for Federal Register publication on August 20, 2026, giving plan sponsors revised guidance on funding calculations.

headline: Aon projects employer health-care costs will jump 9.5% in 2027, a fourth straight year near double digits
summary: Aon's analysis of over 1,100 U.S. employers found projected 2027 health benefit costs rising 9.5% to above $19,000 per employee, driven by rising medical utilization, chronic disease prevalence and GLP-1 drug spending, extending a multi-year run of elevated cost trends.

headline: Skyward Group's longtime CFO to retire, deputy CFO named successor
summary: Skyward Group announced that CFO Mark Haushill will retire in March 2027, with Taryn McHarg, currently deputy CFO, set to succeed him in the specialty P&C insurer's finance leadership.
source_name: SEC EDGAR / Skyward Specialty Insurance Group Form 8-K

headline: TPA software market on pace to more than double by 2034 amid AI-driven claims push
summary: The global third-party-administrator software market is projected to grow from $4.8 billion in 2025 to $10.2 billion by 2034, an 8.7% CAGR, as AI-driven claims automation and rising self-funded enrollment push carriers and employers toward outsourced TPA platforms.

headline: Carson Group adds $405 million Atlanta team from Northwestern Mutual
summary: Carson Group welcomed Yari Capital, a $405 million Atlanta advisory practice led by CFP Kurt Mattson, to its independent advisor channel, continuing a run of recruiting wins for the $62 billion RIA aggregator.

headline: Commercial P&C pricing keeps softening as premium cuts accelerate in Q2
summary: The Council's latest survey found average commercial premiums fell 2.0% in Q2 2026, led by large-account discounts, even as umbrella and commercial auto lines kept posting increases amid continued nuclear-verdict pressure.

headline: Vanguard readies first new target-date series since 2003 with built-in TIAA annuity
summary: Vanguard is rolling out Target Retirement Lifetime Income Trusts that begin allocating to the TIAA Secure Income Account at age 55, reaching about 25% of the portfolio by 65, giving 401(k) participants an optional guaranteed-income sleeve within the same glide path as its flagship funds.

headline: State Farm raises Illinois home insurance rates 27% on rising claims costs
summary: State Farm is raising home insurance rates by an average of 27% for Illinois customers, saying it paid out $1.26 in total costs for every $1 collected in premium in 2024, even as the insurer separately lowers Illinois auto rates.

headline: Apollon and Merit extend RIA buying spree with two more acquisitions
summary: Apollon Wealth Management added a roughly $650 million RIA while Merit Financial Advisors picked up a $470 million advisory firm, the latest moves in an accelerating wave of RIA consolidation.

headline: Healthcare Management Administrators names Diane Zalewski CEO
summary: The third-party administrator serving self-funded employers hired Zalewski, formerly president of Payer Solutions at Evernorth, where she ran a business serving health plans, TPAs and employer clients.

headline: Advisors take a cautious approach to AI tools despite a crowded wealthtech field
summary: At the Future Proof Citywide conference in Miami, 86 wealthtech firms competed for demo slots spanning CRM, tax planning, compliance and agentic AI assistants, but advisors said they remain cautious about full-scale adoption.

headline: Swiss Re Institute: $750 billion AI investment boom is reshaping the insurance risk landscape
summary: Swiss Re Institute says a roughly $750 billion boom in AI-related capital investment, layered on top of geopolitical fragmentation, is reshaping the risks insurers must underwrite and the opportunities available to their investment portfolios.

headline: UCare becomes latest insurer to exit the Medicare Advantage market
summary: Minnesota nonprofit insurer UCare has asked CMS to terminate its Medicare Advantage contracts for 2026, citing rising medical costs and broader strain across the MA market.

headline: APAC insurers navigate geopolitics, catastrophe losses, and AI adoption in 2026
summary: Regional insurers across Asia-Pacific are contending with overlapping pressures from geopolitical tension, rising natural catastrophe losses, and fast-moving AI adoption even as the region remains the primary engine of global insurance premium growth.

headline: OneAmerica's sale to Voya intensifies consolidation pressure on mid-tier 401(k) recordkeepers
summary: Industry analysis points to OneAmerica's sale to Voya as accelerating scale pressure on smaller, regional retirement recordkeepers already squeezed by falling fees and rising technology and staffing costs.

headline: Hong Kong's Insurance Authority closes consultation on risk-based capital reforms favoring infrastructure investment
summary: Hong Kong's Insurance Authority closed a consultation on revisions to its Risk-Based Capital framework that would give insurers preferential capital treatment for qualifying infrastructure investments, targeting a December 31, 2026 implementation date.

headline: Target-date funds edge toward embedding guaranteed lifetime income as adoption nears universal
summary: With target-date funds now used by the vast majority of defined contribution plans, providers are increasingly building retirement-income and annuity features directly into the glide path rather than offering them as separate options.

headline: TPA industry consolidates further as private-equity-backed roll-ups chase scale
summary: Industry coverage of the shifting TPA landscape points to continued private-equity-driven acquisitions as administrators pursue the scale needed to serve multiple lines of business profitably amid margin pressure.

headline: Payments and AI startups pull in $361 million in a single week of fintech funding
summary: Weekly fintech funding tracked by FinTech Global reached $361 million, with payments and AI-focused companies accounting for the bulk of the capital raised, continuing a summer run of steady if unspectacular deal flow.

headline: August Equity takes a stake in niche digital MGA Starpeak
summary: UK private equity firm August Equity agreed to invest in Starpeak, a digital insurance distributor focused on niche SME and personal-lines segments, backing its next growth phase.

headline: Ping An's first-half profit surges 36% as China's market rally lifts asset management income
summary: Ping An Insurance reported a better-than-expected 36% year-on-year rise in first-half net profit, as a rally in mainland Chinese equities boosted fee income and investment gains within its asset management business.

headline: Embedded finance moves into a more predictive, AI-driven phase
summary: Analysts say embedded finance is shifting from simply placing financial products inside other platforms toward AI-driven tools that anticipate customer needs, with the global market projected to grow from about $94 billion in 2025 to over $115 billion in 2026.

headline: Australia's Steadfast agrees to $5.5 billion buyout by KKR-backed consortium
summary: Steadfast Group agreed to an A$7.7 billion buyout by a consortium of KKR, Amwins Group and Dragoneer Investment Group, with Amwins taking the underwriting agency business and Dragoneer the broking operations; shareholders get A$6 per share, a roughly 52% premium, with completion targeted for December 2026.

headline: Aon poaches Marsh's Southeast Asia chief executive
summary: Aon hired Godelieve van Dooren, Marsh's Singapore-based chief executive for Southeast Asia, succeeding Andrew Minitt, who left earlier this year to lead The Ardonagh Group's Asia business.

headline: Maine regulators approve York Hospital's merger into MaineHealth
summary: State regulators approved York Hospital's merger with MaineHealth after the community hospital said financial strain, including an $11 million operating loss, left it unable to keep operating independently.

headline: AI-driven claims automation named key growth driver for TPA sector through 2030
summary: A 2026 market analysis of insurance third-party administrators cites AI-driven claims automation and demand for scalable TPA platforms as the leading growth drivers for the sector through the end of the decade.

headline: HIMSS and SingHealth host APAC Health Conference in Singapore to accelerate AI-enabled care
summary: HIMSS and SingHealth co-hosted the 2026 HIMSS APAC Health Conference & Exhibition Aug. 23-25 in Singapore, gathering health ministries and digital-health leaders from South Korea, Australia and across the region around clinical AI, smart hospitals and interoperability.

headline: Clear Group and ANV strike back-to-back UK broker and MGA acquisitions
summary: Clear Group agreed to buy Lloyd's wholesale broker Newman Pearce & Partners while ANV Group struck a deal to acquire Car Care Plan, a UK motor-warranty MGA, from AmTrust, in a busy week of London-market consolidation.

headline: Carpe launches Minerva Reasoning Engine to help small commercial insurers underwrite profitably
summary: AI-native data specialist Carpe introduced its Minerva Reasoning Engine, an underwriting tool aimed specifically at helping small commercial insurers price risk more profitably.

headline: MSIG Asia names Ronak Shah as regional chief executive
summary: MSIG Asia appointed Ronak Shah as its new Regional CEO effective October 1, 2026, a leadership transition for the Asia-Pacific general insurer.

headline: Federal marketplace crackdown set to strip coverage from up to 1.8 million ACA enrollees
summary: A batch of Trump administration ACA marketplace rules takes effect August 25, tightening eligibility verification, ending some special enrollment periods and cutting DACA recipients from subsidized coverage, though litigation could still block parts of it.
source_name: Georgetown Center on Health Insurance Reforms

headline: M&G pushes deeper into bulk annuities, targeting £3-4 billion in annual sales by 2027
summary: M&G shares held steady as the insurer leans further into the bulk purchase annuity market, with analysts pointing to an improving sales and fee-income trajectory heading into 2027.

headline: Asia-Pacific reinsurers reverse revenue decline with 4% growth
summary: Asia-Pacific reinsurers recorded a 4% year-on-year increase in net insurance service revenue in 2025, reversing the prior year's decline as regional demand and pricing stabilized.

headline: Rising costs push employers to lean harder on broker-TPA partnerships
summary: Employee Benefit News reports that rising healthcare costs and limited internal HR capacity are driving employers to demand stronger broker-TPA partnerships capable of executing complex cost-containment strategies, as TPAs take on expanded analytics and compliance roles.

headline: RIA channel keeps pulling senior talent from banking and asset management
summary: Three wealth management firms announced senior hires spanning investment banking, alternative investment distribution and sports and entertainment wealth management, including Guggenheim Securities naming Blake Jones a senior managing director focused on M&A involving RIAs and broker-dealers.

headline: Willis Re to acquire BMS Group's US reinsurance division
summary: Willis Re agreed to buy the US reinsurance broking and capital-advisory business of BMS Group, including its catastrophe bond and ILS team, marking Willis Re's first major deal since its relaunch.

headline: Sequoia Financial expands in Colorado with $2.3 billion RIA acquisition
summary: Akron-based Sequoia Financial Group, which manages $34.9 billion in assets, acquired Colorado registered investment advisor BSW Wealth Partners in its latest consolidation move.

headline: China tightens algorithm-governance expectations for AI-driven insurance pricing and claims
summary: Chinese regulators are pushing insurers toward "algorithm governance," requiring that AI-driven pricing and underwriting models be transparent, explainable, and free of discriminatory bias, while barring insurers from offloading core management responsibility to third-party tech vendors.

headline: RIA dealmaking accelerates as three acquirers hit new AUM milestones
summary: InvestmentNews reports RIA dealmaking is accelerating, highlighting Wealth Enhancement's purchase of a $345 million Anchorage-based RIA and other acquirers crossing new assets-under-management thresholds.

headline: Bipartisan 'Doctors Not AI Act' seeks to keep medical-necessity denials in human hands
summary: A bipartisan group of House lawmakers introduced legislation requiring that insurance claim denials based on medical necessity be made by a licensed clinician, limiting AI to a supporting role in the claims process.

headline: Cyber insurers roll out ‘AI security riders’ as autonomous agents reshape risk pricing
summary: With global cyber premium on track to reach $16.4 billion in 2026, carriers are introducing AI-security riders requiring proof of red-teaming and reassessing how policies respond to risks from an organization's own autonomous AI systems.

headline: Vanguard agrees to acquire wealthtech custodian Altruist
summary: Vanguard signed a definitive agreement to acquire Altruist, an AI-forward wealth technology and custody platform for advisors, in a deal reported at roughly $4-4.6 billion; Altruist is expected to keep operating under its own brand.

headline: Principal expands 401(k) access to private-market strategies
summary: Principal broadened its Featured Partner Programme to let AllianceBernstein, Apollo, Ares, Blackstone, KKR and other alternative managers offer private-market exposure inside CIT-based target-date and target-risk funds on its recordkeeping platform.

headline: State Farm begins distributing promised $5 billion in policyholder dividends
summary: State Farm started distributing $5 billion in previously announced dividends to eligible policyholders, part of the mutual insurer's broader capital-return efforts detailed in PropertyCasualty360's industry roundup.

headline: Embedded finance's growth collides with a regulatory reckoning
summary: As embedded finance and insurance partnerships proliferate, regulators are increasing scrutiny of sponsor-bank and fintech partnerships, with compliance violations already costing many sponsor banks over $100,000 each.

headline: Reinsurance sidecar market set to hit record $23 billion in 2026
summary: Industry estimates put the reinsurance sidecar market at a record $23 billion for 2026, with Swiss Re separately projecting up to $200 billion in premium opportunity from data centers and renewables by 2030.

headline: Vanguard agrees to acquire RIA custody platform Altruist in deal valued near $4 billion
summary: Vanguard and Altruist announced a definitive agreement for Vanguard to acquire the venture-backed custody and technology platform, which serves more than 6,000 advisors; Altruist will keep operating under its own brand as the deal is expected to close later this year.

headline: Vanguard to acquire wealthtech platform Altruist for $4.6 billion
summary: Vanguard agreed to acquire Altruist, an AI-forward RIA custody and wealth-technology platform serving more than 6,000 advisors, in a deal expected to close later in 2026 and push Vanguard directly into custody competition with Schwab and Fidelity.

headline: Higginbotham joins forces with Two West Capital Advisors to grow retirement plan business
summary: The Fort Worth-based brokerage, ranked 16th-largest in the US, is bringing the Kansas City retirement-plan consulting and wealth management firm's team into its retirement and wealth division, with Two West staying in Kansas City as employee-owners of Higginbotham.

headline: Clinician AI use triples as 74% of doctors and 70% of nurses adopt weekly
summary: A new report finds daily multiple-times-per-day AI use has tripled among doctors and doubled among nurses since 2025, driven by generative AI breakthroughs, near-universal EHR adoption and surging institutional investment in cognitive-computing infrastructure.

headline: NewYork-Presbyterian and UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage contract set to lapse August 31
summary: After repeated extensions since a January deadline, the hospital system and insurer face an August 31 cutoff that would push most UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage members out of network, part of a wider pattern of health-system/payer contract breaks in 2026.

headline: Catastrophe bond issuance hits record $24.9 billion as alternative capital tops $144 billion
summary: Aon's latest Insurance-Linked Securities report shows catastrophe bond issuance reached an all-time high of $24.9 billion over the year to June 30, 2026, pushing total alternative reinsurance capital to a record $144.5 billion.

headline: India's wealth management market on track to grow past $436 billion by 2034
summary: A new market report projects India's wealth management industry will grow at roughly a 10.6% annual rate through 2034, driven by a fast-growing high-net-worth population and a continued shift from physical to financial assets.

headline: Aon agrees to buy broker USI from KKR in roughly $17 billion deal
summary: Aon announced it will acquire USI Insurance Services, the tenth-largest US insurance broker with about $3 billion in annual revenue, from private equity owner KKR for approximately $17 billion in cash, extending Aon's push into the US middle market following its 2024 purchase of NFP.

headline: Aon to acquire USI Insurance Services for $17 billion, forming a top US middle-market broker
summary: Aon signed a definitive agreement to buy USI Insurance Services from KKR for $17.0 billion, aiming to build the leading platform in the US middle-market segment; the deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026 and follows Aon's 2024 acquisition of NFP.

headline: NHS watchdog finds AI scribes inserting incorrect diagnoses and drug names into patient records
summary: Healthwatch England reported on August 31, 2026 that AI transcription tools used across dozens of NHS scribe products have produced errors including a dropped negation that reversed a diagnosis, with patients catching mistakes clinicians missed.

headline: Aon to acquire USI from KKR for $17 billion, building a premier US middle-market platform
summary: Aon agreed to buy the 10th-largest U.S. insurance broker USI from KKR for roughly $17 billion, building on its 2024 NFP acquisition to expand access to the more than $40 billion middle-market segment.

headline: IRDAI proposes a nationwide Public Insurance Registry to digitize India's insurance ecosystem
summary: India's insurance regulator released a consultation paper proposing a population-scale Public Insurance Registry connecting insurers, intermediaries, reinsurers and policyholders through a single interoperable digital framework.

headline: London NHS trust performs world-first AI-assisted brain surgery
summary: University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust says it carried out the world's first brain operation guided by real-time AI analysis of the surgical video feed, helping the surgical team identify critical structures while removing a pituitary tumor from a 48-year-old patient.

headline: Federal guidance tightens expectations for retirement plan recordkeeping accuracy
summary: A roundup of federal retirement rules highlights sharpened recordkeeping and reporting expectations for plan sponsors and administrators, part of continued fallout from SECURE 2.0 implementation as agencies push for more reliable participant data.

headline: Wealth Enhancement adds Virginia RIA in its third second-half deal of the year
summary: Minneapolis-based consolidator Wealth Enhancement acquired the investment advisory business of Dickerson Jackson & Associates, a hybrid RIA in Glen Allen, Virginia managing about $376 million in client assets, continuing its acquisitive pace into the second half of 2026.

headline: EU Council extends EIOPA chair Petra Hielkema's mandate for a second five-year term
summary: The Council of the European Union extended Petra Hielkema's term as chairperson of the European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority for a second five-year term beginning September 1, 2026, following a positive performance review from EIOPA's Board of Supervisors.

headline: US public pension funding hits 85% on strong investment returns despite record contribution burden
summary: Equable Institute's State of Pensions 2026 report finds the average public pension plan is now 85% funded, up from 81.2%, as investment returns beat targets for a fourth straight year, even as employer contribution rates hit a historic high.

headline: Home insurance rates set to rise for a fifth straight year as wildfire and storm losses mount
summary: Insurify projects US homeowners insurance premiums will keep climbing in 2026, with California rates alone forecast to jump 16% as insurers respond to persistent wildfire losses and capital strain.

headline: InsuranceDekho and RenewBuy merge to form India's largest AI-led insurance distribution platform
summary: The combined entity, operating under the InsuranceDekho brand, has a premium book above Rs 6,600 crore and reaches 98.57% of India's postal codes, pairing InsuranceDekho's north-and-west presence with RenewBuy's southern network.

headline: LIMRA forecasts a fourth straight record year for U.S. annuity sales in 2026
summary: LIMRA's Life Insurance Awareness Month research puts 2026 annuity sales on pace for a new industry record of between $438 billion and $485 billion, even as crediting rates are expected to ease gradually through the year.

headline: Aon promotes Larry Kwok to head North Asia market
summary: Aon promoted Larry Kwok to head of its North Asia market excluding South Korea, while Er Jun joined the broker from Lockton to lead its marine major-market division, as regulatory divergence across APAC pushes brokers to consolidate leadership on cross-border programs.

headline: Verisk raises average annual global catastrophe loss estimate to $171 billion
summary: Verisk's latest catastrophe modeling projects the insurance industry should expect to absorb $171 billion in insured natural catastrophe losses in an average year, up $19 billion from its prior estimate.

headline: UK insurers now subject to FCA's tougher non-financial misconduct rules
summary: As of September 1, 2026, the Financial Conduct Authority requires insurance firms to treat serious workplace bullying, harassment, and violence as potential regulatory breaches, bringing insurers into line with banking-sector conduct standards.

headline: BrokerTech Ventures brings insurance and insurtech leaders together at Chicago summit
summary: BrokerTech Ventures held its second annual BrokerTech Connect conference in Chicago on September 1-2, 2026, gathering brokerage, carrier, and startup executives to discuss emerging distribution technology and partnership opportunities.

headline: India's insurers reposition around prevention and AI-driven personalization
summary: Coverage of India's evolving insurance market describes a shift from viewing insurance as a mandatory expense toward AI-enabled, prevention-focused products that blend protection with wealth-building and health management.

headline: Insurance industry sees wave of September leadership moves at AIG, Allianz Trade, and Marsh
summary: A roundup of executive appointments effective around September 1, 2026 includes AIG naming a new global chief underwriting officer, Allianz Trade appointing a new China CEO, and Marsh naming a global chief claims officer.

headline: MAI Capital taps former KeyBank CIO Amy Brady as managing partner to lead AI and growth push
summary: RIA MAI Capital named 30-year financial-services veteran Amy Brady, formerly of KeyBank and Bank of America, as managing partner to drive firmwide AI adoption, technology strategy and enterprise growth.

headline: Sanford Health finalizes merger with North Memorial Health, entering the Twin Cities market
summary: Sanford Health completed its merger with North Memorial Health under a 10-year Minnesota oversight agreement that includes $600 million in investment commitments and preserves Robbinsdale Hospital as a Level I trauma center.

headline: NHS begins phased 2026/27 flu vaccination drive, prioritizing pregnant women and at-risk children first
summary: The NHS opened its 2026/27 flu vaccination programme on September 1 for pregnant women, at-risk children and school-aged children, with the wider adult rollout and a first-time offer to rough sleepers following on October 1.

headline: Catastrophe bond issuance hits record as reinsurance capital keeps flooding in
summary: 144A catastrophe bond issuance reached $17.3 billion in the first half of 2026, a record pace driven by record dedicated reinsurance capital and alternative capacity that continues to outstrip buyer demand.

headline: InsureMO becomes formal Anthropic partner for AI-powered insurance applications
summary: Insurance infrastructure platform InsureMO became a formal Anthropic partner, enabling insurers and distributors to build AI-powered applications on its API, data and AI architecture.

headline: BrokerTech Ventures brings insurance and insurtech leaders together in Chicago
summary: BrokerTech Ventures held its second annual BrokerTech Connect conference September 1-2 in Chicago, convening brokerage, carrier, wholesaler and startup executives alongside its 2026 accelerator cohort of nine insurtech startups.

headline: Pooled employer plans adoption jumps 45% as recordkeepers bet on PEP growth
summary: The 2026 PLANSPONSOR Recordkeeping Survey found 10,797 employers had adopted pooled employer plans for 401(k) or 403(b) participants, up 44.8% from a year earlier, with many recordkeepers naming PEPs a major strategic priority.

headline: Private capital in 401(k) plans could top $1 trillion by 2030, Deloitte projects
summary: Deloitte forecasts regulatory changes could push private-market allocations in U.S. defined contribution plans to roughly 6% of assets by 2030, up from under 1% today, as target-date funds begin adding private equity exposure.

headline: AIG leans into private assets as investment income growth slows
summary: AIG plans to increase its allocation to private assets to help reaccelerate net investment income, which the insurer expects to resume growing in 2027 after a slower stretch.

headline: ACA marketplace premiums set to jump as enhanced subsidies expire
summary: With Congress declining to extend enhanced ACA premium tax credits, some marketplace enrollees could see costs rise as much as 114% when combined with insurers' 2026 rate increases, which carriers say already priced in the subsidy expiration.

headline: Sanford Health finalizes merger with North Memorial Health, entering the Twin Cities
summary: Sanford Health completed its merger with North Memorial Health under a 10-year Minnesota oversight agreement requiring $600 million in facility investment, forming a combined nonprofit system serving about 2.5 million patients.

headline: India's GST exemption and 100% FDI reform continue reshaping life and health insurance growth outlook
summary: Analysts say India's move to exempt individual life and health premiums from GST and to allow full foreign ownership of insurers is fueling a bullish 2026 growth outlook, even as regulators push further digital and policy reforms toward universal coverage.

headline: UK regulators propose lighter-touch regime for captive insurers
summary: The Bank of England's PRA and the FCA opened a joint consultation on a bespoke UK captive insurer framework sitting outside Solvency UK, promising lower capital and reporting burdens and a four-to-six-week authorization target ahead of a planned mid-2027 launch.

headline: UK's MGAA appoints Padda Consulting as compliance and regulatory partner
summary: The Managing General Agents' Association named Padda Consulting its new UK compliance and regulatory partner effective September 1, 2026, aiming to help MGA members keep pace with evolving regulatory requirements.

headline: EU insurers face narrowing window to prove AI governance to supervisors
summary: European regulators are converging on binding AI governance standards for insurers, with a monthly regulatory tracker warning that carriers without documented AI oversight frameworks face a shrinking compliance runway.

headline: Bipartisan 'Doctors Not AI Act' would bar algorithms from final medical-necessity denials
summary: Rep. Greg Landsman's bill, introduced September 1, would require a licensed clinician to make the final call on medical-necessity claim denials at group health plans and insurers, permitting AI only in a supporting role with disclosure requirements.

headline: Bermuda's life and annuity sidecar market nearly quadruples in four years
summary: A new Morningstar DBRS report cited in the Longevity & Mortality Investor shows Bermuda's L&A reinsurance sidecar market has grown almost fourfold over the past four years as carriers seek off-balance-sheet capital solutions.

headline: Goldman Sachs flags four trends reshaping defined contribution plans in 2026
summary: Goldman Sachs Asset Management's 2026 outlook highlights personalized glidepaths, growing lifetime-income features, blended active-passive strategies, and expanding private-market access as the forces redefining DC plan design.

headline: Target-date fund assets approach $5 trillion as adoption nears universal
summary: A 401(k) Specialist deep dive finds target-date fund assets nearing $5 trillion, cementing TDFs as the primary retirement-savings engine even as sponsors weigh new personalization and private-markets features.

headline: India's mutual fund SIP inflows climb 12% year-on-year in July
summary: India's mutual fund industry recorded SIP inflows of roughly Rs 31,961 crore in July 2026, up 12% year-on-year, as total industry AUM grew to about Rs 85.76 lakh crore.

headline: Gallagher Re report shows reinsurance capital growth outpacing earlier estimates
summary: Gallagher Re's September half-year 2026 reinsurance market report finds traditional reinsurance capital on pace to grow 6% for the year, above earlier forecasts, on the back of a strong first-half performance.

headline: Device-intelligence fraud platform Fingerprint surpasses $50 million in ARR
summary: Fingerprint said it passed $50 million in annual recurring revenue on September 1, identifying more than a billion unique devices monthly for over 6,000 organizations combating AI-driven fraud.

headline: FinovateFall 2026 draws top US banks as embedded finance dominates agenda
summary: FinovateFall 2026 in New York confirmed attendance from major US banks including JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America, reflecting continued convergence between traditional banks and fintech platforms.

headline: MediaAlpha CFO Pat Thompson to step down, SVP of Finance to succeed him
summary: Insurance marketing platform MediaAlpha announced CFO Pat Thompson will step down effective October 1, 2026, with SVP of Finance Tigran Sinanyan succeeding him as chief financial officer.

headline: September ITL Focus spotlights the technology reshaping agents and brokers
summary: Insurance Thought Leadership's September 2026 agents-and-brokers focus examines how distribution technology, data and AI tools are reshaping the intermediary role across the value chain.

summary: Hightower's Signature Wealth unit added a $1.6 billion Boston-area firm, Carson Group closed a 50-office deal with Elios Financial Group, and AlphaCore launched a family-office unit via a $5 billion acquisition, part of what is shaping up to be a record year for RIA M&A.

headline: AI wealth-transfer platform Luminary raises $22 million Series A
summary: Luminary, which turns static estate-planning documents into structured data for advisors and trust companies, raised a $22 million Series A led by Ten Coves Capital, bringing total funding to nearly $32 million and supporting more than $500 billion in client assets.

headline: Charles Taylor acquires Ohio-based third-party administrator Matrix Companies
summary: Global claims and TPA services provider Charles Taylor has acquired the Matrix Companies, an Ohio-based third-party administrator, expanding its US claims-handling footprint.

headline: TRISTAR expands with acquisition of New Jersey third-party administrator
summary: Claims and risk-management firm TRISTAR is acquiring a New Jersey-based third-party administrator, continuing the wave of consolidation among regional TPA and claims-services firms.

headline: Davies strikes strategic claims partnership with Brown & Brown in North America
summary: Claims and services group Davies has signed a deal with Brown & Brown adding new claims and services capabilities to its North America business, establishing a long-term strategic partnership between the two firms.

headline: Fintech dealmaking stays hot with $850 million raised in a single week
summary: A separate FinTech Global roundup tallied more than $850 million raised across fintech financings in the week of September 18, 2026, reflecting continued investor appetite for the sector.

headline: Sanford Health and North Memorial Health complete merger, pledge $600 million Minnesota investment
summary: The two nonprofit systems finalized their combination on September 1, 2026, with Sanford Health committing more than $600 million to expand Maple Grove Hospital and modernize Robbinsdale Hospital, whose Level I trauma center status is guaranteed for at least a decade.

headline: Indian Bank eyes insurance and mutual fund partnerships, plans wealth management launch
summary: Indian Bank is exploring partnerships to enter the insurance and mutual fund businesses within 1.5 to 2 years and plans to launch wealth management services in the second half of FY27.

headline: FinTech Innovation Lab Asia-Pacific names 2026 cohort of eight startups
summary: The 13th edition of the FinTech Innovation Lab Asia-Pacific selected eight technology companies, including climate-underwriting startup WeavAir, to work directly with major banks and insurers across the region.

headline: Identity verification firm Jumio expands reusable digital ID into Asia-Pacific
summary: Jumio extended its reusable identity solution, selfie.DONE, into the Asia-Pacific region on September 15, 2026, as regional financial institutions push to streamline onboarding and compliance.

headline: Allianz Trade names new China CEO as Asia-Pacific leadership shuffles continue
summary: Allianz Trade appointed Scott Munafo as its China CEO effective September 1, 2026, part of a string of senior Asia-Pacific leadership moves across the region's insurers this month, including a new chief underwriting officer at MSIG Hong Kong.

headline: NAIC working group begins overhaul of market conduct regulation
summary: State insurance regulators' new Market Conduct Regulation Modernization Working Group is collecting broad industry input through 2026, aiming to deliver actionable recommendations on modernizing market-conduct oversight by year-end.

headline: US cyber insurance pricing stays soft even as third-party claims climb
summary: US cyber insurance premiums were roughly flat through the first part of 2026 after a long run of rate cuts, but a roughly 30% rise in third-party claims is pressuring loss ratios and clouding the outlook for insurers.

headline: Zurich returns to the catastrophe bond market with a new closed deal
summary: Zurich successfully closed a new catastrophe bond, marking its return to the cat bond market as insurers continue tapping capital markets for property catastrophe protection amid ample investor appetite.

headline: US insurers brace for major ISO general liability form changes
summary: Insurers are preparing operational and pricing adjustments ahead of significant 2026 revisions to ISO's general liability forms, which are expected to reshape coverage language and underwriting workflows industry-wide.

headline: Consumers face another sharp jump in health insurance costs heading into 2027
summary: Analysts warn that health insurance costs are set to rise steeply again in 2027 as insurers pass through higher medical trend and the fading of enhanced ACA subsidies, prompting fresh guidance on how households can manage premiums.

headline: Major health insurers post strong second-quarter 2026 results as cost trend eases
summary: UnitedHealthcare, Elevance Health and peers reported improving medical cost ratios in Q2 2026, with UnitedHealthcare's medical cost ratio falling from 89.4% to 86.7% and Elevance posting roughly $1.5 billion in quarterly profit, prompting raised full-year guidance.

headline: Greenfield Asian hospitals build AI-native records systems from the ground up
summary: Singapore's Woodlands Hospital and Taiwan's Taipei Veterans General Hospital are each using unified electronic medical record and interoperability architectures, unencumbered by legacy systems, to push AI use beyond clinical documentation.

headline: AIG's general insurance CEO Lou Hancock to retire at year-end
summary: AIG confirmed that Lou Hancock will step down as chief executive of its general insurance business at the end of 2026, part of a broader wave of senior leadership transition at the carrier this year.

headline: Newly licensed Indian insurer Protec taps insureMO to build an AI-native core system
summary: Protec General Insurance, a newly licensed Indian carrier, selected middle-office platform insureMO to build an API-driven, AI-native insurance core as it prepares to scale retail and commercial lines across India.

headline: Apollo launches a private-credit fund aimed at UK defined contribution pension savers
summary: Apollo introduced a long-term asset fund giving UK defined contribution pension schemes semi-liquid access to a private credit portfolio spanning investment-grade, large-cap corporate lending and asset-backed finance.

headline: APAC insurers accelerate technology bets heading into 2026
summary: A regional roundup highlights how APAC insurers are leaning further into digital distribution, automation and AI tooling as they compete for growth in under-penetrated markets across the region.

headline: US annuity sales notch another record first half, RILA leads growth
summary: Finalized LIMRA data show second-quarter 2026 US annuity sales around $121 billion (revised down slightly from an initial $123.9B estimate), extending an 11-quarter streak above $100 billion and pushing first-half 2026 sales to a record $231.3 billion, with registered index-linked annuities (RILAs) growing fastest.

headline: Legacy Marketing and Malibu Life USA team up on new indexed annuity line
summary: Legacy Marketing Group struck a distribution partnership with Malibu Life USA to bring two new fixed indexed annuity products, PillarMark and SpireMark, to market through independent agents starting this month, issued by Malibu's Texas-domiciled carrier TruSpire.

headline: Indian insurer stocks jump on expected crackdown on distributor commissions
summary: Shares of HDFC Life, ICICI Prudential Life, SBI Life and Max Financial rallied as much as 5% after reports that India's insurance regulator IRDAI is preparing a consultation paper to cap or reduce commissions paid to banks and other distributors, a move investors expect to lower acquisition costs and lift margins.

headline: State AI-governance rules for insurers reach a tipping point in 2026
summary: Adoption of the NAIC's AI Model Bulletin has spread to roughly 25 US states as of mid-2026, with several more in progress, pushing carriers to build documented AI governance, testing and monitoring programs for underwriting and claims models as a new multistate examiner tool pilots across a dozen states.

headline: Luxembourg insurer OneLife completes CEO handover
summary: Cross-border life insurer OneLife confirmed Cédric Lootvoet as its new Chief Executive Officer effective September 1, 2026, succeeding Bruno Valersteinas after Lootvoet had spent roughly nine months as Deputy CEO preparing for the transition.

headline: Full plan terminations now drive most pension risk transfer deals
summary: October Three's 2026 PRT Trends survey found plan terminations accounted for two-thirds of pension risk transfer transactions in the first half of 2026, with buy-in premiums up sharply even as total buyout dollar volume cooled from a strong 2025 finish, and carriers reporting less worry about PRT litigation than a year ago.

headline: DOL floats safe harbor for putting alternative assets into 401(k) menus
summary: The Department of Labor's proposed rule, issued March 31, 2026 under a 2025 White House executive order, would give plan fiduciaries a six-factor "prudent process" safe harbor for adding private equity, real estate and other alternative investments as 401(k) and 403(b) designated investment options.

headline: Aging Asia-Pacific populations push pension providers toward income-focused products
summary: Amundi's research team flagged that rapidly aging populations in Japan, China, Australia and South Korea are shifting demand from pure accumulation toward decumulation and retirement-income products, as state and workplace pension systems in the region struggle to keep pace.

headline: Grayscale pushes crypto further into mainstream advisor portfolios
summary: Grayscale rolled out digital-asset model portfolios for financial advisors in mid-September 2026, giving wealth managers a packaged way to add crypto exposure to client accounts as digital assets keep edging into traditional asset-management platforms.

headline: BNP Paribas Asset Management installs four new co-CIOs
summary: BNP Paribas Asset Management named four new Chief Investment Officers, including Guy Davies as Deputy Global Head of Investments and CIO for fundamental active equity and Robinson Rouchié as CIO for systematic and quantitative investments, effective September 1, 2026, reporting to global investments head Rob Gambi as part of the firm's "AMplify 2030" plan.

headline: AGF's August AUM snapshot shows steady asset growth
summary: Canadian asset manager AGF reported total assets under management and fee-earning assets of roughly $74.2 billion as of August 31, 2026, offering an early read on how markets and flows treated mid-tier managers heading into the fall.

headline: India's wealth management market on track to more than double by the mid-2030s
summary: India's wealth-management industry is projected to roughly 2.5x to about $436 billion by 2034, fueled by a 90% four-year jump in dollar-millionaire households and mutual fund AUM approaching Rs 78 lakh crore, according to industry estimates cited in early September coverage.

headline: SEC pushes forward on adviser recordkeeping and fiduciary-conduct rulemaking
summary: The SEC published a proposed rule amendment in the Federal Register on September 10 updating books-and-records requirements for investment advisers, part of a broader FY2026 exam agenda emphasizing fiduciary standards, conflict-of-interest disclosure and Regulation S-P cybersecurity compliance.

headline: Chicago RIA Choreo taps another Edelman veteran for newly created executive post
summary: Choreo named Kelly O'Donnell as its first chief people and transformation officer, marking the fourth Edelman Financial Engines alum hired into a C-suite role at the RIA in about a year; she will oversee HR, brand and the integration of acquired firms.

headline: Mapfre's buyout of Safety Insurance clears key antitrust hurdle
summary: The regulatory waiting period on Mapfre's acquisition of Safety Insurance Group expired on September 14, clearing the way for Safety to become a wholly owned Mapfre subsidiary after shareholder materials were mailed the same week.

headline: US P&C insurers post stronger profits even as premium growth cools sharply
summary: Industry-wide net underwriting gains more than doubled to $31.7 billion in the first half of 2026, even as net written premium growth slowed to about 2.1% from 5.2% a year earlier, with personal auto and commercial property rates softening while liability and casualty losses kept worsening.

headline: UK consolidator Clear Group buys specialist Lloyd's wholesale broker
summary: Clear Group acquired Newman Pearce & Partners, a 24-person Lloyd's wholesale broker whose revenue grew from about £5m to £7m in the past year, as part of Clear's push to deepen its London market wholesale broking presence.

headline: Specialty insurer Mosaic rolls out AI-driven underwriting platform for SMEs
summary: Mosaic Insurance launched a digital underwriting system called HALO that combines broker trading activity, underwriting decisions and portfolio outcomes in one environment, aimed at speeding up delivery of complex specialty products to small and midsize business customers.

headline: Asia-Pacific insurance dealmaking cools even as India and Malaysia buck the trend
summary: Broader M&A activity across Asia-Pacific's insurance and broking sector slowed in the second quarter of 2026, even as India and Malaysia each recorded major multi-million-dollar transactions, underscoring uneven momentum across the region's markets.

headline: Marsh names new global chief claims officer as it reshuffles claims leadership
summary: Marsh Risk appointed Chetna Gulati-Kapoor, a 20-year claims veteran who trained as a solicitor in India and the UK, as global chief claims officer effective September 1, succeeding Rob Powell, who moves up to chairman of global claims.

headline: AI-native claims TPA Elysian bolsters leadership with new claims strategy chief
summary: Elysian, a startup positioning itself as an AI-native third-party administrator for complex commercial claims, named industry veteran Armando Andrade as its Head of Claims Strategy, bringing over two decades of TPA and claims-operations experience from TheBest Claims Solutions.

headline: Zinnia adds whole-life product engine to its Zahara administration platform
summary: Life and annuity technology vendor Zinnia expanded its Zahara policy administration system with a new configurable whole-life chassis aimed at the final-expense market, letting carriers launch products in roughly three months as API-based, cloud-native administration continues replacing legacy batch systems.

headline: Wealthtech giant FNZ secures $450m top-up from existing backers
summary: Global wealth-management technology platform FNZ raised $450 million in new equity from long-standing institutional investors including CPP Investments and La Caisse, earmarking the funds for continued platform modernization, hiring and product expansion.

headline: UK broker JMG Group names Andrew Cunis to lead South and private-client business
summary: UK insurance broker consolidator JMG Group appointed industry veteran Andrew Cunis, who brings more than 22 years of experience, as chief executive of its South of England and private-client operations as the group continues regional expansion.

headline: AIG's top P&C executive Jon Hancock to step down at year-end
summary: AIG disclosed that General Insurance CEO Jon Hancock will retire December 31, 2026 and move into a senior advisory role reporting to CEO Eric Andersen, the latest in a string of leadership changes atop the carrier this year.

headline: Florida clears HCSC's absorption of Cigna's local Medicare business
summary: Florida's insurance commissioner signed off on Health Care Service Corp's acquisition of Cigna's HealthSpring Medicare Advantage operations in the state, one of the remaining state-level approvals needed to fully fold Cigna's Medicare book into HCSC.

headline: ACA enrollees hit with the subsidy cliff again as enhanced credits lapse
summary: With the pandemic-era enhanced premium tax credits gone as of January 1, 2026, the ACA's hard income cutoff for subsidy eligibility has returned, and marketplace insurers' median proposed rate increase for 2026 sits around 18-20%, pushing many middle-income households toward much higher net premiums.

headline: Big payers say AI-driven prior-auth cleanup is cutting transaction volume
summary: The six largest publicly traded insurers report they've standardized documentation for more than half their prior-authorization requests under an industry pledge, and sector-wide prior-auth volume has fallen about 11% over a 10-month stretch as automated, standardized workflows take hold.

headline: Employer medical plan cost inflation eases slightly across Asia-Pacific
summary: Brokers report that year-over-year medical trend increases for corporate health plans across Asia-Pacific markets are moderating somewhat in 2026 compared with recent years, though costs remain elevated as insurers cite an aging population and rising private-care demand.

headline: Hospital margins keep sliding as expenses outrun reimbursement
summary: System-wide operating margins fell roughly 5% nationally in early 2026 versus a year earlier, with rising bad debt and uncompensated care, soft government reimbursement and Medicare Advantage payment friction squeezing smaller hospitals hardest while the largest nonprofit systems hold up better.

headline: Taiwan's hospitals roll out agentic AI at scale with NVIDIA and Foxconn
summary: Under a $1.5B 'Healthy Taiwan' push, Foxconn and the island's leading medical centers are deploying NVIDIA-powered clinical agents for tasks like ECG screening, cancer subtyping and real-time procedural support, covering over 14 million patient encounters a year.

headline: Ambient-AI vendor Suki pushes past documentation into standalone dictation tools
summary: Clinical scribe company Suki is broadening its ambient AI suite with a modular, standalone dictation product for EHRs, part of a wider push by ambient-documentation vendors to extend beyond note-taking into fuller clinical workflow support.

headline: CMS locks in more than 5,500 specialists for its mandatory 2027 payment model
summary: CMS released the final participant roster for its new Ambulatory Specialty Model, compelling 5,556 specialists treating heart failure and low back pain in selected regions into value-based payment starting January 1, 2027, with the program running five performance years.

headline: ChristianaCare taps Jenn Schwartz as next CEO
summary: Delaware-based ChristianaCare named Jenn Schwartz as its incoming chief executive, succeeding longtime CEO Janice Nevin, who retired September 1, 2026, as part of a broader wave of health-system leadership turnover this year.

headline: 401(k) and 403(b) balances hit record highs as savers stay the course
summary: Fidelity's Q2 2026 retirement analysis found average 401(k) balances grew roughly 10.5% quarter-over-quarter, pushing 401(k), 403(b) and IRA balances to new highs as participants maintained contribution rates despite market swings.

headline: Sequoia Financial Group buys $2.3 billion Colorado RIA BSW Wealth Partners
summary: Sequoia Financial Group announced the acquisition of BSW Wealth Partners, a roughly $2.3 billion AUM registered investment advisor, expanding Sequoia's footprint in Colorado as RIA roll-up activity continues at a rapid pace in 2026.

headline: US P&C insurers post $31.7 billion underwriting gain in first half of 2026
summary: The US property/casualty industry's net underwriting gain nearly tripled to $31.7 billion in H1 2026 versus $11.6 billion a year earlier, while net written premium growth slowed to 2.1% as the market continues to soften and competition intensifies.

headline: Aon to acquire USI Insurance Services from KKR for $17 billion
summary: Aon confirmed a definitive agreement to acquire USI Insurance Services from private equity owner KKR for $17 billion, extending Aon's push into the US middle market following its 2024 purchase of NFP and adding USI's wholesale MGA/MGU capabilities.

headline: AI-native small-business health benefits brokerage Corridor launches with $25 million seed round
summary: Corridor, an AI-native benefits brokerage aimed at closing the gap between the health coverage options available to large employers versus small businesses, launched with a $25 million seed round led by Bain Capital Ventures with participation from BoxGroup and Definition Capital.

headline: Sapiens expands executive bench with new Chief Autonomous Enterprise Officer and CMO
summary: Core insurance software provider Sapiens International named Nazir Esmail as Chief Autonomous Enterprise Officer and Maggie Fox as Chief Marketing Officer, broadening its leadership team as it pushes further into AI-driven, autonomous insurance operations.

headline: WTW warns UK employer health insurance costs set to jump more than 10% in 2026
summary: A WTW analysis projects UK private medical insurance costs for employers will rise over 10% in 2026, as elevated medical inflation driven by expensive oncology treatments and a surge in mental health claims continues to squeeze corporate health benefit budgets.

headline: FTC finds PBM specialty-drug markups generated $7.3 billion in excess revenue
summary: A Federal Trade Commission report found the largest pharmacy benefit managers marked up specialty generic drugs enough to generate more than $7.3 billion in excess revenue between 2017 and 2022, with PBM-affiliated pharmacies charging especially steep markups on cancer and HIV medications.

headline: Guthrie Clinic and UF Health deploy R1's AI-native utilization and revenue-cycle platform
summary: Guthrie Clinic and UF Health became early adopters of R1's Phare platform, an AI-powered tool that shifts utilization management from retrospective chart review to real-time clinical and financial decisioning as health systems scale enterprise AI beyond pilots.

headline: AIG names Sierra Signorelli CEO of Americas and Global Personal Insurance as Zaffino steps back
summary: AIG appointed Sierra Signorelli, rejoining from Zurich, as Chief Executive Officer of Americas and Global Personal Insurance effective January 2027, while Peter Zaffino stepped down as Executive Chair and board member effective September 15, 2026.
